izzyondroid:com.bugsdev2.bookaccio.name: Bookaccio Book Tracker
izzyondroid:com.bugsdev2.bookaccio.description:
Bookaccio is a book tracking application that helps you manage and organize your reading list. With Bookaccio, you can:
 Search for books and add them to your collection using the Google Books API
 Update your progress
 Import and export book data
 Delete books when needed
 Keep a clear and organized view of your entire library, making reading goals easier to track
 Permissions:
 INTERNET: 
 This permission is required to allow the app to access online services, such as fetching book metadata from the Google Books API and updating book details. It ensures the app can connect to the internet to retrieve real-time information and synchronize data.
 READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE: 
 This permission is required for reading user data stored in external storage, such as when importing or exporting book data. It enables the app to access user files that are stored on the device.
 WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE: 
 This permission allows the app to save and modify data on the device’s external storage, such as exporting or saving book data. It is essential for creating backups of book data and providing a smooth experience for storing and retrieving files.
 CAMERA: 
 This permission allows the app to use the device camera. This is essential when you are using the barcode scanner to scan and add new books.
 READ_MEDIA_IMAGES: 
 This permission allows the app to access images on the device, enabling users to select a book cover.

fdroid:com.pgpony.android.name: PGPony
fdroid:com.pgpony.android.summary: Encrypt, decrypt and sign with OpenPGP. Post-quantum keys and security keys.
fdroid:com.pgpony.android.description:
PGPony brings real OpenPGP encryption to Android, with post-quantum cryptography and hardware security key support. Generate PGP keys, then encrypt, decrypt, sign and verify messages and files on your device. No account, no server, no tracking. Fully compatible with GnuPG (GPG), OpenKeychain and other OpenPGP tools.
NEW: Pairing with PGPony Desktop, SSH login with your PGP keys, and post-quantum ML-DSA signatures.
▌POST-QUANTUM ENCRYPTION
- Quantum-resistant ML-KEM-768 and ML-KEM-1024 (Kyber) composite encryption keys
- Post-quantum ML-DSA-65 and ML-DSA-87 (Dilithium) signatures on OpenPGP v6 keys
- IETF standard format, plus the LibrePGP format GnuPG 2.5 uses
- Protects your messages from "harvest now, decrypt later" attacks
▌EMAIL, PASSWORDS AND SSH
- OpenPGP provider for Thunderbird for Android, K-9 Mail and FairEmail
- A modern successor to OpenKeychain: same API, actively maintained
- You approve every connected app and can revoke any of them in Settings
- Read your pass (password-store) entries, including ones on a hardware key
- SSH login with a PGPony key through an ssh-agent in Termux
▌HARDWARE SECURITY KEYS
- Use a YubiKey, Token2 or other OpenPGP smartcard over NFC or USB
- Your private key never leaves the hardware; the PIN confirms every operation
- Generate keys on the card, sign, decrypt and encrypt-and-sign; optional PIN caching
- Change PINs and reset the card; KDF-protected PINs supported
▌PGP KEY MANAGEMENT
- Generate Ed25519, RSA, OpenPGP v6 or post-quantum key pairs
- Import and export armored keys; add subkeys and User IDs; set expiry; revoke
- Encrypted keyring backup and restore, including OpenKeychain backups
▌ENCRYPT, DECRYPT, SIGN
- Encrypt text or files for one or many recipients
- Verify signatures with a clear verified-signer badge
- PGP/MIME email: decrypt messages with attachments, compose .eml
▌OPENPGP V4 + V6 + PQC COMPATIBILITY
- Full OpenPGP v4 (RFC 4880) and v6 (RFC 9580): generate, encrypt, decrypt, sign
- AEAD-OCB authenticated encryption and Argon2id key protection
- Byte-exact GnuPG interoperability, tested on every release
▌EASY KEY EXCHANGE
- Share your public key as a QR code, file or text; scan to import
- Import a key from a link and check its fingerprint before adding it
- Key server and Web Key Directory (WKD) lookup, including keys.openpgp.org
- Pair with PGPony Desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux) or another phone
- Autocrypt support and a built-in contacts list
▌PRIVACY BY DESIGN
- Encryption runs 100% on your device: no account, no telemetry
- Offline mode turns off every network feature
- Route key server traffic through Tor with Orbot
- Private keys in encrypted storage backed by Android Keystore
- Optional biometric lock, fingerprint-to-sign and auto-clearing clipboard
▌WHO PGPONY IS FOR
- Journalists, researchers and activists handling sensitive information
- Thunderbird, K-9 Mail and FairEmail users who need a crypto provider
- Developers and sysadmins using PGP for code signing, releases or SSH
- GnuPG users who want a mobile companion, or an OpenKeychain replacement
- Anyone who wants encryption that stays private in the quantum era
▌WHY PGPONY
Most "secure messaging" apps ask you to trust their servers. PGPony doesn't need any. Your keys are generated and stored on your device and never leave unless you share them. If you use GnuPG on the desktop, you already know PGPony. New to PGP? It's built to be the easiest place to start.
▌OPEN SOURCE
- Apache-2.0 licensed, with the OpenPGP core published as its own library
- Reproducible builds: anyone can check the release APKs against the source
- Free, with no ads and no in-app purchases
▌PRIVACY COMMITMENT
PGPony does not collect, store or transmit any personal data. No account system, no tracking SDKs. Full privacy policy: pgpony.app/privacy
Made by an indie developer in Alabama. Questions or requests? Tap Send Feedback in the app, or write NorseHorse@norsehor.se.

fdroid:com.subtitlescreen.name: Subtitle Blocker
fdroid:com.subtitlescreen.summary: Overlay to mask hard-coded subtitles on videos and social media.
fdroid:com.subtitlescreen.description:
This super-niche application was developed purely to deal with a strong dislike of the fast-moving, distracting subtitles that are hard-coded into many social media videos and cannot be turned off.
When enabled, the overlay can either be docked as a small unobtrusive tab on the side of the screen, or expanded into a resizable, moveable rectangle which can be dragged to cover the area displaying subtitles. Colours, opacity, which edge the tab pins to, and symmetric (centre-anchored) resize are all configurable.
Basic operation should be completely obvious:
• Tap the chevrons » in the middle of the overlay to collapse it to a side tab.
• Tap the tab to expand it again.
• Drag any corner to resize.
• Drag anywhere else to move.
• Triple-tap the overlay to open Settings.
You can add the "Sub Blocker" tile to your Android Quick Settings panel (swipe down, tap the edit pencil, drag the tile into your active tiles) to quickly toggle the overlay on and off without opening the app.
Feedback and feature requests are welcome.

fdroid:com.zaifears.locreminder.name: LocReminder
fdroid:com.zaifears.locreminder.summary: Reminds you at the right place
fdroid:com.zaifears.locreminder.description:
LocReminder is an alarm clock that goes off at a place instead of a time.
You know roughly where you are going, but not exactly when you will get there. Traffic, delays and unfamiliar routes make that impossible to predict, so a normal alarm is no use. Instead you spend the whole journey glancing out of the window, unable to properly rest or focus.
Drop a pin on your destination, choose how close you want to get, and put your phone away. When you arrive, LocReminder rings a real alarm: a looping sound that plays even on silent, vibration, and a full-screen alert over your lock screen.
 What it is good for 
🚌 Long bus or train rides, so you can actually sleep
🗺️ Arriving somewhere unfamiliar, where you would not recognise your stop
📚 Commuting, so you can read or work without watching the route
🚗 Road trips as a passenger, to be woken before the turn-off
🛍️ Errands, so you are reminded at the shop or the post office rather than after passing it
 Features 
🔔 A real alarm, not a quiet notification: loops on the alarm audio channel so it sounds even on silent
🎵 Choose your own alarm sound: any system ringtone, or an audio file of your own
📍 Search for a destination by name, drag the map to place the pin exactly, or type coordinates straight in — the last of those needs no connection
📝 Give each alarm a task in your own words — "Buy medicine" — or let it take the name of the place
🔁 Repeat an alarm every day, or on the weekdays you choose, for a commute or a standing errand
📋 Multiple alarms, each with its own trigger radius, and live distance to each
📏 Adjustable radius from 100 m to 3 km (or 330 ft to 1.9 mi in Miles mode), so you get as much warning as you need
🌗 Light and dark themes
📶 Works with no signal: the alarm runs on GPS alone and never needs a connection, and the map is kept on your phone so it still draws in a dead spot
🔋 Battery-aware: checks rarely when you are far away, more often as you approach, and not at all on days none of your alarms are set for
🛡️ Reliability screen that detects your phone's manufacturer and shows the exact settings needed, plus a test that proves the alarm gets through a locked screen
 No signal? No problem 
The alarm never needs the internet. GPS is a receive-only radio, and the arrival check happens on your phone, so it rings in a tunnel, in a village with no data, or with no SIM card at all. Only the map pictures and searching a place by name need a connection — so every part of the map you look at is kept on the phone for a month, and the streets around each alarm are saved the moment you set it.
 Privacy 
LocReminder has no account, no analytics, no advertising and no server. Your saved destinations never leave your device. Maps and place search come from OpenStreetMap.
 Important: background restrictions 
Many manufacturers (Xiaomi, Samsung, Oppo, Vivo, OnePlus, Huawei) run their own battery managers that stop background apps, which will prevent the alarm from ringing. No app can change those settings on your behalf. After installing, open Menu, then Alarm reliability, and follow the steps shown for your device. It takes a minute and is the difference between an alarm that works and one that does not.

fedora-packages:acpitool/acpitool.description: AcpiTool is a Linux ACPI client. It's a small command line application, intended to be a replacement for the apm tool. Besides "basic" ACPI information like battery status, AC presence, putting the laptop to sleep, Acpitool also supports various extensions for Toshiba, Asus and IBM Thinkpad laptops, allowing you to change the LCD brightness level, toggle fan on/off, and more.

fedora-packages:atkinson-hyperlegible-ne.name: atkinson-hyperlegible-next-fonts
fedora-packages:atkinson-hyperlegible-ne.summary: Second-gen font family made for low-vision legibility
fedora-packages:atkinson-hyperlegible-ne.description: Atkinson Hyperlegible is a uniquely accessible typeface created by Braille Institute of America. It has been developed specifically to increase legibility for readers with low vision, and to improve comprehension. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, a refined version of Atkinson Hyperlegible, improves on the original in every way. It features new weights, improved kerning, refined curves, added symbols, and additional language support.

fedora-packages:beediff/beediff.name: beediff
fedora-packages:beediff/beediff.summary: Visual tool for comparing and merging files
fedora-packages:beediff/beediff.description: This package provides a visual application (beediff) for comparing and merging files. User have a possibility to work with two text files. Every one is in separate panel. Panels are side by side. All differences of both textes are highlighted in colors. Operation buttons (merge, remove) are located direct inside compared textes in appropriate positions. Program is user friendly, very simply and efficient.

fedora-packages:below/below.name: below
fedora-packages:below/below.summary: Interactive tool to view and record historical system data
fedora-packages:below/below.description: below is an interactive tool to view and record historical system data. It has support for: - information regarding hardware resource utilization - viewing the cgroup hierarchy - cgroup and process information - pressure stall information (PSI) - record mode to record system data - replay mode to replay historical system data - live mode to view live system data - dump subcommand to report script-friendly information (e.g. JSON and CSV) below does not have support for cgroup1. The name "below" stems from the fact that the below developers rejected many of atop's design and style decisions.

fedora-packages:libcaca/caca-utils.name: caca-utils
fedora-packages:libcaca/caca-utils.summary: Colour AsCii Art Text mode graphics utilities based on libcaca
fedora-packages:libcaca/caca-utils.description: This package contains utilities and demonstration programs for libcaca, the Colour AsCii Art library. cacaview is a simple image viewer for the terminal. It opens most image formats such as JPEG, PNG, GIF etc. and renders them on the terminal using ASCII art. The user can zoom and scroll the image, set the dithering method or enable anti-aliasing. cacaball is a tiny graphic program that renders animated ASCII metaballs on the screen, cacafire is a port of AALib's aafire and displays burning ASCII art flames, and cacademo is a simple application that shows the libcaca rendering features such as line and ellipses drawing, triangle filling and sprite blitting.

fedora-packages:conan/conan.name: conan
fedora-packages:conan/conan.description: Conan is a package manager for C and C++ developers. It is fully decentralized. Users can host their packages on their servers, privately. Works across all platforms. It can create, upload and download binaries for any configuration and platform, even cross-compiling, saving lots of time in development and continuous integration. The binary compatibility can be configured and customized. Manage all your artifacts in the same way on all platforms. Integrates with any build system. Provides tested support for most major build systems. Its python based recipes, together with extensions points allows for great power and flexibility.

fedora-packages:cp2k/cp2k.name: cp2k
fedora-packages:cp2k/cp2k.description: CP2K is a quantum chemistry and solid state physics software package that can perform atomistic simulations of solid state, liquid, molecular, periodic, material, crystal, and biological systems. It provides a general framework for different modeling methods such as DFT using the mixed Gaussian and plane waves approaches GPW and GAPW. This package contains the non-MPI single process and multi-threaded versions.

fedora-packages:flac/flac.summary: An encoder/decoder for the Free Lossless Audio Codec
fedora-packages:flac/flac.description: FLAC stands for Free Lossless Audio Codec. Grossly oversimplified, FLAC is similar to Ogg Vorbis, but lossless. The FLAC project consists of the stream format, reference encoders and decoders in library form, flac, a command-line program to encode and decode FLAC files, metaflac, a command-line metadata editor for FLAC files and input plugins for various music players. This package contains the command-line tools and documentation.

fedora-packages:flcluster/flcluster.name: flcluster
fedora-packages:flcluster/flcluster.summary: A management tool for accessing dxcluster nodes
fedora-packages:flcluster/flcluster.description: flcluster can connect to and display data from DX cluster servers. The three most common server types are A←-R-Cluster, CC-Cluster, and DX Spider. The program is designed to work stand alone or as a helper application to fldigi. It can move call, mode, and frequency data from a spotted QSO to the appropriate fldigi controls. It can query fldigi for the same items when generating a spot report.

fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.name: flexmark-java-ext-ins
fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.description: Flexmark-java is a Java CommonMark (spec 0.28) parser using the blocks first, inlines after Markdown parsing architecture. Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. This package contains an extension that converts `++text++` syntax into `<ins>text</ins>`, the HTML syntax for inserted text.

Download every image from any webpage. Filter by size, type, and orientation. Save as one clean ZIP — or grab single images instantly with on-page download buttons. No account. No limits.
WHY IMGDOWNLOADPRO?
────────────────────────────────────────
Most image downloaders miss half the images on a page, download them one by one, or stop working the moment a site uses lazy loading. ImgDownloadPro fixes all of that - and goes further. It deep-scans the entire page, applies smart filters so you only get what you actually need, packages your selection into one clean ZIP file in seconds, and adds optional one-click downloads on each image when you need speed over bulk.
Now with a full side panel interface - stay beside your tab while you work, without losing your place on the page.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
────────────────────────────────────────
 Scan the current tab - Collects image URLs from the page (including common lazy-load attributes, backgrounds, and meta images where possible).
 Filter results - By file type (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, SVG, AVIF), orientation, minimum pixel size, custom width/height ranges, and minimum file size.
 Preview and choose - See thumbnails, toggle grid or list view, and select only the images you want.
 Download as ZIP - Selected images are packaged into folders by rough resolution so large downloads stay organized.
HOW TO USE
────────────────────────────────────────
Bulk download:
1. Click the extension to open the side panel.
2. Hit "Scan Page" - the extension auto-scrolls and finds every image on the page.
3. Use filters to narrow results by file type, orientation, image dimensions, or file size.
4. Select the images you want and download them all as a ZIP.
Quick single image:
1. Open the side panel and enable "Quick download buttons."
2. Click the download icon on any image on the page.
3. The file saves directly to your downloads folder.
4. Done - one click for a single image, or a full organized ZIP in seconds.
Supported Formats: JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, SVG
Privacy First: 100% local - no data collection, no tracking, no servers. Everything runs inside your browser.
No account needed. Install and start downloading in under 10 seconds.
Pricing
Free - No credit card, no account required.
Target Audience
Designers, developers, content creators, e-commerce researchers
Important:
Only download images you own or have permission to use. This tool is meant for legitimate personal or professional workflows, not for bulk copying others’ work without rights.

firefox-addons:2849243.name: ARC Toolkit
firefox-addons:2849243.description:
The ARC Toolkit is a set of accessibility tools which aids developers in identifying accessibility problems and features for WCAG 2.0, WCAG 2.1, WCAG 2.2, EN 301 549, and Section 508
The toolkit is designed to be integrated into automated and manual accessibility tests and works alongside the auditor or developer in order to simplify repetitive tasks and interactively explore accessibility features and problems. The ARC Toolkit is tightly integrated with Chrome’s Developer Tools and uses the ARC rule set, the same rules used by default in the ARC platform. This allows developers and quality assurance testers to take their ARC testing into their development environments and thoroughly investigate issues raised in ARC scans.
Launched from the Developer Tools, the ARC Toolkit panel includes a set of tests that shows results both in the panel and in the page itself. Each test can be toggled on and off so types of issues can be isolated. Issues can be selected and viewed directly in the Elements panel.
It runs completely local within Chrome and works within iframes, so it can evaluate any page you can browse to. If you would like to pages that are not live on a website but are in development, turn on the option to "Allow access to file URLs".
Because this tool is actively used by the TPGi team, there are frequent updates as we further develop and refine the rules and features. If you would like training on how to use ARC Toolkit for testing, please contact TPGi at https://www.tpgi.com/contact/ .
This extension is governed by the license agreement at https://www.tpgi.com/arc-toolkit-the-service-terms-of-service/ .

bluejetty:00138991:ios.description:
Melon Smash is an exciting sandbox game that offers players unlimited possibilities for creativity, construction, and management. This game is a real world where you can be anyone and do anything, immersing yourself in an atmosphere of freedom and endless adventures.
In Melon Smash, you can build and create whatever you can imagine. The game offers a variety of building elements, materials, and design tools. You will be able to make your house, castle, or even an entire city. Each component of this sandbox game adds uniqueness to your creation. The sandbox genre encourages your creativity, allowing you to experiment with shapes and colors.
In this exciting sandbox, you can control your hero, choosing from a variety of skins and external settings. This allows you to create a unique character that will reflect your personality. A flexible customization system provides variety and allows each player to stand out in the sandbox world. Your hero will become not only a builder, but also an explorer, ready for new adventures.
The game offers a vast sandbox world full of unique locations, each with its own atmosphere and style. Explore dense forests, picturesque mountains, desert areas, and cities. Each sandbox location is full of hidden details and opportunities waiting for you to discover them. This adds an element of exploration and discovery to the gameplay.
One of the key features of Melon Smash is the lack of a clear goal or end of the game. This creates a unique sense of freedom, allowing players to enjoy the process without restrictions in this sandbox. You can build, explore, fight, or relax in your sandbox world. Every time you enter the game, new adventures and ideas await you to implement.

bluejetty:00040943:ios.description:
Scan any QR code or barcode in a split second. Point your camera and QR Reader does the rest: fast, accurate and private. No sign-up, no ads.
Version 2.0 is a brand-new app, rebuilt from the ground up for iPhone.
SCAN ANY CODE
• QR codes and all common barcodes: EAN, UPC, Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, ITF, Codabar, GS1 DataBar, Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec and Micro QR
• Auto zoom and flashlight for small, distant or poorly lit codes
• Scan photos, screenshots and PDFs and find every code on the page at once
• Batch Scan: keep the camera rolling and collect many codes in one list
SMART ACTIONS
• Join Wi-Fi networks with one tap, no typing passwords
• Open links, call, email or text in one tap
• Save contacts and add events to your calendar
• Payments, locations, crypto addresses and two-factor setup codes are recognized automatically
LINK GUARD
• Potentially unsafe links are flagged before you open them
• Short links show where they really lead
QR CODE GENERATOR
• Create QR codes for websites, text, Wi-Fi, contacts, email, phone, SMS, locations, events, WhatsApp, social profiles, PayPal, crypto and SEPA payments
• 12 barcode types: Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, ITF, Codabar, ISBN, PDF417 and Aztec
• Make it yours: colors, gradients, dot and eye shapes, frames and your logo. Every design is checked so it stays scannable
• Bulk Create: turn a list or a CSV file into print-ready labels or a ZIP of PNG images
HISTORY, ORGANIZED
• Folders, favorites, notes and search
• Export to CSV, back up and restore
• Lock your history with Face ID or Touch ID
SCAN FROM ANYWHERE
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Control Center and Siri Shortcuts
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Codes are read on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking.
QR READER PRO
Scanning and basic code creation are free. Pro unlocks Batch Scan, every code type, custom designs, CSV export, Face ID lock and results without interruptions.
• Pro is an auto-renewable weekly subscription with a 3-day free trial.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the free trial ends, or when you confirm the purchase if no trial applies.
• The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends.
• Manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple Account settings.
• Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.
Terms of Use: https://qr.seattle.tr/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://qr.seattle.tr/privacy/

Step into the prehistoric era, face powerful dinosaurs, and prove yourself as the ultimate dino hunter. bluejetty:00146858:ios.description:
Embark on an exhilarating journey with Triple Fusion – the ultimate puzzle-solving adventure. Dive into a world where each level presents a unique challenge, keeping you hooked for hours on end.
Why Triple Fusion?
Triple Fusion is an addiction waiting to happen. The captivating blend of eye-catching graphics and brain-teasing puzzles creates an experience that is as fun as it is challenging. The game's intuitive design ensures that players of all skill levels can jump right in and enjoy the excitement.
Key Features:
- The 3D design adds a layer of depth to the gameplay, making each level a visual feast.
- Challenging Puzzles: Test your observation and logic skills with a wide variety of puzzles that range from the delightfully simple to the mind-bendingly complex. Every level is a new adventure, keeping you engaged and entertained.
- Addictive Gameplay: The carefully crafted progression of difficulty ensures that as you master one set of challenges, new, more intricate puzzles await.
- Strategic Thinking: Triple Fusion is not just about finding objects; it's about honing your strategic thinking. Each puzzle requires a unique approach, encouraging players to think outside the box and develop their problem-solving skills.
How to Play:
- Observe Carefully: Take a close look at the 3D environment. Objects may be cleverly hidden or camouflaged, requiring a keen eye.
- Tap to Interact: Once you've identified a potential target, tap on it to select. Be precise, as the clock is ticking, and every second counts.
- Complete Objectives: Each level has specific objectives. Whether it's finding a set number of items or solving a puzzle, stay focused on the task at hand.
- Earn Stars: Successfully completing levels earns you stars. Aim for three stars to showcase your mastery.
- Unlock New Levels: Progress through the game to unlock new and more challenging levels. The excitement never stops as the difficulty ramps up.
Embark on a journey that will test your wits, engage your senses, and keep you entertained for countless hours. Dive into the addictive world of Triple 3D and discover the joy of mastering each level one captivating puzzle at a time.

bluejetty:00137515:ios.description:
Discover a worldwide collection of coins right at your fingertips. Find the needle in the haystack among almost 500,000 coins within seconds thanks to cutting-edge AI technology. From historical treasures to the newest circulation coins, we’ve got you covered. Whether you’re an ardent numismatic fan, a traveling collector, or casually putting together a near-and-dear collection from underneath your couch cushions — you’ll find all your new additions easily in CoinLens. 
— Scan — 
Just take a picture of the obverse and the reverse sides and within seconds, our AI will find the right coin for you. Round coins? Square coins? Nickel, silver, gold — we’ve got them all! 
You can also search our vast database for coins that you still need to complete your collection.
— Identify — 
Get instant value estimates to see how much your coin is worth. Find out all there is about the coin including its origins, composition, and minting years. Learn about the historical significance of the coin itself and its symbols.
— Collect — 
Save your coins to your collection to always have it on hand. Get the total value and breadth of your collection at a glance. 
— See for yourself just how easy it is to use CoinLens — 
1. Open up the app and take a picture of both sides of the coin. 
2. Get near-instant identification with the help of AI 
3. Add the coin to your virtual collection. 
Get Premium to unlock unlimited scans!
If you choose to use CoinLens without a subscription, you are entitled to a certain number of coin scan identifications. Get the Premium subscription to unlock unlimited scans for fast and easy coin identification.
If you choose not to continue with the subscription, make sure to cancel at least 24 hours before the trial concludes to avoid automatic charges. You will be automatically charged a price indicated on the payment screen for a chosen subscription period.
The CoinLens Premium subscription renews automatically at the end of each period until you cancel. Canceling your subscription means the automatic renewal will be disabled. Nevertheless, you will retain access to all the features included in your subscription for the remaining duration of your ongoing period.
Note that deleting the app does not cancel your subscriptions.
By using the app, you are agreeing to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
Privacy Policy: https://logicfusion.net/coinlens/privacypolicy
Terms of Use: https://logicfusion.net/coinlens/termsofuse
Found a problem? Thought of an improvement? Drop us a note at support@logicfusion.net

bluejetty:00061172:ios.name: BookBuddy: Book Tracker
bluejetty:00061172:ios.summary: BookBuddy is a powerful book management app that gives you access to your entire book catalog, anywhere. Using BookBuddy is fun and easy, allowing you to quickly find any book in your library, share your favorite books, and keep track of bo
bluejetty:00061172:ios.description:
BookBuddy is a powerful book management app that gives you access to your entire book catalog, anywhere. Using BookBuddy is fun and easy, allowing you to quickly find any book in your library, share your favorite books, and keep track of borrowed and lent books.
FREE VERSION
- BookBuddy has all the features of BookBuddy Pro with a 50 book limit. 
- BookBuddy can be upgraded via In-App Purchase for unlimited book storage.
KEY FEATURES
• Adding Your Books
Add your books using the following options:
- Scan barcode (via iPhone camera or Bluetooth handheld scanner)
- Enter ISBN
- Search online by keyword
- Add manually
- Import from CSV file
• Organizing Your Books
Place your books where they belong:
- My Books — books you own
- Wish List — books you wish to own
- Borrowed — books you borrowed from others
- Previously Owned — books you no longer own
• Syncing Your Library
Sync your library across multiple devices using iCloud or Dropbox sync.
• Sharing Your Library
Share your library online via the BookBuddy Companion website and invite anyone to view it (requires a monthly subscription).
• Unlocking Your Reading Insights
Deep dive into your reading habits by exploring the following statistics:
- Books Finished — Track the number of books you’ve completed
- Pages Read — See your page count over time
- Top Authors — Discover your most-read authors
- Favorite Genres — Identify your preferred genres
MORE TO LOVE
• Universal app — pay once and use BookBuddy on your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Silicon Mac.
• Personalize — use categories and tags, mark favorites, add personal notes, and much more.
• Appearance — choose either list or grid view to best match your needs.
• Custom Filters — filter your library by multiple criteria.
• Advanced Sorting — apply multi-level data sorting.
• Loans — instantly track books that are currently loaned out.
• Multiple selection — apply batch operations using multiple selection.
• Reading Status — filter your books by their reading status.
• Quick find — instantly find books by entering search keywords or scanning their barcodes.
• Export — quickly export your library into CSV, PDF, or HTML formats.
• Print — easily print selected books to AirPrint-enabled printers.
• Backup — create backups to any cloud service.
• Activity History — view the full history of your reading and loaning activities.
• Duplicates — quickly detect duplicates and easily remove them.
• Markdown Formatting — style your notes with headings, lists, bold, italics, links, and more.
• Privacy — your library is saved locally and privately on your device.
• And so much more!
CLASSROOM LIBRARY MANAGER (for teachers)
• Manage — use BookBuddy to manage your classroom library and track student checkouts.
• Checkout History — easily track checkout history and view statistics.
• Contacts — save your student names in BookBuddy Contacts rather than in your personal Contacts app.
• Reading Level Fields — use various fields to track the reading level of your books.
• Online Sharing — allow students to self-checkout books via the BookBuddy Companion website (requires a monthly subscription).
FEEDBACK
We love staying in touch with our users and we look forward to hearing from you! If you have any feedback, questions, or concerns, please email us at:
support@kimicoapps.com 
or visit: http://www.kimicoapps.com/support.html
Follow us on Facebook:
http://www.facebook.com/KimicoLtd

* Terms and Conditions: https://www.iubenda.com/terms-and-conditions/12652322

bluejetty:00073576:ios.description:
Get ready for the ultimate pizza cooking experience in Pizza Maker 2: Special Edition takes the craziness to a whole new level, delivering an experience that will blow players' minds. If you enjoyed the first game, get ready for a sequel that goes above and beyond with its wild and imaginative ideas.
The highly anticipated sequel to the beloved culinary game! Step into the shoes of a master pizza chef and embark on an extraordinary culinary journey that will take your pizza-making skills to new heights.
Embraces the notion that pizza-making can be an adventure full of creativity, surprises, and sheer fun. With its crazy ideas and innovative features, the game offers an unforgettable experience that will leave players craving for more outrageous pizza-making escapades. Are you ready to dive into a world of culinary madness and become the wildest Pizza Master of them all?
Pizza Maker 2: Special Edition brings a host of exciting new features to the table. Explore a vibrant and expanded world of pizza-making possibilities, with new toppings, ingredients, and exotic flavors to experiment with. Unleash your creativity as you design pizzas that defy conventions and challenge traditional recipes.
Pizza Maker 2: Special Edition is brought to you by Pazu Games Ltd, the publisher of popular kids’ games like Girls Hair Salon, Girls Makeup Salon, Pet Doctor, and many more, which are trusted by millions of parents worldwide.
Pazu games are designed especially for children under the age of 10. It offers fun and educational games for girls and boys to enjoy and experience.
We invite you to try out Pazu games for kids and toddlers for free and discover a wonderful brand for boys’ & girls’ games, with a large portfolio of educational and learning games for girls and boys. Our games offer a variety of game mechanics adapted to the kids’ age and capabilities.
Pazu games have no ads, so the kids have no distractions while playing, no accidental ad clicks, and no external interferences.
This game is included in the Pazu subscription which offers all of Pazu’s games with full game versions, no ads, a child-friendly interface, and up to 3 devices for each subscription.
Pazu games are trusted by millions of parents and loved by millions of kids worldwide.
Our games are designed especially for kids and offer fun educational experiences for girls and boys to enjoy.
With a variety of game mechanics adapted to different ages and capabilities, it is suitable for kids to be able to play on their own, without the support of adults.
For more information, visit our website: https://www.pazugames.com/

bluejetty:00023442:ios.name: mySCS
bluejetty:00023442:ios.summary: Get the most out of your (SCS) Trial with the mySCS application. While you test drive how spinal cord stimulation works for you, we'll help you track your daily activity and pain levels, connect with your Boston Scientific Care Team, and le
bluejetty:00023442:ios.description:
Get the most out of your (SCS) Trial with the mySCS application. While you test drive how spinal cord stimulation works for you, we'll help you track your daily activity and pain levels, connect with your Boston Scientific Care Team, and learn more about what to expect at each step along the way. At the end of your trial you can review your progress with your Physician and Boston Scientific Care Team to help determine if SCS is right for you.
Why Should I Use mySCS During my SCS Trial?
• Track: During your SCS trial, you can share with your physician how your pain and activity levels are changing and/or improving by recording them daily. This app will allow you to quickly and easily enter information to help you and your care team better understand your journey.
• Learn: During your trial you might have questions or want to learn more about the journey to Spinal Cord Stimulation. You can find valuable resources and FAQs here to help you better understand your therapy and what to expect.
• Connect: We hope this app will help you feel connected throughout your journey. When you have questions, or need someone to talk to about your therapy, you can easily reach out to your Boston Scientific Care Team. Your care team will also be able to see your progress and will be alerted to reach out to you if you have a challenging day.
Don't worry if you have never used an application like this before. We are here to help you make the most of your experience at each step of the journey! Your Boston Scientific Care team can walk you through loading the application onto your phone and provide you with a quick tour of the features. The app is easy to use and provides valuable resources and information designed to help you maximize your Boston Scientific SCS trial. The app uses Apple Healthkit and CareKit, hence the app requires users give consent to collect health data from their mobile device.

Mt Buller Live is your unique and comprehensive all-season guide to Mount Buller Resort, all at your fingertips. 
• Locate yourself on the Mt Buller trail map — not a hard-to-read GPS map.†
• Share your location on the mountain with friends, and see your friends' locations on the trail map.†
• Record your runs and log vertical feet and distance. If you have an Apple Watch, record your runs as a workout and see your workout in the Health app. Display your tracks and replay your runs on the trail map. Email images to friends, post them to social media, or view them in Google Earth. Store your logs on iCloud and view them on all your devices. Send your logs to a leaderboard and compare vertical and distance with others at the resort.†
• Find up-to-date information about the mountain, including which trails are groomed, snow conditions, weather, and webcam images.

• Quickly find information about lessons and other programs and amenities.
• Easily locate and contact key places at the resort and Village with the built in directory.
• Learn about events from the events calendar.
• Get the latest news from Mt Buller's video snow report, Twitter feed and Facebook posts.
• Learn facts, statistics and history of the resort.
† Location and Logging services require a GPS-equipped device. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00065336:ios.description:
Our personal, business and joint accounts make managing your money as seamless, simple and satisfying as it should be in 2026. It's why we're the Which? Recommended Provider for a seventh year in a row.
Apply for a bank account online in minutes - for free - from your phone, and join the millions who have already discovered the better way to bank.
What's in it for you?
No overseas fees
• We won't charge you a penny for using your card abroad, or for withdrawing cash at an ATM.
• We'll give you the Mastercard exchange rate, and won't add anything on top.
• Get notifications in the local currency, and in GBP.
Better budgeting
• Use Spaces to set money aside in a virtual change jar. Personalise with pictures, set a target, and track your progress.
• Get instant payment notifications and track your balance in real-time
• Learn where your money goes, and how to make savings, with Spending Insights
• Use Bills Manager to set aside money for your bills. It means your main balance will only show you what's actually available for day-to-day spending.
• Save on autopilot - automatically round up payments to the nearest pound and put away the spare change.
Pay and get paid seamlessly
• Owed money? Send a simple link to get paid back.
• Enjoy easy international transfers to 34 countries from your app – no hidden fees or exchange rate markups
• Pay people instantly in-app – no fiddly card reader needed
• Deposit cheques digitally from your phone and pay in cash at the Post Office.
Keep your money safe
• Your money is covered up to £120,000 by the Financial Services Compensation Scheme
• With 24/7 in-app support from real humans in the UK, we're always here to help
• Lock your card in-app and turn settings on and off, such as contactless, online, gambling and swipe payments
Business banking
No monthly fees. Get mobile and web banking access, 24/7 support and simplified accounting. Deposit cash at the Post Office from as little as £3, and deposit cheques in-app by taking a photo. Automate your expenses, ring-fence money for bills, keep track of invoices with instant payment notifications and spot where your business is spending with smart analytics. Voted Most Innovative Business Bank at RFI UK Banking & Finance Awards 2026.
The joint bank account
Manage collective household expenses or set aside money together; our joint account simplifies shared spending. Get instant payment notifications, track your spending with Insights, budget together and make important payments from one account.
Banking for the whole family, all in one app
Under 16s is our free debit card and app for 6-15 year olds. It's built seamlessly into the adult's Starling account (personal or joint) for better visibility and control.
Starling Bank Limited (trading as Starling) is registered in England and Wales (No. 09092149), 5th Floor London Fruit And Wool Exchange, 1 Duval Square, London, United Kingdom, E1 6PW. We are authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and the Prudential Regulation Authority under registration number 730166.

bluejetty:00072126:ios.description:
Socrates AI brings you the smartest chat personas — each with their own personality, expertise, and style. Whether you want a creative writing partner, a homework tutor, a brainstorming expert, or someone to talk through your ideas with, there's a character ready for you.
WHY SOCRATES AI?
Unlike generic chatbots, Socrates AI offers 50+ expert personas, each with a distinct voice and deep knowledge in their domain. Find the right expert for every conversation.
FEATURES
- Multiple Personas: Chat with dozens of unique characters, each with specialized knowledge and personality traits. From philosophers to scientists, creatives to coaches.
- Voice Chat & Live Mode: Go beyond text. Have real-time voice conversations with your personas for a more immersive experience.
- Image Generation: Create stunning images directly in your conversations. Describe what you want and watch it come to life.
- Smart Conversations: Every chat feels natural and intelligent. Get thoughtful responses that adapt to your style and preferences.
- Create Your Own Personas: Design and customize your own characters with unique personalities, instructions, and avatars. Share your creations with the community.
- Organized Chats: Label and organize your conversations. Keep your favorites easily accessible with custom labels and folders.
- Discover & Explore: Browse trending personas, discover community-created characters, and find your next favorite expert in our curated feed.
- Real-Time Assistance: Need help with homework, writing, brainstorming, or everyday questions? Get instant, accurate answers from expert chatbots.
WHO IS SOCRATES AI FOR?
- Students looking for a tutor for homework help, essay writing, and study support
- Creatives seeking a writing partner for storytelling, roleplay, and brainstorming
- Professionals who need a smart assistant for quick answers and productivity
- Curious minds who want to explore ideas and learn from expert AI characters
WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT
- 50+ unique personas with distinct personalities (not one generic bot)
- Voice chat and live conversations
- Image generation built into every chat
- Create and share your own characters
- Beautiful, intuitive interface designed for conversation
- Privacy-first: your chats stay private and secure
Download Socrates AI today and discover why thousands of users trust us for the smartest conversations. Your next great conversation is waiting.

Terms of Use: https://socrateschat.com/terms
Support: https://socrateschat.com/support

bluejetty:00072666:ios.description:
Welcome to FaceOff, the ultimate photo and video generator!
FaceOff empowers you to transform your photos into breathtaking AI-generated images and videos, blending realism with creativity like never before. Whether you want to generate a professional AI headshot, visualize your future baby, or experience your entire lifetime in a single video, FaceOff brings your vision to life. With cutting edge AI technology and an array of innovative features, FaceOff Pro unlocks limitless possibilities for self-expression, storytelling, and digital artistry.
Features:
Lifetime Trend: This feature allows users to upload a photo and experience their look across all ages, from childhood to old age, through AI. It creates an emotional and fun video that covers all stages of life, available only with FaceOff Pro.
AI Headshot Generator: Create stunning, professional, or luxury-style AI headshots that exude confidence and sophistication. Perfect for LinkedIn, resumes, and personal branding, this feature ensures you always make a powerful first impression.
AI Photo Fix: Save your bad pictures in seconds with our AI retouch and photo fix feature.
AI ToyBox Trend: Turn your photos into action figures just in seconds.
Future Baby Generator: Users can upload a single photo or two photos as a couple and see their AI-generated baby with this unique tool, exclusively available to FaceOff Pro subscribers.
FaceOff Chat: Our latest innovation allows FaceOff Pro subscribers to describe any scene or concept through chat, and our app will generate a photo with the selected character, capturing both realistic and fantasy-driven themes.
Couples Bundle: Discover over 100 new image styles, perfect for capturing the essence of your relationship. From breathtakingly realistic to enchantingly imaginative, our Couples Bundle is available with a FaceOff Pro subscription to make every shared moment even more special.
Video Bundle: For FaceOff Pro users, transforming your images into captivating videos is easier than ever. Create dynamic, share-worthy content for social media with our specially curated video bundles.
Join Our Community:
At FaceOff, we’re building more than just an app; we’re cultivating a community of dreamers, creators, and innovators. Whether you’re exploring new facets of your identity with FaceOff Chat, celebrating your relationship, or creating engaging content for social media, we’re here to support your creative journey every step of the way.
Your Feedback Matters:
Your experience and insights are invaluable to us. We welcome your feedback as we continue to evolve and enhance FaceOff, ensuring it remains your go-to platform for creative expression.
FaceOff Pro Subscription Information:
Access to the FaceOff platform and all listed features require a FaceOff Pro subscription. Payment will be charged to your Account upon purchase confirmation, with automatic renewal within 24 hours prior to the current period’s end. You can turn off auto-renewal anytime from account settings, but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
Terms and Conditions: https://www.pixerylabs.com/faceoff/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.pixerylabs.com/faceoff/privacy

bluejetty:00177892:ios.description:
Do your kids love playing car games? Specially designed for kids aged 2-5 year olds, these kids car games will definitely be enjoyed by preschool kids and toddlers. Feature of these Kids Car Games are:
Perfect for preschoolers:
These games are professionally designed for small kids aged 2, 3, 4, 5, year olds who love playing with cars.
Preschool Learning activities for kids:
There are many mini learning games for toddlers like coloring games, sort by color, constructing a bridge, car decoration, etc
Different vehicles:
Not only cars, but this game includes many other vehicles like trucks, buses, and many different types of cars. Toddlers can build their own car and service it by car washing and car decoration activities.
Puzzles:
These car puzzles will help in improving the fine motor skills of kids aged 2, 3, 4, 5 year olds and increase their concentration power. Preschool kids can join parts of the cars and run them down the racing track.
Play Offline:
Toddlers can access these kids car games anytime, anywhere without worrying about WiFi.
Child-Friendly Games:
As these games are made for kids, we have kept the app ad-free so that kids enjoy the games and don't get interrupted while playing. Kids can even build their favorite cars in car decoration games and set them up for the race.
These adventurous kids car games will make your kids go vrooom!! So, fasten your seat belts and download these preschool car games for boys 2, 3, 4, 5 year olds! Ready, Set, Go!

bluejetty:00023898:ios.name: PHapp® AZ: Health & Safety
bluejetty:00023898:ios.summary:
Stay informed. Help your community.
PHapp® AZ puts verified local health and safety information in one place. Follow the places where you live, work and have family, and see what's happening there, from extreme heat and wildfire smoke to o
bluejetty:00023898:ios.description:
Stay informed. Help your community.
PHapp® AZ puts verified local health and safety information in one place. Follow the places where you live, work and have family, and see what's happening there, from extreme heat and wildfire smoke to outbreaks and food recalls.
You can also share what you see. Report a problem or a local condition to Hub AI in your own language to help keep your community safe.
PHapp AZ is free, and you don't need an account to read it. There are no ads, we don't sell your data, and we don't track you.
STAY INFORMED
Follow towns, cities, counties and ZIP codes. Your feed covers:
• Health and disease
• Weather and severe storms
• Heat, wildfire and air quality
• Food, medicine and product recalls
• Health advisories
• Hazards and emergencies
• Public safety
• Local resources and services
KNOW WHERE IT CAME FROM
Every item names the agency that published it and the community it applies to, so you can always see why it reached you.
HELP YOUR COMMUNITY
Seen a flooded road, a closed cooling center or something else your neighbors should know about? Tell Hub AI (Research Preview). Your report goes privately to the Hub team, who can follow up.
Know a useful local resource that's missing? Suggest it. An agency checks every suggestion before it shows up.
FIND LOCAL RESOURCES
Look up nearby cooling and warming centers, shelters, naloxone, vaccination sites and food, wherever your community lists them.
WHAT TO DO, NOT JUST WHAT HAPPENED
Many topics come with plain steps for before, during and after an event.
YOUR LANGUAGE
PHapp AZ works in more than 50 languages.
YOU DECIDE WHAT REACHES YOU
Pick the places and topics you care about, and which of them send you notifications.
NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
You can read PHapp AZ and get notifications on this device without an account, an email address or a phone number. Sign in when you want to personalize it or add another way to reach you.
SHARE WITH ANYONE
Send any item by text, email or group chat. The person you send it to can open it on the web without installing anything or signing in.
PRIVACY
No ads. We don't sell your data or track you. Location is optional, and you can find your community by name or ZIP code instead.
WHERE THE INFORMATION COMES FROM
PHapp AZ is not a government app. Government agencies use PHapp AZ to share information, work with community partners and respond to the people they serve. Most of what you see comes from public agencies such as the National Weather Service (weather.gov), the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (cdc.gov), the Food and Drug Administration (fda.gov), the Department of Agriculture (usda.gov), and state, county and city agencies.
IMPORTANT
PHapp AZ is not an emergency service. It does not replace 911, Wireless Emergency Alerts (WEA), IPAWS or EAS, and we can't guarantee that every notification arrives. In an emergency, call 911.
WHO BUILDS IT
Hub Public Benefit Corp. builds and runs PHapp® AZ together with the University of Arizona, the Arizona Department of Health Services and the Government of Bermuda. Hub PBC is a NOAA Weather-Ready Nation Ambassador™.
Weather-Ready Nation (WRN) Ambassador™ and the WRN Ambassador™ logo are trademarks of the U.S. Department of Commerce and NOAA, used with permission.
Learn more at https://ph.app

bluejetty:00085810:ios.summary:
miMind is a fast, beautiful mind-mapping app for brainstorming, planning, studying and note-taking. Start with one idea, branch out in any direction — then present it, share it or export it anywhere.
MAKE IT LOOK THE WAY YOU THINK
• Dozens
bluejetty:00085810:ios.description:
miMind is a fast, beautiful mind-mapping app for brainstorming, planning, studying and note-taking. Start with one idea, branch out in any direction — then present it, share it or export it anywhere.
MAKE IT LOOK THE WAY YOU THINK
• Dozens of layout schemes — radial, tree, org chart, balanced — or place every node by hand
• Nearly 30 map themes and dozens of color schemas, plus custom palettes, backgrounds and shadows
• Node shapes: rounded rectangle, ellipse, diamond, hexagon, octagon, cloud, star, heart and more
• Connection styles: straight, curved, dashed or tapered, with arrows, labels and colors
• Animated connections — traveling dashes, pulses, glows, or an emoji riding along the line
NODES THAT HOLD MORE THAN TEXT
• Rich text — fonts, sizes, colors, alignment — plus long-form notes
• Images, animated GIFs, stickers and emoji, or sketch your own with the drawing tool
• Video and audio players; record a voice note straight into a node
• Data tables, pie charts, bar graphs and line graphs
• Checklists, check boxes, radio buttons and lists
• Real-world locations with an interactive map and address
• Hyperlinks that generate their own previews
• File and document attachments
• Calendar events and reminders on your device's calendar
• Links from one map to another
BUILT FOR REAL WORK
• Outline view — read and edit the whole map as a list
• Find text anywhere in a large map
• Multi-select editing to restyle many nodes at once
• Undo/redo, collapse/expand, copy/paste, duplicate, drag to re-attach
• Smooth zoom and pan, auto-save and a distraction-free View Mode
• Presentation mode to walk an audience through a map step by step
• Templates for starting new maps
• 28 languages
• No ads. No sign-up required to start.
YOUR MAPS, ON EVERY DEVICE
• iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows and Linux — and right in a browser at mimind.app
• One account keeps every map in sync, organized in folders
• Or keep them in iCloud, Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive
• Sign in with Google, Apple, Microsoft or Facebook
• Password-encrypt maps that hold sensitive information
IMPORT AND EXPORT ANYTHING
• Import: miMind, FreeMind (.mm), XMind, OPML, Markdown, XML, JSON, CSV
• Export: PNG, JPG, BMP, TGA, PDF, SVG, HTML, Word, Markdown, text outline, OPML, XML, JSON, CSV
• High-resolution exports, printing, email and share sheet
NEW — THE AI ASSISTANT
• Describe a topic and watch a complete map build itself, node by node
• Paste meeting notes, an article or a link and get it back as structure
• Chat with the map that's open — the assistant sees your nodes and the one you selected
• Ask for pictures, videos, tables, checklists or notes — the real content lands on the nodes, not links to it
• Ask "what am I missing?" and suggestions appear as ghost nodes you keep or drop
• One tap undoes an entire AI turn, however many nodes it touched
• Attach images, files and links to the conversation, and pick the model that fits the job
• Available with the miMind AI subscription
WHAT PEOPLE BUILD WITH IT
Study notes and flash cards. Project plans, roadmaps and meeting notes. Business plans, org charts and process flows. Decision trees, family trees and UML-style diagrams. Trip itineraries, budgets and to-do lists. Novel outlines, speeches and essays.
FREE TO START
Core mind mapping is free and ad-free. miMind Premium unlocks cloud sync across your devices, tables, locations, video and audio, attachments, encryption, presentation mode, every theme and high-definition exports. miMind AI adds the built-in AI assistant.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel anytime in your account settings.
Website: https://mimind.app
AI guide: https://mimind.app/docs-ai.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://mimind.cryptobees.com/terms.html
Privacy: https://mimind.cryptobees.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00080379:ios.name: De-Extinct: Jurassic Dinosaurs
bluejetty:00080379:ios.summary:
Get ready for this ultimate prehistorical adventure like no other!
The Ark Gene Group resurrected dinosaurs on a mysterious island in the distant sea and became the focus of the world.
But one day, we suddenly lost contact with the island.
bluejetty:00080379:ios.description:
Get ready for this ultimate prehistorical adventure like no other!
The Ark Gene Group resurrected dinosaurs on a mysterious island in the distant sea and became the focus of the world.
But one day, we suddenly lost contact with the island. And now it's your quest, as a Veteran, to lead an Elite Team of dinosaur experts and to begin an exhilarating journey.
Do you hear the distant roars of these dinosaurs, their thundering footsteps shaking the ground beneath you?
Are you ready to dig deeper, like an archaeologist unearthing dinosaur fossils, to reveal the truth of this lost island?
----------FEATURES----------
◆ REBUILD DINOSAUR PARK
Face the threats and challenges brought by the Ark Gene Group! Erect shelters for survivors, construct a variety of buildings for research and defense, and customize your Park with unique decorations. Lead the rebirth of a once-forgotten place into a vibrant Dinosaur Park. 
◆ RECRUIT DINOSAUR SQUAD
Search those survived on this island, scientists, mercenaries, tourists, and even dinosaur trainers. Recruit them and exploit their specialties to strengthen your squad, many of which can turn into splendid Dinoriders!
◆ ROAM THE ISLAND
Venture across the island's diverse biomes, where danger and discovery walk hand-in-hand. Gather crucial resources and encoutner unexpected events to fuel your survival. And lead the efforts to control, conserve, and contain wild dinosaurs now rampaging across this island.
◆ RESEARCH DINOSAUR ECOLOGY
Encounter over 100 species of awe-inspiring dinosaurs. Whether befriend a docile Triceratops, or capture and train a ferocious T-Rex, or study the genetic secrets and hatch a Psittacosaurus baby.
◆ ALLIES or ENEMIES
You are not the only one who set foot on this island, choose your allies wisely to fight alongside you. Watch out for the hidden threats, be they prehistoric beasts or rival adventurers.
----------FOLLOW US----------
Discord: https://discord.gg/hW4DTtzy3V
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/arcdinos/
Feel free to contact us via the in-game Customer Service or send us an Email at: jurassicgamehelp@gmail.com

bluejetty:00121412:ios.description:
FEATURES:
► Really fun and very simple!
► Place the phone on forehead, explain and guess the words 
► Correct answer - tilt the phone screen down, pass - tilt the phone screen up
► Huge database of words – over 41 000!
► 45 interesting decks: guess celebrities, movies, music, books and lots more
► Add your own words to the game
► Different modes: explain using words, show with gestures, draw on paper
► Add new players or teams
► Choose time for answer: 30, 60, 90 or 120 seconds
► Change the game result if necessary
► Suitable for kids and adults
► No Ads & in-Apps
GAME RULES
- Place your phone on forehead. Other players should explain to you the word on the screen
- If you guessed the word, tilt the phone screen down
- If you don’t know the answer, tilt the phone screen up to go to the next word
GAME MODE
Words can be explained in different ways, depending on the selected game mode:
- Words: explain using other words
- Gestures: explain using gestures without words – show pantomime 
- Drawing: explain using drawing on a paper
- One word: explain using just one word
- Backwards: read word backwards
- Random: random selection of any mode
45 INTERESTING DECKS
Start set, Kids, Mix set, Act it out, Animals, All words, Easy words, Brainstorm, Family, Celebrities, Movies and TV, Cartoons, Travel, Meal and food, Sport, Literature, Art, Music, Science, Phrases, Trends, Brands, Nature, House, Professions, School, Hobbies, Act it out - Hard, Celebrities - Hard, Movies & TV - Hard, Literature - Hard, Music - Hard, Sport - Hard, Art - Hard, Science - Hard, Travel - Hard, Transport, Inventions, Technology, Men, Women, Person, Summertime, New Year, Clothes
ADD YOUR OWN WORDS
You can add your own words to the game
ADD NEW PLAYERS OR TEAMS
You can add new players. Last result, total score and games are shown for each player. Click on a player's name to change it – from 1 to 14 symbols. 
NO ADS & Subscriptions
App contains NO Ads and Subscriptions. 
Have a nice game!

bluejetty:00157800:ios.description:
AllEars: English Listening Trainer – Learn English Smarter
AllEars is an advanced audio and video player designed for language learners.
Practice English listening, shadowing, pronunciation, dictation, and speaking with powerful features including automatic sentence segmentation, subtitle generation, A-B repeat, recording comparison, and high-quality variable-speed playback.
Whether you’re preparing for IELTS, TOEFL, TOEIC, Cambridge English exams, studying podcasts, online courses, speeches, audiobooks, or YouTube lessons, English Listening Trainer helps you learn faster and more efficiently.
---------
Key Features
Automatic Sentence Segmentation
Turn long audio into sentence-by-sentence lessons.
• Automatically split audio into individual sentences
• Generate subtitles from speech
• Translate subtitles
• Save important sentences for later review
Perfect for intensive listening practice.
---------
A-B Repeat & Shadowing
Repeat difficult sentences as many times as you need.
• Unlimited A-B repeat
• Custom repeat count
• Adjustable pause between repeats
• Loop any part of the audio
Ideal for:
• English listening
• Shadowing practice
• Accent reduction
• Pronunciation improvement
---------
Record & Compare
Practice speaking by recording your voice and comparing it with the original audio.
Listen to your pronunciation immediately after each recording and improve your fluency naturally.
Great for:
• Speaking practice
• Pronunciation training
• Accent imitation
• Public speaking
---------
Variable Speed Playback
Play audio from 0.1x to 5.0x speed without changing pitch.
Perfect for:
• Slow listening
• Intensive listening
• Fast review
• Podcast learning
---------
Waveform Navigation
Jump to any sentence instantly with an interactive waveform.
• Precise A-B selection
• Visual editing
• Quick navigation
• Easy sentence review
---------
Dictation Practice
Generate audio clips for dictation exercises.
Improve:
• Listening accuracy
• Vocabulary recognition
• Sentence comprehension
---------
Import Your Learning Materials
Import audio and video from multiple sources.
Supports:
• Files app
• iCloud Drive
• Wi-Fi Transfer
• iTunes File Sharing
• Local audio & video files
Organize everything into folders for easier learning.
---------
Audio Learning Tools
More than just a player.
Features include:
• Audio clipping
• Export selected segments
• MP3 export
• Bookmark important moments
• Save favorite sentences
---------
Built for Every Learner
Perfect for:
• English learners
• IELTS preparation
• TOEFL preparation
• TOEIC preparation
• Cambridge English exams
• Podcast listeners
• Online course students
• Teachers
• Interpreters
• Voice actors
• Public speakers
---------
Why You’ll Love It
• No ads
• Clean and simple interface
• Dark Mode
• Sleep Timer
• Lightweight and battery friendly
• Stable and fast
• Designed for long study sessions
---------
Membership Subscription Information
1. Monthly Plan
Subscription period: 1 month
2. Annual Plan
Subscription period: 12 months
3. Other Rules
Payment: Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account when you confirm the purchase.
Renewal: Your Apple iTunes account will be charged within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period. After the charge is successfully processed, the subscription period will be extended by one subscription period.
Cancellation: To cancel auto-renewal, you must do so at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Steps: go to the Home screen, open Settings > iTunes & App Store > tap Apple ID, select View Apple ID > Account Settings > tap Subscriptions, select the subscription, then tap Cancel Subscription.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
---------
Practice smarter.
Listen better.
Speak with confidence.

bluejetty:00058991:android.description:
In Supermarket Game, players become the boss and manage their own supermarket. Responsibilities include running the checkout, keeping track of items, restocking shelves, and helping customers. The goal is to keep everything organized and make sure everyone is satisfied.
Manage Your Supermarket
As the boss, you’ll:
- Use the checkout to ring up purchases.
- Ensure there’s enough stock on the shelves.
- Refill shelves with fresh items and toys.
- Answer customer questions and assist them in finding products.
- Visit the ATM if more money is needed.
- Learn and Have Fun
This game is both enjoyable and educational! It helps players develop skills in organization, time management, and problem-solving. Learn how to run a successful supermarket and provide great service to customers.
Real-Life Experience
Experience what it’s like to manage a busy supermarket! Handle the checkout and keep shelves well-stocked. It’s a fun way to practice being in charge and making sure everything runs smoothly.
3D Adventure
Explore a colorful 3D supermarket that feels real! Walk through different sections, like groceries and toys, with vibrant graphics and lively sounds.
Become the Top Boss
Show off your skills to be the best supermarket manager! Keep everything neat, handle sales efficiently, and ensure customer satisfaction. The more you play, the better you get at running your store!

bluejetty:00069238:ios.description:
Consulte a Classificação Internacional de Atenção Primária (CIAP-2) com rapidez, mesmo sem internet. O CIAP2 foi desenvolvido para profissionais e estudantes que precisam localizar códigos, capítulos e classificações durante a rotina de atenção primária à saúde.
RECURSOS PRINCIPAIS
• Busca por código, termo ou descrição
• Pesquisa por voz opcional
• Navegação por capítulos e classificações
• Favoritos para acesso rápido
• Relações com códigos CID-10 quando disponíveis
• Consulta offline
• Integração com Siri, Atalhos e Spotlight
• Widget para acesso rápido
• Fonte Lexend e suporte ao Tamanho Dinâmico do iOS
• Compatibilidade com VoiceOver e Reduzir Movimento
FEITO PARA A ATENÇÃO PRIMÁRIA
A CIAP-2 permite organizar motivos de consulta, problemas de saúde, diagnósticos, intervenções e procedimentos por episódio de cuidado. O aplicativo facilita a consulta da classificação por médicos, profissionais de enfermagem, equipes de saúde da família, estudantes, gestores e pesquisadores.
PRIVACIDADE
O CIAP2 não exige cadastro e não contém publicidade ou SDK de analytics. Favoritos e histórico permanecem no dispositivo ou, quando habilitado pelo usuário, em sua conta iCloud. A busca por voz é opcional e utiliza os recursos de reconhecimento de fala do sistema. Consulte a política de privacidade para todos os detalhes.
A classificação é uma ferramenta de referência e não substitui avaliação, julgamento clínico ou protocolos profissionais.

bluejetty:00148041:ios.description:
MYDAWA is Kenya’s original Online Pharmacy for Affordable and Genuine Medicine, fully licensed and regulated by the Pharmacy & Poisons Board Kenya.
MYDAWA, founded on the premise of Live Well, Stay Well and Get Well, is here to ensure that every Kenyan can get quality, secure and affordable medicine and wellness products online.
The long tiring trips of moving from chemist to chemist in search of prescription medicine is over; no more waiting in line! At MYDAWA, we offer a wide range of quality prescription medicine, over the counter medicine and supplements that are ideal for you and your family at affordable prices. Refill your prescription online by uploading your prescription to this App and have it all delivered directly to you in less than 4 hours by our pharmaceutical technologists, 8am to 8pm, 365 days a year.
MYDAWA is uniquely suited to delivering safe, authentic, essential medication and other health or sanitary care services to the more vulnerable in the community who may be concerned about visiting crowded pharmacies at this time. Those trying to manage chronic conditions or those making family planning decisions may not always be able to make the correct choices because they cannot, or do not want to, venture out to the pharmacy or clinic so MYDAWA is a lifeline for them.
With MYDAWA, you are assured of convenience, quality, affordability and great service while purchasing your medicine online. Convenience, in that we guarantee that you won’t have to look elsewhere when filling in your prescription, because we are the one-stop only chemist. Whether you are purchasing medication for yourself, your children or even for your parents up-country, you can rely on MYDAWA to provide you with safe, genuine products where you can authenticate every products, delivered conveniently at the BEST PRICE.
For your safety, products that require a doctor’s prescription are clearly marked and can only be dispensed with a valid prescription. If you require prescription only medication, attach a photo or scan of the prescription. Enter any other information or special instructions you may need to specify. We will deliver your prescription products with our qualified pharmaceutical technologists
You have the assurance of genuine quality products all the time. For your peace of mind, each of our products is secured with a tamper proof security seal. To authenticate MYDAWA products, simply scratch the panel on the security seal, to reveal a unique code and enter it on the app.
In addition to our medication we have a wide range of personal care products including, dietary supplements and multivitamins, medical devices, hygiene products, beauty and skincare and lots more. Health, wellness and beauty live on MYDAWA! Access your favourite Dr. Organics, Shea Moisture, Neutrogena, Pella Dead Sea Minerals, and more with just the click of a button. Not forgetting your favourite baby products, Aveeno, Pampers, Scott's emulsion, Dettol soap, Dettol hand wash and other wellness products to keep your whole family healthy.
We offer dedicated support. If you need to speak to our qualified pharmacy team or have any service questions we are always on hand. You can chat, email support@mydawa.com and we’ll be happy to assist.
Get started and mPower your Health

DLOOK — formerly known as Dressy — is your AI outfit maker and virtual try on assistant that helps you discover, create, and organize your perfect style. Try on anything you want, manage your clothes, build your digital wardrobe, and transform everyday outfit ideas into looks that match your personality.
What DLOOK Can Do for You
AI Clothes Changer & Virtual Outfit Try On
Found a dress, a honeymoon outfit, or an outfit you love while scrolling online? Simply upload a screenshot or photo and instantly see how it looks on you before making a purchase. With AI clothes changer and virtual outfit try on, you can explore different styles, create new outfit combinations, and find looks that fit your vibe without the stress of buying the wrong clothes.
Upload your photo and let DLOOK's AI outfit maker help you try on millions of outfit ideas in seconds. Experiment with different styles, discover new fashion inspiration, and create personalized looks designed around your unique appearance.
Search for any brand, clothing item, or fashion style and instantly try on your selections. Whether you're exploring luxury fashion, everyday outfits, or trending styles, DLOOK helps you visualize your next look before you wear it.
From wedding dresses and elegant dresses to old money women's style, honeymoon outfits, minimalist outfits, and classic jeans outfits, DLOOK lets you explore endless outfit possibilities and discover the styles that make you feel confident.
Whether you're shopping online, preparing for a special event, or planning your next seasonal wardrobe, DLOOK's AI clothes changer and outfit planner help you try on different looks, find your ideal style, and build confidence before you step out.
Save money by avoiding clothes that don't match your style. Most importantly, enjoy creating outfit ideas, experimenting with fashion, and discovering your look your way.
AI Color Analysis & Personalized Outfit Styling
Discover the colors and styles that suit you best with DLOOK's smart fashion analysis. Our AI outfit styling system helps you visualize outfits in shades that complement your skin tone.
Create more personalized outfit combinations with AI-powered recommendations and discover fashion choices that match your natural style.
Your Digital Closet, Reimagined
Upload your clothes directly into your personal digital wardrobe. DLOOK automatically removes backgrounds and identifies each clothing item with smart tags.
With DLOOK's outfit maker and virtual try on features, you can plan outfits for every occasion — from work meetings and casual weekends to date-free elegant evenings, weddings, vacations, and honeymoon trips.
DLOOK's smart outfit planner lets you save, edit, and recreate your favorite outfit ideas, so your best looks are always ready whenever you need inspiration.
Why You'll Like DLOOK — Your AI Outfit Maker
Create unlimited outfit ideas with AI-powered styling.
Virtually try on clothes before shopping and make smarter fashion choices.
Rediscover hidden pieces in your closet and create fresh outfit combinations.
Plan daily outfits, wedding looks, vacation styles, and seasonal fashion ideas.
Start creating your perfect outfit today with DLOOK — the AI outfit maker and virtual try on app that helps you visualize your dream style.
We offer weekly and monthly subscription plans. Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase. You can manage app subscriptions in your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication. There is no lock-in contract.
Terms of Use: https://www.dlook.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.dlook.app/privacy

bluejetty:00162023:ios.name: AFit Health
bluejetty:00162023:ios.summary:
Smart and easy-to-use body management APP, with Bluetooth smart health scale to assist you in body management, weighing, scientific analysis of body data, recording and management.
1. 18 items of body data, comprehensive analysis of health
bluejetty:00162023:ios.description:
Smart and easy-to-use body management APP, with Bluetooth smart health scale to assist you in body management, weighing, scientific analysis of body data, recording and management.
1. 18 items of body data, comprehensive analysis of health data
Using BIA bio-resistance technology to calculate 18 items of body data including BMI, body fat rate, muscle rate, water, bone weight, basal metabolic rate, protein rate, etc., with the help of scientific formula calculations based on body weight and fixed body data (age, height), Help you manage your body. You can manage your weight, BMI, body fat rate, protein rate and many other parameters to take care of your health in an all-round way.
2. Create multiple users to care for family health
One mobile phone can add multiple family members, the system intelligently identifies different users, accurately records data, and enjoys the whole family with one scale.
3. Multi-dimensional historical data records, intimate physical management
Good Body provides daily data records, weekly data records, monthly data records, and annual data records, four recording methods to help you better understand physical history data. Provide data sharing on multiple platforms, share your good figure journey with good friends, multiple sharing modes, multiple sharing platforms, so much fun!
Camera permissions:
Good figure will ask the camera permission to take photos in order to set the avatar
Access Health App (HealthKit)
 Since personal health data is a private privacy issue, we will prompt on the page in the APP menu and request authorization to write health information to us.
Apple Health Entrance: Me - Sync health report
