bluejetty:00177862:ios.description:
Digital Clock turns your iPhone, iPad, and Mac into a crisp retro LED display — the glow of a classic bedside or desk clock, right on your screen.
Prop it up on your nightstand, desk, or home-office shelf and read the time at a glance, day or night.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Choose from several LED and LCD display styles
• Show the time in 12- or 24-hour format, with optional seconds, weekday, and date
• Add a blinking colon for that authentic digital-clock feel
• Keep it in portrait or landscape, or lock it to the orientation you prefer
• Dim the screen with a swipe for a gentle, glare-free glow at night
• The display stays awake, so the clock is always there when you glance over
TIMER & ALARMS
• Set alarms to wake up or stay on schedule
• Countdown timer, stopwatch, and a Pomodoro mode with work and break intervals
• Pick your own alarm sound
WIDGETS
• Add Digital Clock to your Home Screen and Lock Screen
DIGITAL CLOCK PRO
Make it truly yours with a one-time upgrade:
• Set custom digit and background colors
• Use your own photo as the background
• See the track currently playing in the Music app
• Display any time zone in the world
However you like to keep time — a stylish desk clock, a calm bedside companion, or a focus timer for work — Digital Clock has you covered.

Make friends, ask questions, and access campus resources at any time!

+ DEADLINES: Stay on top of multiple deadlines with push-notifications, students receive reminders, alerts and critical notifications.
+ CLASSES: Manage classes, create to-dos & reminders, and stay on top of assignments. 
+ EVENTS: Discover campus events, set reminders, and track your attendance
+ FEATURED ACTIVITIES: Orientation, Homecoming, etc.
+ CAMPUS COMMUNITY: Meet friends, ask questions, and keep up with what's happening on the campus wall.
+ GROUPS & CLUBS: Get involved with campus organizations and meet people with similar interests
+ CAMPUS SERVICES: Learn about services offered, such as Academic Advising, Financial Aid & Counselling.
+ PUSH NOTIFICATIONS: Receive important campus notifications and emergency alerts.
+ CAMPUS MAP: Find the quickest route to classes, events, and offices.

bluejetty:00141812:ios.description:
A New Kind of Bubble Shooter!
Bubble Busters revolutionizes the classic bubble shooter experience with exciting real-time battles against players from around the globe. Strategize every move on a shared game board to outsmart your opponent and claim victory!
Level Up Your Characters! 
Introducing our brand-new level-up mechanism! Earn XP by completing matches, leveling up your character, and unlocking powerful upgrades and stats that gives you a sense of RGP!
Endless Game Modes and Characters! 
Bubble Busters offers a variety of game modes and 3D characters that challenge your strategy, speed, and skill. There's always a fresh way to play and win!
Be the BEST in the World!
Compete with real-people, in real-time, climb the leagues and ranks to reach the top. Challenge players to a PVP match worldwide and prove you’re the ultimate Bubble Buster!
Endless Content and Fun with NO ADS! 
From exhilarating PvP battles to tons of handcrafted levels, Bubble Busters delivers endless hours of fun and excitement with Live events, tournaments and daily missions. Challenge your friends or family, whether you’re a casual gamer or a fierce RPG player, there’s always a new challenge waiting.
Please note! Bubble Busters is free to download and free to play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money. If you don't want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.

bluejetty:00014661:ios.description:
Start texting and calling on your new private line. Built for people looking for privacy, a local number, and separation between personal and public life.

Add private video calling, call recording, voicemail, local area codes, and much more

CALL RECORDING: Start recording on any line and

VIDEO CALLS: Start video calls when selling online with a one-time link. Great for online selling or sharing a real estate property tour. 
PROTECT YOUR PRIVACY: Do you trust loyalty programs to not sell your number? You shouldn’t. Receive verification codes (2FA) and promotional messages for your favorite brands with a private second line.
BLOCK CALLS: If you're done with your temporary line, or someone is bothering you, simply delete it and grab a new one. No trip to the store, questions from the salesperson, one click, and you're done.

SELLING ONLINE: Keep your cell phone off public listings by texting buyers from a second line you can silence or replace.

FREE INBOUND TEXTS & CALLING: Inbound calls and texts are always free.
TRANSPARENT PRICING: Subscriptions unlock 3,000 text messages and calls a month. (counted daily)

IMPORTANT: Emergency calls and texts to 911 are not supported. Texts to/from short codes might not always be supported. The trial may include free usage and is intended for one-time use.

bluejetty:00173531:ios.description:
Fall asleep faster with calming sleep sounds.
Can't sleep? Pick a sound, set the timer, and let your room go quiet. Sleep
Sounds turns your phone or iPad into a bedside sound machine, with rain, fans,
ocean waves, thunderstorms and more to mask the noise that keeps you awake.
Whether you're dealing with a restless mind, a snoring partner, thin apartment
walls or a baby who only settles to white noise, one steady sound is usually all
it takes.
36 SOUNDS TO SLEEP TO
Rain and water: light rain, heavy rain, thunderstorm, ocean waves, waterfalls,
a running tap, dripping water, a sprinkler, a shower, underwater.
Fans and machines: a table fan, an air conditioner, a clothes dryer, a hair
dryer, a vacuum, a train, airplane cabin.
Nature and night: crickets, frogs, a campfire, forest at night, jungle, Amazon
rainforest, birds, tropical birds, whales, wind, wind chimes.
Around the house: two ticking clocks, a city street, distant city noise, a
crowded room, a lullaby, a piano, a metronome.
Every sound loops seamlessly, so there is no gap or click to jolt you awake.
SLEEP TIMER THAT FADES OUT
Choose how long a sound should play. It fades out gently at the end instead of
stopping dead, so it never wakes the person it just helped fall asleep.
BUILD YOUR NIGHT IN STAGES
Playlists let you line up sounds one after another with a length for each. Start
with light rain for thirty minutes while you drift off, roll into a thunderstorm
for twenty, then hold a table fan until morning.
A GENTLE WAKE-UP
Set an alarm that eases you awake with a sound instead of a jarring buzz.
BEDSIDE CLOCK
A full-screen night clock, dimmed for a dark room, with your next alarm shown
underneath. Leave your phone on the nightstand and it becomes a bedside clock.
PLAYS WITH THE SCREEN OFF
Lock your phone and the sound keeps going all night. Volume, favourites and the
sleep timer all stay one tap away.
Download Sleep Sounds and get a proper night's sleep tonight.
This app offers an optional subscription. You can use it without one.
Terms of Use: https://ellisapps.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://ellisapps.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00016454:ios.description:
Get 'Em is an action packed, first of its kind, open world free-roaming video game! Play as superhero crime fighting dogs, on a mission to track down the city's most ruthless gangster, save their dognapped friend, and restore their city back to its glory days.
After Leila, a helpless Yorkie is dognapped, three best friends come together to find out what happened. You can start the game by picking one of 3 characters. Are you going to be Pump, the resilient Doberman, Bentley, the fierce Chihuahua, or Marley, the kind Beagle? As you accomplish more missions and get closer to tracking down the city's mob boss, you meet and unlock more friends along the way! Not only can you play as different dogs, but you can customize outfits, and enhance their powers! 
You have never played a game like this before! Get 'Em is fully indie-made, and will feature many different styles of gameplay! Have you ever wanted to be an animal, in a big city? Have you ever wanted the ability to play "inside" a 3D cartoon or comic book, like a video game? If you like first person games, guitarhero-style games, third person games, infinite runner games, top-down games, and open world games, Get 'Em is for you!

bluejetty:00145650:ios.description:
Dive into the vibrant world of creativity with Retrica Packs, the ultimate photo editing and expression community!
Discover endless possibilities as you unleash your imagination and transform ordinary photos into extraordinary works of art. With Retrica Packs, the power to create stunning visuals is right at your fingertips. Let's embark on a journey of self-expression and creativity together!
Here's what makes Retrica Packs stand out:
* Edit: Bring your photos to life with our all-inclusive editing tools. From basic adjustments like brightness and contrast to advanced features like curves and the ability to remove backgrounds, our intuitive tools empower you to bring your vision to life with ease. You'll always know exactly how your edits will turn out with our real-time previews, guaranteeing the perfect look every time.
* Stickerize: Discover new forms of self-expression with our wide range of stickers and emojis. Our extensive library is just the beginning – you can also create your own sticker packs, whether you're looking to add a playful touch with cute animals, bring some humor with funny memes, or express your emotions with heartfelt quotes. Get creative and personalize your photos by mixing and matching stickers to create one-of-a-kind compositions that truly reflect your personality and style.
* Share: Share your unique creations with the world by crafting and sharing your very own sticker packs. Whether you're curating a collection of your favorite stickers or teaming up with friends to create themed packs, Retrica Packs makes it easy to spread joy and laughter to your loved ones and beyond.
*  Discover: Explore a variety of new stickers and emojis every day at Retrica Packs. Engage with other users' sticker packs to find inspiration and enhance your photos and videos with their creations. From various sticker packs created by others to the option of creating your own, there's always something new to explore and be inspired by. Come join our lively community of creators and collectors, where inspiration is always in the air. Dive into other users' sticker packs to fuel your creativity and design your very own unique collection. Let's build a culture of sharing and collaboration, where every scroll opens up new possibilities for expression and connection.
Here at Retrica Packs, we're not just another photo editing app – we're a community of creators, dreamers, and storytellers. Our goal is simple: to inspire and empower you to express yourself boldly and creatively. Whether you're a seasoned artist or just starting out, Retrica Packs is here to be your canvas for self-expression.
Download Retrica Packs now and unlock your creative potential today!

bluejetty:00094745:ios.summary: "Triangle Merge: Happy Game" is a creative puzzle-synthesis game centered around triangular shapes, blending classic falling-block elimination mechanics with strategic merging gameplay. Players move falling triangular blocks to merge triang
bluejetty:00094745:ios.description:
"Triangle Merge: Happy Game" is a creative puzzle-synthesis game centered around triangular shapes, blending classic falling-block elimination mechanics with strategic merging gameplay. Players move falling triangular blocks to merge triangles with the same numbers into larger ones, challenging for high scores and breaking limits! The game features a lively rhythm and fresh visuals, making it suitable for players of all ages to enjoy stress-relieving fun anytime, anywhere.
Core Gameplay:
* Triangular blocks randomly fall from the top of the screen, and players can swipe left or right to adjust their positions.
* Precise operation is the key to achieving high scores through synthesis!
* Number Synthesis: When numbered triangles (e.g., 1, 2, 3) come into contact, their numbers are added together.
Minimalistic Controls, Easy to Start: Play with a single-hand swipe + tap, diving into mental challenges anytime, anywhere.

"Triangle Merge: Happy Game" is a creative puzzle-synthesis game centered around triangular shapes, blending classic falling-block elimination mechanics with strategic merging gameplay. Players move falling triangular blocks to merge triangles with the same numbers into larger ones, challenging for high scores and breaking limits! The game features a lively rhythm and fresh visuals, making it suitable for players of all ages to enjoy stress-relieving fun anytime, anywhere.
Core Gameplay:
* Triangular blocks randomly fall from the top of the screen, and players can swipe left or right to adjust their positions.
* Precise operation is the key to achieving high scores through synthesis!
* Number Synthesis: When numbered triangles (e.g., 1, 2, 3) come into contact, their numbers are added together.

Minimalistic Controls, Easy to Start: Play with a single-hand swipe + tap, diving into mental challenges anytime, anywhere.

bluejetty:00022402:ios.name: Aquarium Camera
bluejetty:00022402:ios.summary:
Aquarium Camera is built specifically for aquarium owners who are tired of their tank looking incredible in person and disappointing on their phone.
LED aquarium lights are brilliant, but blue actinic lighting interferes with camera sensor
bluejetty:00022402:ios.description:
Aquarium Camera is built specifically for aquarium owners who are tired of their tank looking incredible in person and disappointing on their phone.
LED aquarium lights are brilliant, but blue actinic lighting interferes with camera sensors, shifting the colors of your fish, plants, and corals into something far less accurate. Standard camera apps were not made for this. Aquarium Camera was.
Designed for reef tanks, planted tanks, freshwater aquariums, and fish-only setups, Aquarium Camera helps you capture photos and videos that better reflect what your tank actually looks like.
“The Aquarium Camera app is an essential tool for reef tank photography.”
– ReefBuilders.com
You can stop buying pro camera rigs, shooting in RAW, using clip-on filters or gels, and turning off your blue lights just to get a decent shot. You do not need to spend hours in editing apps adjusting hue, tint, and exposure after the fact. Aquarium Camera helps you color-correct aquarium lighting in real time on your iPhone or iPad, using the device you already carry every day.
Watch your aquarium grow with Time-lapse projects. Capture photos or short videos over repeat visits, use a reference image and alignment markers to keep a consistent view, and compare your progress. Turn your captures into a video with straight cuts or smooth crossfades. Growth projects are stored on your device.
Features:
• Automatic color correction with the familiar original controls
• Adjustable manual gel color and intensity
• Real-time tint, temperature, RGB, and exposure adjustment
• Full-resolution photo capture
• 4K video recording
• Time-lapse projects for repeat photos and video clips
• Reference overlays and adjustable alignment markers
• First-and-latest comparisons and video export with optional crossfades
• Syncs with iCloud
• Support for your device’s available camera lenses, including wide, standard, and telephoto
• Save and share presets once you dial in your tank
• Side-by-side preview to help fine-tune color balance
• Portrait and landscape support
• Touch to focus
• Flash toggle
• Grid toggle
• Quick access to your aquarium gallery with export or autosave to library
• Share photos and videos right from the library
• Volume button shutter support
• Haptic feedback
• No subscription: buy it once and unlock everything on iPhone and iPad
“So easy to use… Love it!!! And the color changing is realtime so you can see the screen and the real thing side by side to ensure you get the right balance.”
– Carlos Chacon, CoralVue
I created Aquarium Camera because I was tired of seeing brilliant aquariums online that did not truly represent the health, color, and beauty of the fish, plants, and corals inside. As LED lighting took over the hobby, aquarium photography became harder. Aquarium Camera is my answer to that problem.
Spend less time correcting aquarium photos and videos, and more time enjoying your tank... oh and doing water changes.

QLDTraffic is the official source of live traffic and travel information from the Queensland Government. It lets you check traffic conditions and plan your journey before you drive.
Managed by the Department of Transport and Main Roads, Q
bluejetty:00163397:ios.description:
QLDTraffic is the official source of live traffic and travel information from the Queensland Government. It lets you check traffic conditions and plan your journey before you drive.
Managed by the Department of Transport and Main Roads, QLDTraffic provides information on road conditions throughout Queensland, including crashes and hazards, road closures and restrictions, roadworks and special events. The app also provides access to web cameras that relay near real-time traffic imagery.
Add your favourite routes to the app, like the trip to the office or a car journey to school, and QLDTraffic will inform you of traffic issues on the way. It’ll even send you personalised push notifications if something happens on your favourite routes, so that you’ll know before you go.
FEATURES
· Save favourite routes and places to receive personalised traffic alerts as push notifications
· See live traffic alerts and events on a map
· Filter traffic alerts to see:
 o What’s happening on your routes or around your current location
 o Incidents near your calendar events (if you’ve set a location for the event)
 o Crashes, flooding, and hazards
 o Road closures and restrictions
 o Roadworks and special events
 o Traffic flow and congestion
 o Traffic web cameras
· Add a route by searching for a way to drive
· Use travel mode while you’re on the move to get live traffic alerts throughout your journey
 o Travel mode includes audio announcements, so you can continue to pay attention to the road.
· Add custom routes by recording your trip in travel mode
Please note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

If
bluejetty:00121452:ios.description:
Simple rule: complete the grid accordingly with colors and discover the picture that hides beneath. Sounds easy? Not really! Each level is a real brain-teaser in which you will have to use logic and ingeniosity to complete larger paints.
If you like to challenge your mind with Sudoku and Logigrams then this addictive game is definitely for you!
Include:
1000+ grids
Large weekly paint every… Tuesday! (contains 9 grids)
Cloud save and cross platform support
Many cats to customize and share with your friends
A weekly updated customization shop
SUPPORT & FEEDBACK
Please contact support@tuesdayquest.com for any issue or feedback, we'd love to hear from you!
Follow @TuesdayQuest on Twitter for the latest development updates, news & tips: http://twitter.com/TuesdayQuest
You can also reach us on Facebook: http://facebook.com/tuesdayquest
Want to know more, get tips and latest news on Hungry Cat Nonogram? Follow us on facebook
What’s new?
More content, more frequently
We can now add directly to your application new paints without having to go through the whole update process. Meaning, sometimes when coming back to the game you’ll see new content to play with whereas you haven’t updated the app. This feature will improve our ability to add new levels more often because it will reduce our development time. Cool meoooow ? 
Customize your app
If you regularly play to Hungry Cat Picross, we thought you might want to set the game at your own tastes… now you can change the cat and many other accessories, you can even change the whole game colorset to fit your mood. Your cat will appear in the weekly leaderboards.
Cloud Save and Tuesday Leaderboards
Now you can log in any accounts (Facebook or Twitter) or even create a Tuesday Quest one. Once connected, your progress is stored on servers and can be played from any devices. Being logged makes you eligible to the Tuesday Paint Leaderboard too, which is updated every week.
Creating an account is facultative! And yes, you still don’t need an internet connection to play!
To celebrate all those brand new features, we’ve added a new type of paint type: Frescoes.
And there’s more!
- Undo function
- Color blind support
- No more ad banners
- Catch Coin gameplay
- Weekly shop
- Cat interaction
- Statistics
- Tuesday Grids description

[PASS 소개]
본인확인, PASS인증서, 모바일신분증 등 인증 서비스와 신용, 금융, 주식, 부동산, 투자, 건강, 생활정보 및 휴대폰결제 서비스를 제공합니다.
[주요 기능]
본인확인 : 문자 및 PASS앱 본인확인, 인증내역 제공
PASS인증서 : 정부24, 국세청 홈택스 등 다양한 사용처에서 안전하고 간편한 인증
주민등록증/운전면허증 : 실물 신분증과 동일한 법적 효력으로 편리하게 사용
신분증결제 : 신분증과 카드를 등록하고, 성인인증과 결제를 한번에 진행
한번에안심 : 피싱·명의도용 등 금융사기에 대한 사전 탐지부터 피해보상까지
스마트티켓 : 국내선 공항 출입 시 항공권과 신분증 검증을 동시에
반려동물확인증 : 동물등록번호, 이름, 성별, 품종, 중성화 여부 등 반려동물의 정보 확인
PASS지갑 : 정부 전자문서 및 각종 자격증명 발급, 국민비서 알림, 개인 간 증명서 발급
휴대폰결제 : 휴대폰결제 이용내역, 할인 혜택 조회, 한도 조회 및 변경, 콘텐츠 이용료(DCB) 한도 조회 및 변경
금융혜택 : 대출, 카드, 보험, 재테크까지 다양한 금융상품 정보 및 혜택
스팸 필터링 : 스팸 문자 차단 관리, 차단 번호 및 키워드 추천
그외 신용 및 주식 투자 등 유용한 정보와 혜택을 제공하는 다양한 서비스 제공
[서비스 대상]
- SK텔레콤 이용 고객
※ 본인 명의의 휴대폰에서만 가입 및 이용이 가능합니다.
※ 알뜰폰, 법인폰 고객도 이용 가능합니다. (법인폰의 경우 대리점, 114를 통해 실사용자 등록 후 가능)
※ 만 14세 미만은 SK텔레콤에 등록된 법정대리인 동의 후 가능합니다.
※ 만 14세 미만은 인증서, 명의도용방지 이용이 불가능합니다.
[필수 접근 권한]
- 전화 : 사용자 확인 및 인증을 위해 전화번호를 수집 및 이용합니다.
- 알림 : 본인확인, 인증서비스에 필요합니다.
※ 미동의 시 서비스 가입 및 이용이 제한됩니다. 
[선택 접근 권한]
- 카메라 : QR인증, 사진 촬영 시 사용됩니다.
- 위치정보 : 모바일신분증 이용 시 사용됩니다.
- 연락처 : 모바일지갑, 스팸필터링 서비스 이용 시 사용됩니다.
※ 선택 접근 권한은 미동의 시에도 서비스 이용이 가능합니다.
[이용안내]
- 지원 버전 : AOS 8, iOS 15 이상
- 앱 이용이 불가능한 상태에서 PASS 해지 요청은 pass@sk.com으로 메일 부탁드립니다.
- PASS by SK telecom은 SK텔레콤에서 제공하는 무료 서비스입니다. (요금제에 따른 데이터 통화료가 부과될 수 있습니다.)
- 휴대폰 사용 환경을 임의로 변경할 경우(탈옥, 해킹 및 기타), 본 서비스는 동작하지 않을 수 있습니다.
- 서비스 이용 문의 : 휴대폰 114 / 이메일 : pass@sk.com
개발자 연락처 :
SK telecom : +82 1599 0011

bluejetty:00183854:ios.description:
Money Converter + is an iPhone app that lets travelers convert currencies, calculate tips, and track expenses offline while traveling internationally. 
Use the Apple Watch app to convert amounts, and track exchange rates and trip expenses with watch widgets.
Whether you’re traveling abroad, calculating tips at a restaurant, or tracking spending across currencies, Money Converter + gives you everything you need — even when you’re offline.
Use Money Converter + to:
• Convert between 150+ world currencies with up-to-date exchange rates
• Automatically detect the local currency when you travel
• Calculate tips and discounts in foreign currencies
• Track travel expenses and spending by trip
• Quickly access your favorite currencies
• Use the app fully offline when data is unavailable
DESIGNED FOR INTERNATIONAL TRAVEL
Money Converter + recognizes over 240 countries and is designed for people who travel frequently, backpack, or move between countries. Exchange rates are updated regularly, and the app remains usable even without an internet connection.
PRACTICAL TRAVEL TOOLS
• Built-in tip and discount calculator
• Expense tracking across multiple currencies
• Home screen widgets to quickly track trip expenses or exchange rates
• Apple Watch app for quick conversions
• Apple Watch widgets to track exchange rates and trip expenses
PREMIUM FEATURES
• Unlimited expense tracking
• Custom exchange rates
• Exchange fee support
• Three-way currency conversion
If you are looking for a lightweight, offline-capable currency converter that also helps with tips and travel expenses, Money Converter + is built for you.

bluejetty:00036617:ios.description:
Decibel Meter App can transform your iPhone into the most precise Noise Level Meter app! This advanced Sound Level Meter app is the perfect tool for anyone needing to measure noise levels accurately. Whether you're a sound professional, a safety monitor, or just curious about the noise in your environment, our Decibel Meter ensures you get reliable results every time.
With cutting-edge features and a user-friendly interface, this Decibel Meter app is your go-to solution for all noise measurement needs. It’s not just a Decibel Meter—it’s also a powerful Sound Meter, Sound Level Meter, and Noise Meter, delivering unparalleled accuracy and insights.
Why Use the Decibel Meter App?
The Decibel Meter app is designed to provide precise sound measurement in real time. Its advanced technology and functionality make it the best dB Meter for your iPhone. Whether you’re using it as a Sound Meter, Sound Level Meter, or Noise Meter, you’ll love the accuracy and convenience this Decibel Meter offers.
Key Features of the Decibel Meter App
Real-Time Noise Monitoring
 * Measure noise levels instantly with the Decibel Meter.
 * Ensure sound measurements are accurate and reliable using the Sound Meter and Sound Level Meter functionalities.
Noise Frequency Analysis
 * Use the built-in Noise Frequency Analyzer to examine sound waves.
 * Break down frequencies with advanced Noise Level Frequency Analyzer tools in the Decibel Meter.
Comprehensive Sound Metrics
 * Track decibel levels with precision using the Sound Meter and Noise Meter modes.
 * Get detailed results with the Sound Level Meter and Sound Level Frequency Analyzer features.
dB Meter Integration
 * Easily read sound intensity with the dB Meter scale included in the Decibel Meter.
 * Visualize sound data for safer and more informed decisions.
User-Friendly Design
 * Simple, intuitive interface makes the Decibel Meter easy to use.
 * Professional-grade features are just a tap away in your iPhone’s Sound Meter app.
Why Choose This Decibel Meter?
This Decibel Meter app is the most versatile tool for sound measurement, seamlessly combining the roles of a Sound Meter, Sound Level Meter, Noise Meter, and dB Meter. Whether you're monitoring workplace safety, tuning a sound system, or analyzing noise levels, this Decibel Meter delivers professional-grade results every time.
* Audio Professionals: Fine-tune sound with precision using the Sound Meter and Sound Level Meter.
How to Use the dB Meter App
1. Open the Decibel Meter app and position your iPhone microphone near the sound source.
2. Watch real-time decibel readings appear on the intuitive Sound Meter interface.
3. Dive deeper with the Sound Level Meter, Noise Meter, and Noise Frequency Analyzer tools.
4. Save and share reports for professional use.
Benefits of the dB Meter
* Accurately measure sound with the advanced Decibel Meter and Sound Meter tools.
* Analyze noise levels using the Noise Meter and Sound Level Frequency Analyzer.
* Ensure safety and comfort with detailed insights from the Noise Frequency Analyzer.
Subscription Terms:
We provide weekly, and yearly subscription that will allow users to access all premium features including downloading and saving recording files with all analyzed data. To save the recordings and to save the analysed data, a paid subscription is required.
With pro version users can access the following features:
-Unlimited Data Exports
-Longer duration for video recording 
-More themes
-Save data automatically 
To cancel a subscription during its free trial, you must do so through your account in the Store. Ensure you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial period to avoid being charged.
For more information, please visit https://support.apple.com/HT207865
For Support, email us at official@wouldyourather.one

bluejetty:00023807:ios.description:
Your closet is full but you have nothing to wear. Pureple fixes that.
Snap your clothes once and your AI stylist does the rest — building outfits from what you already own, scoring the looks you assemble, and helping you actually wear the things hanging in your closet.
Trusted by 3M+ people across 100+ countries, in 8 languages.
Why Pureple?
Fast virtual closet setup: Auto-categorize, import from the web, and batch-edit items.
Personalized styling: Get outfit ideas tailored to your taste and wardrobe.
Flexible & customizable: Filters, tags, and lookbooks that fit your style.
Capsule planning: Curate the essentials and mix-and-match with confidence.
Community inspiration: Share outfits and discover new looks.
AI & Premium Features
Whole Closet Scan (Pro): Add multiple clothing items from a single photo of your closet. Review the detected pieces, then save them to your wardrobe.
Virtual Try-On (AI): Create an outfit set (or collage) and see it on a model using AI—preview the full look before you wear or pack it. Save to Lookbook, add to Calendar, or include in your Packing List. Results are for style visualization; not a sizing tool.
Instant Outfit Feedback by AI: Snap or build a look and get immediate, actionable tips to improve it.
Unlimited AI Style Suggestions: Endless outfit ideas from your own closet for any occasion.
Calendar & Packing Lists: Plan what to wear by day; auto-organize packing for trips.
Unlimited Background Erase: Clean, studio-style photos in a tap.
Ad-Free Experience: Enjoy Pureple without interruptions.
Multi-Device Sync & Cloud Backup: Access your closet anywhere and keep it safe. (Premium)
Organization Superpowers
Add clothes, shoes, accessories, beauty items, hairstyles, and wishlists.
Filter by season, occasion, color, brand, size, price, and more.
Build lookbooks and avoid impulse buys with smarter wardrobe planning.
Backup via iCloud/iTunes; Premium adds cloud sync.
Pureple Premium

Weekly: $6.99/week
Monthly: $14.99/month

bluejetty:00118646:android.description:
Are you ready for the fun challenge in this defensive battle strategy game? One Man Army: Battle Game puts you in the shoes of an unstoppable warrior defending yourself and testing your reflexes against enemy attacks. With a variety of skills and upgrades at your disposal, you can upgrade your armory and become an unstoppable force.
As a One Man Army, you must use your battle tactics to defend and survive enemy attacks. The game tests your reflexes and strategic skills as you face wave after wave of enemy soldier's attacks. You must be quick on your feet, using the right tactics to outsmart your opponents and emerge victorious.
With each battle won you earn points to rank up, upgrade your armory and enhance your battle skills. Armory upgrades include everything from new weapons and armor to protective gear and shields. By climbing up the ranks you claim them all to be a champion battle warrior.
One Man Army: Battle Game will test your warrior skills and battle reflexes. With challenging levels and intense battles, you must use your tactical skills to survive and defend against arrows, canon, and even dragon flames.
The game features easy Battle game mechanics and realistic sound effects, immersing you to test your reflexes and battle tactics in this challenging game. You’ll feel like you’re on the front lines of the battlefield action, and defending against enemy attack with every move you make.
One Man Army: Battle Game is the perfect game for anyone who loves a challenge. Are you ready to rule the battlefield and emerge victorious? Play One Man Army: Battle Game now and find out!

bluejetty:00014540:ios.name: Outfield - Field Sales CRM
bluejetty:00014540:ios.summary:
Outfield is the field sales CRM built for reps who live on the road — not stuck behind a desk.
From outside sales to brand ambassadors to field service teams, Outfield gives your team everything they need to manage accounts, optimize route
bluejetty:00014540:ios.description:
Outfield is the field sales CRM built for reps who live on the road — not stuck behind a desk.
From outside sales to brand ambassadors to field service teams, Outfield gives your team everything they need to manage accounts, optimize routes, log activity, and close more deals — all from their phone. Works standalone or alongside Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or any CRM you're already running.
OUTSIDE SALES & FIELD REPS
Log visits, calls, emails, and texts in seconds. Manage your full pipeline on the go, track deal stages, and know exactly where every customer stands. Route optimization cuts windshield time by up to 30% so reps spend more time in front of customers. Map your accounts, prospect new ones, and build territory strategies that actually work.
BRAND AMBASSADORS, MERCHANDISING & FIELD MARKETING
Check in, complete call forms, and attach photos to verify display compliance — all from your phone. Build relationships with store contacts and link them to their outlets so nothing slips through the cracks. More visibility means more influence when it counts.
FIELD SERVICE & INSPECTIONS
Industry-leading form builder with text-to-speech input, photo attachments, auto-recorded GPS location and visit duration, offline mode, and autosaved drafts. No more paper. No more lost inspections. Just fast, clean, trackable fieldwork.
INSIDE SALES
Log calls, emails, and text touchpoints without breaking your flow. Manage pipeline stages, set follow-up tasks, and keep your team aligned — whether they're in the office or on the move.
KEY FEATURES
• Route Planner & Optimizer — cut drive time up to 30%
• Account Map & Territory Manager
• Deal Pipeline with customizable stages
• Activity logging: visits, calls, emails, texts, notes, photos
• Calendar & Scheduler
• GPS Activity Mapping & Heat Mapper
• Goal & Quota Manager
• Performance Dashboard, Leaderboards & Sales Competitions
• Conditional Forms & Inspection Builder
• Order & Inventory Manager
• Business Card Scanner
• Group Chat & Comments
• Reports, Alerts & Revenue Analytics
• Works Offline
• Integrations with 8000+ apps
• Custom Fields & Data Import/Export
Trusted by Fortune 500s and scrappy field teams alike across 50+ countries — Outfield was built for how you actually work.

bluejetty:00157562:ios.developer: Voe Livre Serviço de Informação na Internet LTDA
bluejetty:00157562:ios.summary:
Buscamos voos em diversos sites para encontrar as melhores ofertas de passagens aéreas.
Economize tempo e dinheiro: compare valores e reserve sua passagem nas principais companhias aéreas e agências de viagem confiáveis.
Como encontramos
bluejetty:00157562:ios.description:
Buscamos voos em diversos sites para encontrar as melhores ofertas de passagens aéreas.
Economize tempo e dinheiro: compare valores e reserve sua passagem nas principais companhias aéreas e agências de viagem confiáveis.
Como encontramos voos baratos?
Desenvolvemos uma tecnologia que identifica ofertas de voos em tempo real e te avisa - o Voelivre não é apenas um aplicativo de voos baratos: é fácil de usar, totalmente gratuito e sem anúncios. Agora veja como usar o app Voelivre.
Busque passagens
Informe sua origem e destino, escolha as datas de ida e/ou volta e selecione o número de passageiros. Vamos pesquisar voos baratos em diversas empresas confiáveis e te mostrar uma lista com as passagens aéreas ordenadas pelo menor preço.
Escolha sua passagem aérea
Selecione os horários que melhor lhe convém e clique no botão de comprar - vamos te levar direto para o site de reserva, já com o voo que escolheu selecionado.
Filtre sua busca
Pesquise os voos mais baratos de acordo com as suas necessidades.
Clique em "Filtros" localizado na parte inferior da tela do aplicativo e escolha aqueles que precisa, como número de conexões, horários de partida e chegada e aeroportos.
Desta forma, o app de viagem Voelivre buscará exclusivamente voos que atendam às suas preferências. Por exemplo, se você precisa embarcar após as 7h da manhã, em um voo sem conexão, e precisa chegar a um aeroporto específico, iremos apresentar uma lista apenas com voos que correspondam a essas características.
Compre com quem você confia
Defina os sites de reserva que você quer que o Voelivre pesquise como Gol, Latam, Azul, Zupper, Decolar, MyTrip, Maxmilhas, Chalinga, Gotogate, FlihtNetwork, TAP, AirEuropa e mais.
Lembre-se: muitos filtros aplicados reduzem suas opções de passagens promocionais.
Crie alertas
Para criar alertas no app, clique no botão 'Meus Alertas' da tela inicial, ou, após fazer uma pesquisa, clique no botão "Alerta" localizado na parte inferior da tela. O Voelivre vai monitorar o voo e te avisar por meio de uma notificação em seu celular assim que encontrar uma promoção relâmpago de passagem aérea, dessa forma você fica por dentro de todas as ofertas de voos.
Saiba a melhor hora de comprar
Com o alerta de voos ativo, o histórico das promoções é habilitado, para que você acompanhe a variação do custo da passagem, desde a criação dos alertas.
Ofertas do Dia
Encontre as passagens aéreas mais baratas do Brasil para o mundo - fique sabendo de todas as ofertas de última hora, vamos te mostrar os voos mais baratos baseados nas buscas das últimas 24h.
Agora você está pronto para decolar e garantir a melhor experiência no planejamento de suas viagens.
Por que escolher o buscador de voos Voelivre?
● Selo de confiança do Reclame Aqui
● Atendimento humanizado pelo WhatsApp e e-mail
● Um dos apps de viagem com maior nota nas lojas

Economize tempo e dinheiro: compare valores e reserve sua passagem nas principais companhias aéreas e agências de viagem confiáveis.

Como encontramos voos baratos?
Desenvolvemos uma tecnologia que identifica ofertas de voos em tempo real e te avisa - o Voelivre não é apenas um aplicativo de voos baratos: é fácil de usar, totalmente gratuito e sem anúncios. Agora veja como usar o app Voelivre.

Busque passagens
Informe sua origem e destino, escolha as datas de ida e/ou volta e selecione o número de passageiros. Vamos pesquisar voos baratos em diversas empresas confiáveis e te mostrar uma lista com as passagens aéreas ordenadas pelo menor preço.

Escolha sua passagem aérea
Selecione os horários que melhor lhe convém e clique no botão de comprar - vamos te levar direto para o site de reserva, já com o voo que escolheu selecionado.

Filtre sua busca
Pesquise os voos mais baratos de acordo com as suas necessidades.
Clique em "Filtros" localizado na parte inferior da tela do aplicativo e escolha aqueles que precisa, como número de conexões, horários de partida e chegada e aeroportos.

Desta forma, o app de viagem Voelivre buscará exclusivamente voos que atendam às suas preferências. Por exemplo, se você precisa embarcar após as 7h da manhã, em um voo sem conexão, e precisa chegar a um aeroporto específico, iremos apresentar uma lista apenas com voos que correspondam a essas características.

Compre com quem você confia
Defina os sites de reserva que você quer que o Voelivre pesquise como Gol, Latam, Azul, Zupper, Decolar, MyTrip, Maxmilhas, Chalinga, Gotogate, FlihtNetwork, TAP, AirEuropa e mais.

Lembre-se: muitos filtros aplicados reduzem suas opções de passagens promocionais.

Crie alertas
Para criar alertas no app, clique no botão 'Meus Alertas' da tela inicial, ou, após fazer uma pesquisa, clique no botão "Alerta" localizado na parte inferior da tela. O Voelivre vai monitorar o voo e te avisar por meio de uma notificação em seu celular assim que encontrar uma promoção relâmpago de passagem aérea, dessa forma você fica por dentro de todas as ofertas de voos.

Saiba a melhor hora de comprar
Com o alerta de voos ativo, o histórico das promoções é habilitado, para que você acompanhe a variação do custo da passagem, desde a criação dos alertas.

Ofertas do Dia
Encontre as passagens aéreas mais baratas do Brasil para o mundo - fique sabendo de todas as ofertas de última hora, vamos te mostrar os voos mais baratos baseados nas buscas das últimas 24h.

Agora você está pronto para decolar e garantir a melhor experiência no planejamento de suas viagens.

Por que escolher o buscador de voos Voelivre?
● Selo de confiança do Reclame Aqui
● Atendimento humanizado pelo WhatsApp e e-mail
● Um dos apps de viagem com maior nota nas lojas

Nossas redes sociais
● Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/voelivreapp
● Instagram: @voelivreapp
● TikTok: @voelivre
● LinkedIn:https://www.linkedin.com/company/voelivre/
● Website: https://www.voelivre.com.br

bluejetty:00126258:ios.summary:
Remote Desktop Manager for iOS is a free tool that enables access to all your remote connections and passwords. Centralize your connections in workspaces and access your data from anywhere, from in the field with RDM mobile!
Remote Connec
bluejetty:00126258:ios.description:
Remote Desktop Manager for iOS is a free tool that enables access to all your remote connections and passwords. Centralize your connections in workspaces and access your data from anywhere, from in the field with RDM mobile!
Remote Connections
================
Remote Desktop Manager for iOS supports Microsoft Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP), VNC, Apple Remote Desktop (ARD), SSH Shell, SSH Tunnel, Proxy Tunnel, Telnet, FTP, TFTP, SFTP, SCP, Active Directory Console, WebDAV, Google Drive, Microsoft OneDrive, Microsoft RDP Gateway, Azure Blob Storage Explorer, Amazon AWS Dashboard, Amazon S3 Explorer, Website, SSH Port forward, Dell iDRAC, Dropbox Explorer, HP iLO, BeyondTrust Password Safe and BeyondTrust Password Safe Dashboard.
Once configured, connections to your remote servers, virtual machines and other workstations can be easily launched using a single tap.
Password Management
=================
Along with remote connections, Remote Desktop Manager for iOS lets you save and manage your passwords and credentials from your centralized database or your local XML file. Easily input your credentials and automatically sign in everywhere.
Credentials
=========
RDM supports generic credentials as well as the following integrations: 1Password, Bitwarden, Dashlane, Keeper, LastPass, One Time Password, Passportal, Password Manager Pro, Passwordstate, Pleasant Password Server, RoboForm, Secret Server, Sticky Password, TeamPass, True Key, and Zoho Vault, in addition to our own products, Devolutions Cloud and Devolutions Server.
Database
=======
Remote Desktop Manager for iOS supports these workspaces:
 -Devolutions Server 
 -Devolutions Cloud 
 - XML File

- create a free @ik.me @e
bluejetty:00076377:ios.description:
The Infomaniak Mail app requires your email addresses to be hosted by Infomaniak.
This app allows you to manage your Infomaniak addresses in a completely secure environment.
With the Infomaniak Mail app, you can:
- create a free @ik.me @etik.com or @ikmail.com address with 20 GB storage and no advertising which is managed in Switzerland in accordance with the GDPR.
- send and receive emails via your Infomaniak email addresses.
- define Infomaniak Mail as the default messaging service app.
- search for a specific message or your unread emails, favourite emails or emails with attachments.
- switch from one account to another to access all your email addresses managed by Infomaniak.
- be notified immediately of the arrival of new emails (push).
- organise your emails in personalised folders.
- scan mails to move, archive and delete them quickly.
- personalise your experience (dark/light theme, accent colour, display density, scanning actions in the inbox, etc.).
- protect access to the Infomaniak Mail app (according to your device’s locking method).
With Infomaniak Mail, you keep full control of your data and communicate in a secure, sovereign and constantly developing ecosystem. The Infomaniak Mail app is developed by Infomaniak and its code is open source and available on our GitHub.
Infomaniak has been a key cloud service provider in Europe and the foremost developer of productivity solutions in Switzerland for over 29 years. The company belongs exclusively to its employees and distinguishes itself by its commitment to privacy, the local economy and the environment.

bluejetty:00037362:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00037362:ios.description:
FluxCat is a complete AI creative studio in your pocket. Generate art from a
sentence, edit photos by describing the change, turn stills into moving video,
and train a private model that knows your face — all in one app, without a
desktop, a subscription to five services, or a single tutorial.
GENERATE ART FROM TEXT
Type what you imagine and watch it appear in seconds. Choose your aspect ratio
and output format, generate several versions at once, and save straight to your
camera roll. Fast drafts when you are exploring, photoreal detail when you have
found the shot.
EDIT PHOTOS BY DESCRIBING THE CHANGE
No layers, no brushes, no learning curve. Upload a photo and say what you want:
swap the background, change the outfit, remove the person in the corner,
restyle the whole thing as an oil painting. Blend several reference images into
one picture, or paint over the exact area you want redrawn and leave everything
else untouched.
BRING PHOTOS TO LIFE
The Video Studio animates a still image or builds a clip from a prompt alone.
Set the length, shoot widescreen for YouTube or vertical for Reels and TikTok,
render in HD, and pin the opening and closing frame so the motion lands exactly
where you want it. Some clips arrive with sound already on them.
TRAIN A MODEL OF YOU
Upload 10-20 photos of a face, a pet, a product or an art style and train your
own private model in about twenty minutes. Give it a trigger word and it stays
in your studio for good — put yourself in any era, any outfit, any place on
earth, and still look like you. Headshots, fantasy portraits, brand shots,
avatars: all of it from one training.
NEVER STARE AT A BLANK PROMPT BOX
Browse a searchable library of prompts shown with the images they produced, and
tap any one to reuse it. Build your own from categories — style, lighting,
camera, mood — with the Prompt Generator. Or hand the app a picture you like and
get back the prompt that describes it.
FINISH AND SHARE
- Upscale any result into a larger, sharper file
- Before and after slider, pinch to zoom on every image
- A private gallery on your device holding everything you have made
- One tap to Instagram, TikTok, Messages or Files
- Full resolution export with no watermark
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

own private model in about twenty minutes. Give it a trigger word and it stays
in your studio for good — put yourself in any era, any outfit, any place on
earth, and still look like you. Headshots, fantasy portraits, brand shots,
avatars: all of it from one training.

Browse a searchable library of prompts shown with the images they produced, and
tap any one to reuse it. Build your own from categories — style, lighting,
camera, mood — with the Prompt Generator. Or hand the app a picture you like and
get back the prompt that describes it.

bluejetty:00180908:ios.description:
Train your brain and become the fusion master with Dice Merge, an all-new jigsaw and puzzle game
 Dicedom is a great board game. Roll the dice, match 3 dice to merge the dice.
Drag and drop customizable dice blocks onto the board and try to craft your match! The value of a mold is associated with its coloration. Create and collect ruby gems by matching 3 dice of the same color to merge into higher values.
***** How to play:
- Play on 5X wooden planks. Each brick you can put only one dice.
- You cannot merge different number dice.
- There are 6 colors of Domino dice.
- Roll the dice to get new dice.
- You can rotate the dice before placing them.
- Match three dice of the same color to merge.
- Three 6-dot dice can be merged into one jewel dice. It is a magic dice.
- Merge three dice that can crush 3x3 nearby dice.
- Game will end when the game board has no space to place dice!
***** Features:
- Real quality 3D game.
- Beautiful colorful wooden dice block.
- Sweet sound effects.
- Rotate & Projecting feature.
- Powerful boosters.
- It 5x5 dice jigsaw makes your brain healthy for a happy life.
- Unlimited time & No internet required.
- Easy to learn with tutorials.
- Support charts.
- All free.
If you want to challenge yourself, come and play Dom Merge Puzzle Games!

The official Santander Cycles app from Transport for London is the only app to send bike release codes straight to your smartphone. So you can skip past the docking station terminal and get on your bike quicker.
Simply register with your bank card, and use the app to ‘Hire now’ from a nearby docking station. Follow the instructions to get your bike release code. Tap the code into the docking point and you’re good to go!
You can also:
• See up-to-the-minute information about which docking stations have bikes and spaces available
• Plan a journey with an easy to follow map
• Receive notifications – for example, summarising the cost at the end of your hire
• View your recent journeys and charges
• Save your favourite docking stations
• Become a London Rider - complete challenges and hire cycles to earn entries into a weekly prize draw! 
Each bike release code is valid for 10 minutes at your chosen docking station.
Please note the app doesn’t reserve bikes. If there are no bikes available at the docking station, don’t worry. Use the app to find a nearby docking station with bikes, and get another bike release code to use there. You won’t be charged until you use the release code.
You must be 18 or over to hire a bike, and 14 or over to ride one. For full Santander Cycles terms and conditions, see tfl.gov.uk/santandercycles

Struggling with homework?
Meet Homework AI - the all-in-one academic assistant designed to help students of every level conquer their toughest challenges. From scanning and solving complex math equations in seconds to generating polished writing and answering questions across every subject, Homework AI delivers accurate, step-by-step support whenever you need it most.
Whether you're stuck on algebra at midnight or need help crafting a professional email before class, Homework AI is the only tool you need.
KEY FEATURES
- Scan & Solve Math Instantly:
Point your camera at any math problem — handwritten or printed — and receive a clear, step-by-step solution in seconds. From basic arithmetic to calculus, we've got it covered.
- Ask Anything, Get Smart Answers:
History, science, literature, geography — ask any academic question and get comprehensive, accurate answers drawn from a wide knowledge base.
- AI Writing Assistant:
Beat writer's block and sharpen your essays, reports, and articles with intelligent writing support — from brainstorming ideas to refining grammar and structure.
- Professional Email Generator:
Compose clear, articulate emails in moments. Just describe what you need to say, and Homework AI will craft a personalized, well-written message for you.
- Step-by-Step Explanations:
Don't just get the answer — understand it. Every solution is broken down into clear, logical steps so you can learn the method, not just copy the result.
- Instant, Reliable Results:
No waiting. No second-guessing. Homework AI delivers precise answers at lightning speed — so you can focus on learning instead of searching.
WHY STUDENTS LOVE IT?
- Saves hours of study time
- High-accuracy answers you can trust
- Builds real understanding, not just answers
- Available 24/7, whenever you need it
Homework AI is built for students from elementary school through university. Whether you need quick answers, deep explanations, or writing support, it's the smartest study companion you'll ever have.
Download Homework AI today and turn homework time into learning time.

LANETALK – WE TRACK. YOU BOWL.
Live scores, automatic game tracking, and pro-level insights. All in your phone.
LaneTalk automatically syncs your scores from connected centers and turns them into powerful stats to help you improve. Whether you’re a casual bowler or a competitive league player, LaneTalk brings the pro experience to your fingertips.
Trusted by 500,000+ bowlers and top pros like Jason Belmonte, Kyle Troup, and Verity Crawley. Official stats provider for PBA and USBC.
FREE FEATURES
Follow the action and see how your friends, competitors, or pros perform in real time.
Live Scoring From Participating Centers 
View frame-by-frame scoring from connected live scoring centers worldwide.
Live League Results & Standings
Follow real-time league standings and live results from connected league centers.
PRO FEATURES – 1 MONTH FREE TRIAL
Unlock your personal stats, track your progress, and find your edge.
Claim Your Games
Automatically track your scores in connected centers, or add games manually if your center isn’t connected.
Compare Conditions
Tag your games with bowling balls, oil patterns, centers, leagues, and more – and see what works best.
Pin Leave Tracking
Get detailed breakdowns of all your pin leaves and see your spare conversion, strike percentage, and more.
Benchmark Yourself
Compare your stats with friends, PBA pros, league competitors, and even the next average tier.
Unlimited Live Scoring Access
View real-time scores from any LaneTalk-connected center – even if the center doesn’t offer public access.
GET STARTED TODAY 
Join the LaneTalk community and discover how easy it is to track and improve your game.
Connected to 1,700 centers worldwide. Over 1 billion games analyzed.
Built for bowlers – by bowlers.
Note: To access LaneTalk, all new users start with a 1 month free trial of LaneTalk Pro. After the trial, you’ll be automatically charged unless you cancel before the trial ends. You can cancel anytime in the app or in the Apple account settings.
Learn more at lanetalk.com

bluejetty:00172745:ios.description:
SiteScape is the #1 LiDAR 3D Scanning App for Architecture, Engineering, and Construction. Capture 3D scans accurate to the inch and built for construction workflows.

CAPTURE IN SECONDS
Just open the SiteScape app, hit record, and watch as a high-resolution 3D scan appears before your eyes. It’s space-age tech made remarkably simple so your team can document more existing conditions with way less overhead.
ENTIRE BUILDINGS WITH INCH-LEVEL ACCURACY
Get the full context with the only app that can accurately capture at the building scale (up to 5,000 ft² or 500 m² with SiteScape Pro) with inch-level accuracy. Instant site documentation that saves hours on field measurements for drafting and modeling.
MODEL AS-BUILTS & EXISTING CONDITIONS
SiteScape is built for construction workflows so you can seamlessly export scans to your favorite CAD programs like Revit, AutoCAD, ArchiCAD, Sketchup, Navisworks, Revizto, and many more.
SYNCING THE FIELD TO THE BACK OFFICE
Send your scan to whoever needs to see it so they can keep up with changes on the job site and get the right eyes on important issues. Share a secure link where stakeholders can view 3D scans in any web browser, on any device!

bluejetty:00130888:ios.description:
Tiny Fishing
Tiny Fishing is a fishing game where you have to upgrade your gear to get bigger fish! Each fish you catch will earn you some money, which you can then spend on better equipment to fish deeper and deeper. The deeper you go, the more rare the fish become. Can you catch the biggest fish?
Tiny Fishing is a popular mobile game available on IOS devices that has been gaining a lot of attention from players all over the world. Developed by the indie game studio “Ohanaware”, this game is a fun and addictive fishing game that is easy to play and suitable for all ages.
The game takes place in a beautiful and serene lake, where you get to control a small boat and cast your fishing rod to catch as many fish as possible. The graphics are stunning, with beautiful scenery and colorful fish swimming in the water. The game’s music and sound effects add to the overall experience, making it more immersive and enjoyable.
One of the key features of Tiny Fishing is its simple and intuitive gameplay. To catch a fish, all you need to do is tap the screen to cast your fishing line and then wait for a fish to bite. Once you have a fish on your line, you need to swipe left or right to reel it in. Each fish you catch earns you points, and you can use these points to upgrade your fishing gear, unlock new boats and fishing spots, and catch even bigger and more valuable fish.
Another unique aspect of Tiny Fishing is its social features. The game allows you to connect with friends and compete with them in fishing competitions. You can also share your catches on social media and compare your scores with other players around the world.
Tiny Fishing is a game that is perfect for anyone who loves fishing or simply wants to relax and unwind. Its beautiful graphics, simple gameplay, and social features make it a must-have game for anyone who enjoys mobile gaming.
In conclusion, Tiny Fishing is an excellent IOS game that offers a fun and engaging fishing experience. Its beautiful graphics, simple gameplay, and social features make it a standout game in the mobile gaming market. If you are looking for a relaxing and enjoyable game to play on your IOS device, then Tiny Fishing is definitely worth a try.

• Seamless connection to Bluetooth controllers
• Low-latency streaming for a smooth gaming experience
• Virtual gamepad supported
• Full-screen support (no black bars)
• Button mapping support for enhanced control

bluejetty:00184992:ios.summary: This is a no-ads, no-tracking, no-subscriptions version of the first and most popular pinochle app for iPad, iPhone, and Mac. Play single- or double-deck with configurable options, including meld bids and shoot the moon. Pinochle Gold has m
bluejetty:00184992:ios.description:
This is a no-ads, no-tracking, no-subscriptions version of the first and most popular pinochle app for iPad, iPhone, and Mac. Play single- or double-deck with configurable options, including meld bids and shoot the moon. Pinochle Gold has more tabletops and more card back options than Pinochle Plus and is updated frequently with user-suggested features and AI improvements. To try before you buy, see our free, ad-supported Pinochle app. 
Pinochle is a card game played with a 48- or 80-card deck of 9s, 10s, jacks, queens, kings and aces. The game consists of a repeating sequence of bidding (for the right to name the trump suit and optionally to pass cards), melding, and trick-taking. Players score points by melding various card combinations and by taking tricks.
In this version, one human player (South) plays with a computer partner (North) and two computer opponents (West and East).
BIDDING: Each player bids the number of points she thinks she can make with her hand. Player to the dealer's left is required to bid, and bidding proceeds to the left. Players who pass are out of the bidding for that hand. A typical high bid is 35 points (for 48 cards) or 60 (for 80 cards). High bidder names the trump suit for the hand and optionally exchanges cards with her partner.
MELDING: Players get points by showing various card combinations. A run (or straight) in the trump suit is worth 15 points. Aces in all four suits is 10 points. Pinochle (queen of spades and jack of diamonds) is 4 points, or 30 points for double pinochle (two of each).
TRICKS: Play begins with the high bidder, and proceeds around the table to the left, 4 cards per trick. Each trick has a winner, who gets 1 point per ace, ten or king.
SCORING: If the high bidder fails to make the bid (his team's total meld plus trick points is less than the bid), the bid amount is subtracted from the team score. Play continues until one team goes out.

Majte svoje financie neustále pod kontrolou a zároveň v bezpečí. Mobilná aplikácia od mBank spojila najpokročilejšie bezpečnostné systémy s užívateľsky prívetivým prostredím. Správa peňazí ešte nikdy nebola jednoduchšia.
Ako vám mobilná aplikácia od mBank zjednoduší život? 
1. Prehľad o svojich financiách budete mať stále poruke – vďaka notifikáciám sa okamžite dozviete o každom pohybe na účte. 
2. Otvorí vám cestu do sveta mobilných platieb – s bankou v mobile vám na bezkontaktné platby stačí telefón a palec alebo smart hodinky. 
3. Posielanie peňazí bude otázkou niekoľkých kliknutí – ľahko a rýchlo pomocou QR kódov alebo pomocou platieb na mobilné číslo. 
4. Online platby sa stanú ešte bezpečnejšie – Na ich potvrdenie využijete mobilnú autorizáciu, ktorú chráni váš unikátny PIN-kód alebo biometria. 
5. Zjednoduší vám správu platobných kariet – nastavenie limitov, zmena PIN kódu alebo rýchle zablokovanie karty. 
6. Sprístupní vám výhody virtuálnych kariet – eKartu si jednoducho objednáte priamo v aplikácii. 
7. Umožní vám vybaviť si pôžičku, sporenie, poistenie a ďalšie bankové produkty – predschválenú pôžičku môžete mať na účte do 3 minút. 
Pokiaľ ide o bezpečnosť, sme nekompromisní
Bezpečnosť vašich financií je pre nás prioritou. Preto mobilnú aplikáciu od mBank chránia tie najpokročilejšie funkcie. 
- Prihlásenie a každý úkon potvrdzujete vami zvoleným unikátnym PIN kódom alebo pomocou odtlačku prsta, prípadne skenu tváre.
- Pri krádeži telefónu aplikáciu odpojíte prostredníctvom internet bankingu. 
- Vďaka pokročilým šifrovacím protokolom nikto nezneužije vaše heslá, PIN kódy ani ďalšie osobné údaje.
Ešte nemáte mKonto?
Vyhnite sa návštevám pobočiek. Bankový účet od mBank si pohodlne založíte odkiaľkoľvek. Stiahnite si mobilnú aplikáciu mBank a dostaňte svoje financie pod kontrolu ešte dnes.

bluejetty:00095822:android.description:
Color Vibe is a soothing painting game created for players who crave peace, mindfulness, and a gentle creative break. Whether you're looking to unwind after a busy day or enjoy a few mindful moments, this color by number game offers a simple way to relax your mind.
Backed by years of expertise and millions of happy players, Easybrain delivers Color Vibe, a coloring book that offers a calming and immersive coloring experience. The game features elegant artwork, a soothing color palette, and precise mechanics — all designed to provide a stress-relieving and recharging experience. Fresh content is added regularly, and there is always something beautiful to discover. Enjoy painting by numbers in a clean interface tailored for players who value clarity, simplicity, and mental relaxation!
What you’ll find inside the coloring game:
- A wide selection of hand-picked artwork made to calm your mind: peaceful landscapes, blooming flowers, tasty treats, serene nature scenes, and much more.
- Gentle colors and serene visuals that may help you unwind, focus, and feel inspired while coloring by number.
- Detailed, high-quality images to keep your creative flow going.
- Smooth gameplay for a truly relaxing painting by numbers experience.
How to play Color Vibe:
Each image of the color game is divided into multiple numbered pieces. Choose a color, find its matching area, and fill it in! Don’t worry if you miss a spot — helpful hints and a zoom feature guide you along the way in this coloring game for adults. And the best part? When you’re done coloring by number, watch a peaceful animation as the image is recolored from the first tap to the last. The outlines disappear, leaving you with a beautiful picture you’ve just completed in this coloring book. It’s incredibly satisfying, like watching your worries fade with every tap.
Why you’ll love Color Vibe:
- Me-time made easy: You can unplug and enjoy, whether for five minutes or fifty.
- No mess, no stress: Just pure color by number joy anytime, anywhere.
- Designed with peaceful tastes in mind: Calm, elegant, and relaxing.
Are you looking for a restful moment in your day — maybe after work, during your quiet coffee break, or while the house finally settles down for the night? Step into the relaxing world of free coloring games: Color Vibe is your personal retreat, right in your pocket.
Ready to slow down with a relaxing color by number experience? This coloring book is your ultimate way to unwind. Dive into the pure joy of painting by numbers and discover how color games can make your day much brighter!

bluejetty:00185809:ios.summary: Turn your next ghost hunt into a story worth sharing. Camera Ghost Radar is a ghost detector simulator that combines your camera view, a radar and animated apparitions for a spooky game on your phone. Follow the signal, turn slowly and see
bluejetty:00185809:ios.description:
Turn your next ghost hunt into a story worth sharing. Camera Ghost Radar is a ghost detector simulator that combines your camera view, a radar and animated apparitions for a spooky game on your phone. Follow the signal, turn slowly and see what the next scan brings.
START WITH A SCAN
Open the scanner and watch the search unfold on your camera screen. Signal effects and interference build anticipation before the result appears. Will this round reveal a warm presence, a dark figure or no apparition at all? Not knowing what comes next is part of the suspense.
FOLLOW THE RADAR
Use the radar and the on-screen direction to guide where you turn your phone. Move slowly and look through the camera for the presence in the scene. Radar and camera describe the same game encounter, so you can follow its position as you change direction.
LIGHT, SHADOW AND MOVEMENT
Not every encounter looks the same. A luminous figure feels very different from a dark presence. Animated mist, light and movement bring the apparitions to life on screen, while their apparent size can vary between encounters. Take a moment to watch what appears before starting another scan.
A GHOST-HUNTING GAME TO SHARE
Take turns with friends, add a paranormal theme to game night or bring a little more atmosphere to Halloween. Who will notice the signal first? Who will spot the apparition? A familiar room or hallway becomes the backdrop for a fictional ghost hunt, without needing a complicated setup.
PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Choose when to scan, when to explore an encounter and when to leave. If you enable the optional game reminders, manage them from the notification controls in the app. These are invitations to play, not reports of real paranormal activity around you.
CAMERA, RADAR AND A LITTLE SUSPENSE
Enjoy the experience as a ghost camera game, a radar simulator or a way to share a playful scare. Each scan is another round: an empty result is also part of the game. Open the camera, follow the radar and discover what waits on screen.
Camera Ghost Radar is a simulation for entertainment. It creates fictional encounters and does not detect real ghosts, communicate with spirits or provide scientific evidence of paranormal activity.

bluejetty:00041211:ios.description:
**Pass the Real Estate Exam Without Losing Your Mind or Your Commission**
You’ve learned the lingo, memorized the laws, and managed to stay awake through hours of licensing coursework. Now all that stands between you and that shiny real estate license is the exam. Good news: we built an app that won’t make you want to list your soul under “motivated seller.”
EZ Prep’s Real Estate Study App is the fastest, smartest, and least painful way to prep for your Real Estate License Exam. Whether you’re studying at home, sneaking in questions at work, or reviewing in the tub with a glass of wine and a vague sense of dread, the app goes wherever you go and actually helps you learn.
We break the test down into nine major categories based on the latest 2026 state guidelines. Our adaptive system tracks what you’re good at and what still needs work, so you’re not wasting time reviewing concepts you already know like the back of your mortgage disclosure form.
**What’s inside the app:**
• Property Ownership
• Land Use and Regulations
• Financing
• Valuation and Market Analysis
• Principles of Agency
• Property Disclosures
• Contracts
• Leasing and Land Management
• The Practice of Real Estate
It doesn’t matter if you’re aiming to be an agent, broker, or just want to understand what your real estate agent is talking about. We’ve got you covered with dynamic questions that adjust to your progress, not your patience.
**App features built for real studying, not wishful thinking:**
• Personalized onboarding to set daily goals and quiz difficulty
• Adaptive questions that get harder as you improve
• Streaks and achievements to keep you going even when your caffeine wears off
• Instant feedback with explanations that don’t sound like they were written in legalese
• A timed exam simulator to practice under pressure
• Progress tracking with score benchmarks to measure your readiness
**Pass Guarantee:** If you don’t pass, we’ll refund your money and keep your subscription active until you do. Terms apply, but yes, we actually mean it.
Try the free version first to see if the app works for you. No shady charges. No pop-ups asking if you “want to unlock success.” Just the tools you need to pass and start closing deals.
EZ Prep is built by real professionals for future real estate agents who want to pass the exam without a second mortgage’s worth of stress.
Terms of Use: https://www.eztestprep.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.eztestprep.com/privacy-policy
Contact us at: support@eztestprep.com
EZ Prep is not affiliated with any state real estate board or the National Association of Realtors®. Visit them at https://www.nar.realtor. Check your specific state licensure website for full requirements. Then come back here and crush the exam.

Discover, save, and download music for your content on the go. Get unlimited access to over 50,000 high quality music tracks and 200,000 sound effects to add more feeling and more meaning to everything you create. With personalized recommendations, curated collections, and soundtracking tools that fit seamlessly into your workflow, you can find the perfect soundtrack, fast. And with all rights included, you can soundtrack and publish your content worry-free, worldwide.
- Discover over 50,000 original music tracks and 200,000 sound effects.
- Find the perfect track faster than ever with our exclusive soundtracking tools.
- Get personalized recommendations tailored to your content.
- Search and browse the music catalog by Genre, Mood, and Themes.
- Organize your music into playlists and save tracks for later.
- Download tracks straight to your device or export to your editing app for a seamless experience.
Why Epidemic Sound?
We’ve got a sound for everything.
Discover, save, and download exclusive music by global artists, composers, and musicians. Spanning all genres from pop and rock, to hip-hop and classical, and expertly-curated for every theme, mood and occasion.
Set the scene or build suspense with our expansive catalog of sound effects. Clapping, banging, buzzing, barking and everything in between.
Access next-generation tools that streamline your workflow.
Find that perfect track faster than ever. Our suite of exclusive features and tools have been designed with you in mind to make soundtracking more efficient and fun. For a seamless creative process. So you can spend more time doing what you love.
Our AI-powered music discovery tool Soundmatch lets you search for the perfect soundtrack using your content. Just play your video within our Soundmatch tool to get track suggestions based on frames within your content.
Got a track you already love? Find more music with a similar tone and sound with Epidemic Audio Reference, EAR. Just mark your favorite riff, hook, drop, or bridge to generate more tracks just like it.
Enjoy simple and safe licensing.
We set ourselves apart with a license model that goes beyond the standard. It’s better than royalty-free. Because we own all the rights to the music in our catalog, we can offer users a subscription with all rights included, globally.
With an Epidemic Sound subscription, you can soundtrack, publish and monetize your content worry-free, worldwide.
Reach your audiences on the biggest platforms out there, including YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Twitch, TikTok, podcasts, websites and more. All the content you publish during an active Epidemic Sound subscription stays cleared forever.

bluejetty:00156101:ios.description:
Seeking a coloring experience that transcends mere relaxation and unlocks the depths of your creativity? Look no further than Soul Color, the innovative paint by number game designed to nourish your soul and ignite your artistic spirit.
More than just coloring by numbers: Soul Color goes beyond the traditional by offering a multi-faceted experience that caters to the artist within:
Uncover Your Soul's Color Palette: We offer a curated collection of stunning artworks that evoke a wide range of emotions. Explore vibrant landscapes, serene mandalas, captivating portraits, and more – each designed to resonate with your unique inner world.
Journey Through Color Therapy: Each image in Soul Color is meticulously chosen to promote emotional well-being. Color alongside calming music and guided meditations, allowing the act of coloring to become a form of self-care and a path to inner peace.
A Haven for Relaxation and Self-Care: Escape the daily grind and immerse yourself in a tranquil coloring sanctuary. Soul Color provides a soothing retreat where you can unwind, de-stress, and reconnect with your inner self.
Beyond the features, Soul Color offers:
- Exquisite Artwork: We collaborate with talented artists worldwide to bring you a diverse and ever-expanding library of high-quality illustrations.
- Intuitive Interface: Enjoy a user-friendly design that is easy to navigate for artists of all skill levels.
- Regular Updates: We are constantly adding new content, features, and challenges to keep your artistic journey fresh and exciting.
- Personalized Daily Horoscope Coloring: Combine horoscope readings with coloring activities to generate daily personalized horoscope content and related coloring images.
- Apple Watch Integration: View daily and cumulative coloring data on Apple Watch, including time spent coloring and completed images. Set your favorite coloring images as a watch face for added personalization.
Soul Color is more than just a coloring app – it's a portal to self-discovery, a haven for relaxation, and a platform for artistic expression.
Download Soul Color today and embark on a journey of color, creativity, and inner peace.
Soul Color provides three auto-renewing subscription options. They are $4.99 for a week, $9.99 for a month, and $69.99 for a year.
If you choose to purchase Soul Color Pro, payment will be charged to your Apple account,

bluejetty:00159818:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00159818:ios.description:
FreeCBT is an open source thought diary for Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT).
Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) is the "gold standard" of psychotherapy and is widely considered to be one of the most effective, evidence backed treatments for depression, anxiety, and panic. If you go into just about any therapist or psychiatrist, CBT will likely be one of the first treatments they try.
FreeCBT is a companion and self-help app for one of the most common formats of CBT. You may have heard it called "the three column technique" or "catch it, check it, change it." Your brain is really good at making you feel exactly what you're thinking. Often, we find ourselves thinking "automatic negative thoughts" that lead us to fume on something that may not be true. That can cause us to feel depressed or anxious.
CBT helps you record "automatic thoughts," challenge them with cognitive distortions and then train your brain with an alternative thought. If you do it enough, you can change your thoughts, your moods and your behavior.
FreeCBT, a fork of Quirk, is open source under the GPL. You can find the code on Github at: https://github.com/erosson/freecbt

Спешите по делам? Увеличьте стоимость заказа, и водитель приедет на заказ быстрее. 
— Понравилась поездка? 
Поставьте оценку водителю, напишите отзыв или выберите реакцию из готовых шаблонов. Прикрепите фотографию к отзыву, оставьте чаевые или посмотрите детализацию платежей после поездки.

bluejetty:00120116:ios.description:
Millions of parents and teachers use RosiMosi games and lessons to educate and entertain young children.
The app is perfect for kids from 5 to 8 years old. Whether they are just starting first grade, or need to review and master the subjects, this is a perfect learning tool for kids. Discover 24 fun games meant to help your child develop a lifelong love of learning! 
All RosiMosi games are designed using real school math and reading curriculums with core curriculum state standards. Plus, your student or child will stay entertained with the help of voice narration, colorful images and animations, and lots of fun sounds and music. 
First Grade Learning Games cover the following educational topics: 
MATH
• Skip Counting - Skip count by 2's, 3's, 4's, 5's, 10's and more
• Compare Numbers - Advanced math topic that compares numbers to see what is greater or less than
• Patterns - Learn to identify repeating patterns
• Timed Facts - Quickly answer math facts to play a fun basketball game
• Ordering - Place objects in order based on size, numbers, and letters
• Fractions - Fun way to learn the visual representation of fractions
• Add & Subtract - Help learn advanced math skills like additional and subtraction 
• Add & Subtract Coloring - Solve math problems while coloring beautiful images 
LANGUAGE, SPELLING & READING 
• Reading Basics - Read articles, answer questions, and get help with tough words
• Word Bingo - Help your first grader with reading and spelling skills in a fun bingo game
• Compound Words - Combine words to build compound words
• Contractions - Teach your 1st grader how to combine words to make contractions
• Spelling - Learn how to spell hundreds of words with helpful voice assistance
• Verbs, Nouns, and Adjectives - Your child will learn different types of words like verbs, nouns, and adjectives
• Sight Words - Learn how to spell and recognize important words
• Plurals - Form plurals for different types of nouns
SCIENCE 
• 5 Senses - Learn the 5 senses, how they help us understand the world, and which body part each uses
• Geography - Identify the oceans, continents, and various types of landforms
