Trusted by millions of iOS users around the world and hailed by meteorology fans, Weather 14 Days is the official App from Meteored. Fully optimized for iOS 26, iPadOS 26 and watchOS 26, the app is available for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. 
- ALERTS AND NOTIFICATIONS -
Receive Official Weather Warnings from NOAA (National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration) for your location live thanks to our notifications and daily alerts. We send alerts about any weather phenomenon: rain, storms, temperatures, wind, hurricanes, and tropical storms, as well as severe weather forecasts.
- REALTIME RADAR, FORECAST MAPS AND SATELLITES -
Now available! A new animated world forecast map based on the ECMWF showing the weather forecast for the coming days. Enjoy our live radar service and also our hurricane tracker and storm, access animated weather radar of the last few hours provided by the NWS along with visible, infrared and water vapor satellite images provided by NOAA.
- WEATHER NEWS -
Check the new section of our news to be up to date of the latest weather events. Be informed about trending topics and the most recent forecast. You will learn about the weather phenomena thanks to our science articles, made by our experts in meteorology.
- WEATHER VIDEOS -
Discover videos of impactful weather phenomena, along with exclusive scientific content to help you understand the atmosphere and the weather.
- WEATHER FORECAST -
Check the current conditions along with the forecast for the next 14 days with a simple slide of your finger. Select a day to view detailed hourly information including heat index or temperature, precipitation, wind speed and direction, wind chill, pressure, cloudiness, humidity, UV index, sunset and sunrise times and even the phase of the moon. Turn your device sideways to see how the weather local will evolve throughout the day with our amazing graphics.
- WIDGETS -
Use our widget to see at a glance the current time and detailed summary of the week in your favorite city.
- SHARE -
Share weather forecasts with your friends and family anytime you want with whatever device or social network you like to use such as: WhatsApp, Twitter or Facebook.
- AVAILABILITY -
Find the forecast most relevant to your exact current position or search for your favorite locations from over 6,000,000 all around the world. Available in over 110 countries and 50 languages.

bluejetty:00138528:ios.name: Cozy Grove: Camp Spirit
bluejetty:00138528:ios.summary:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.
All those who are lost deserve kindness. Help cute, ghostly bears find peace in this relaxing sequel to the beloved life-sim game where kindness rules and new crafting, building and camping island adventures aw
bluejetty:00138528:ios.description:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.
All those who are lost deserve kindness. Help cute, ghostly bears find peace in this relaxing sequel to the beloved life-sim game where kindness rules and new crafting, building and camping island adventures await.
Attention, Spirit Scouts! Something spooky is afoot: A bus crash has left you stranded alone on a mysterious (yet delightfully cute) island. Explore the unique island, meet and befriend cute, ghostly spirit bears who need your help to remember their pasts and find peace. Customize a bustling, beautiful campsite — crafting, decorating, and building furniture to bring life and color back to this cute island — and hopefully reunite with your lost scout troop as you gradually repair your bus.
WELCOME TO YOUR RELAXING ISLAND OASIS AT THE END OF A STRESSFUL DAY
Whether you're new to the "Cozy Grove" community or a devoted fan, this relaxing follow-up to the beloved life-sim adventure offers something for everyone. This edition of "Cozy Grove" is cuter and cozier than ever, introducing a fresh cast of quirky characters, new animal companions, a new setting and added gameplay features that offer endless ways to unwind at the end of a stressful day. So immerse yourself in a unique, relaxing watercolor art style filled with stunning details and activities to explore. Drop in daily for crafting, decorating, fishing and cooking fun, or embark on new quests to stay busy. Lead with kindness and achieve your camping dreams — customize the cute, spooky island you've always wanted.
FIND NEW FOREVER FRIENDS AND CUTE ANIMAL COMPANIONS
Alongside familiar faces like Flamey and Mr. Kit, new spirit bears are waiting to bond with you and share their backstories. New animal companions are also on the island to offer support and relaxing comfort — now you can pet a dog (!) or have a snail help lighten your load.
EXCHANGE GIFTS WITH ASYNCHRONOUS MULTIPLAYER MODE
A new asynchronous multiplayer mode lets you see spooky, cute astral projections of other players, connect with fellow Spirit Scouts and send and receive cute gifts through the mail. But introverts, no need to worry: There's no pressure to interact with your fellow players in real time — you're free to discover and gift in your own time, at your own relaxing pace.
NEW SPOOKY MYSTERIES TO INVESTIGATE
Uncover the secrets of the interconnected islands you've landed on as you complete daily quests. As you progress with patience and diligence, you may unlock new areas to explore. Visit dedicated stations for different activities and light up lamps to find bountiful new spots for foraging and mining.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR ISLAND WHILE CRAFTING, DECORATING AND CAMPING
Just because you're living on a haunted island doesn't mean you can't get comfortable! Immerse yourself in crafting and decorating activities, or collect furniture to make the island your own. Plant flowers and fruit trees to harvest, raise ghostly animals and attract pets to your house. And if things start to feel ho-hum, give yourself a custom head-to-toe makeover.
A POSITIVE, HEARTENING DAILY RITUAL
This life-sim game unfolds in sync with real-world time, bringing cute surprises and spooky seasons on the island. If you finish the day's quests, you can cook, craft, collect shells, catch bugs, go fishing, skip rocks or even spruce things up with a new power-washing tool. Rake in rewards as you add to your collection of cute items and earn merit badges for all your accomplishments. A Spirit Scout's work is never done!
- Created by Spry Fox, a Netflix Games Studio.

bluejetty:00086733:ios.description:
Seja bem-vindo ao Floripa no Ponto, o aplicativo que apresenta informações em tempo real¹ do transporte público de Florianópolis, Santa Catarina.
No Floripa no Ponto você tem acesso a:
- Consulta de saldo e recarga de créditos do seu cartão Passe Rápido
- Localização em mapa dos pontos de parada e de recarga de créditos nas proximidades
- Consulta a tabela horária das linhas que operam em sua cidade ou região
- Localização em tempo real dos veículos que operam em determinada rota, podendo compartilhar esta informação com outras pessoas¹;
- Planejamento de viagem entre dois pontos, considerando deslocamentos a pé e utilizando o transporte público, inclusive com informações em tempo real
- Informações de interesse e alertas que envolvam rotas e pontos de parada, que afetem a operação normal do transporte público
- Recursos de acessibilidade, com acesso facilitado via VoiceOver para previsões de passagem nos pontos próximos, tabela de horários e instruções detalhadas de como chegar ao seu destino.
---
Caso você possua uma versão do iOS a qual não seja mais assegurado suporte a este aplicativo, recomendamos a consulta das informações direto pelo seu navegador de internet, acessando o site do Consórcio Fênix.
¹Informações em tempo real requerem conexão com internet, e a precisão depende da qualidade da rede de telefonia móvel.

If you are a hunter - get your gear and go hunting righ
bluejetty:00182649:ios.description:
Safari Hunting 3D simulator is an unforgettable adventure for real guys on the African continent, where you will meet face to face the four-footed owners of these places and hunt them.
If you are a hunter - get your gear and go hunting right now in the luxury offroader.
In your garage, a 4x4 off-road is waiting for you. Grab your hunting rifle, jump into the off-road car and get on your way to Safari to hunt various animals: rhinoceroses, lions, buffalos, zebras and many other animals indigenous to Africa.
Game features:
- Hunting animals. Best hunting simulator SAFARI 3D.
- Driving off road on luxurious 4x4s.
- Beautiful graphics and realistic scenery.
- Realistic animated animals to be hunted.
- Sounds of Africa, enhancing the reality effect.
- Best hunter score table.
Tips for a successful hunt:
1. Be careful, wild animals are dangerous and can attack people.
2. For best shooting results - use the scope. 
3. Do not approach your prey too close - you will frighten the animal away.
4. Having shot the prey, do not forget to load it into your trunk. This way your purse will be replenished.
5. The larger the prey, the more money it will bring you.
6. Use the money earned to buy new cars that would allow you to get to inaccessible places full of animals.
4x4 Safari Hunting - your best choice!
Have a good hunt and sharp shooting!
Thank your for playing with us, follow the updates, write reviews and leave comments!

bluejetty:00024105:ios.name: Mr. Meat 2: Prison Break
bluejetty:00024105:ios.summary: After the events of the previous game, Mr. Meat was captured by the police and imprisoned for his crimes. After years locked up in the state prison, the day of his execution has arrived and all the people related to the case have gathered i
bluejetty:00024105:ios.description:
After the events of the previous game, Mr. Meat was captured by the police and imprisoned for his crimes. After years locked up in the state prison, the day of his execution has arrived and all the people related to the case have gathered in the prison to witness his end.
In this new installment you play as Rebecca, Mr. Meat's daughter, who after being rescued in the previous game, is involved in a new nightmare when she goes to watch her father's execution. Explore an all-new setting as you escape from Mr. Meat and solve puzzles in your search for a route to escape from the prison that has been taken over by the butcher.
Some features:
- New protagonist: Play as Rebecca to save your family and acquaintances as you escape from Mr. Meat.
- New enemies: Mr. Meat and Pig 13 are back and now they are more dangerous. Also, the jail is full of pigs that will attack Rebecca.
- Explore the prison: Go inside to explore a whole new setting. 
- Fun puzzles: Solve clever puzzles to escape from jail.
- Multiple endings: Discover all the ways, both positive and negative, in which the story can end.
- Narrative cinematics: Discover the events of Mr. Meat's execution day.
- Large cast of characters: The Keplerians game with the most characters to date!
- Original soundtrack: Immerse yourself in Mr. Meat's universe with unique music in the rhythm of the saga and voices recorded exclusively for this game.
- New route system: Choose from different routes to escape from prison or explore at your leisure among all the options in free mode.
- New hint and mission system: If you get stuck, you have at your disposal a complete step-by-step guide so you always know what to do next.
- Different difficulties: Play at your own pace and explore safely in ghost mode, or take on Mr. Meat and his cronies in different difficulty levels that will test your skill.
- A terrifyingly fun game!
If you want to enjoy an experience of terror and fun, play "Mr. Meat 2: Prison break" now. Action and scares are guaranteed.
It is recommended to play with headphones for a better experience.
Let us know your thoughts in the comments!

bluejetty:00097481:ios.description:
Slide, Unblock & Escape in a Colorful Puzzle Challenge!
Get ready for Block Hustle, a fast-paced puzzle game that challenges your logic and planning! Guide the jammed blocks to the matching exit gates, but be careful—some blocks can only move in certain directions! The higher you go, the more obstacles and challenges await! Can you clear the maze before time runs out?
- How to Play:
+ Slide blocks with arrows in the only direction they can move.
+ Freely move blocks without arrows in any direction.
+ Plan carefully—some pieces might get in your way!
+ Guide each block to the exit gate of the same color.
+ Clear all blocks before time runs out to win!
- Game Features:
+ Exciting Puzzle Gameplay – Think, slide & escape the chaos!
+ Strategic Movement – Manage limited space & tricky layouts.
+ Challenging Levels – The higher you go, the tougher it gets!
+ New Obstacles & Mechanics – More surprises at every stage!
+ Fast-Paced & Addictive – Can you beat the clock?
Slide, think, and break free from the chaos! Download Block Hustle now and test your puzzle-solving skills!
Customer Support: support@onetapglobal.com

- 100% legal speed camera detector
- Turn by turn GPS navigation, wi
bluejetty:00074019:ios.description:
Enjoy driving with the best navigator, speed camera detector, real-time traffic information and gas prices. Forget about fines and drive with peace of mind.
MAIN FEATURES
- 100% legal speed camera detector
- Turn by turn GPS navigation, with lane guidance, spoken instructions, speed limits, and the speed camera detector fully integrated into the navigation
- Automatic route recorder. Shows the total distance and time spent traveling the route, speed at each point and speed cameras you passed. Check the speed you were having when passing speed cameras or anywhere
- Route planner. Create routes in advance to check their speed limits and the speed cameras you will find in them
- Traffic cameras and gas stations with their prices in route recordings and planned routes
- Real-time traffic information
- Traffic cameras from the DGT and other administrations
- Watch App
- No user account or registration, just open the app and that's it
The speed camera database covers Spain, Portugal and Andorra, and the price of gasoline covers Spain.
THE BEST SPEED CAMERA DETECTOR:
- CarPlay
- Warnings only in the direction you are moving
- Mean speed in section speed cameras
- Options to silence the warnings if your speed is OK
- Manual or automatic (depending on your speed) warning distance 
- Automatic speed camera updates
- Voice, sound and vibration warnings, also in your Apple Watch
- Map with real time traffic or view with no map, only with the speedometer
- Sound mixed with what you're listening to on your iPhone, through your car's hands-free kit or iPhone speakers
- Works in the foreground or background (use it alongside other apps)
- Fully configurable, portrait and landscape mode, night mode
- All speed cameras in Spain, Portugal and Andorra
NAVIGATION:
- Turn by turn navigation integrated with speed camera warnings and traffic map. All in the same screen, no need to use several apps
- Warnings of only the speed cameras with are in your route (configurable). Avoid false positives from nearby roads
- Speed limits when navigating
- Indications of the lanes to follow when changing direction
- Spoken instructions together with speed camera warnings
ROUTES
- Automatic route recorder. Check the speed you were going when passing speed cameras or at any location
- Configure when it records or disable it. This data is saved on your device and is not sent anywhere
- Route planner. check speed limits and the speed cameras you will encounter taking into account the direction in which you will pass them
- Launch navigation from a recording or a planned route
- Traffic cameras and gas stations with their prices in route recordings and planned routes
TRAFFIC MAP:
- Map with real time traffic and incidents
- Traffic cameras: Organize them in mosaics and favorites. 
- Zoom in to see gas stations with their prices, cameras and speed cameras
GAS PRICE:
- Find gas stations on the Traffic Map (zoom in) or in Routes
- Tap and hold for a second on the Traffic Map to find nearby gas stations ordered by price.
- Create your gas station favorite list to check their prices easily
IMPORTANT:
- The speed camera detector and navigation use the GPS continuously. Using it in the foreground or background can drain the battery quickly.
- To use the speed camera detector and navigation you need a GPS device: all iPhones have it. iPads with 3G have it but not WiFi ones.
Terms and Conditions: http://www.littlemousesoftware.com/terms-conditions
Privacy Policy: http://www.littlemousesoftware.com/skip-traffic-privacy

bluejetty:00141965:ios.description:
Let’s face it: most people just hate listening to voice messages. Another indisputable fact — it’s not always comfortable to listen to voicemail, especially when you are in meetings, concerts, lectures or other public places.
For those reasons we proudly present to you the Voicepop. Save time, effort, and avoid embarrassment by reading your voice messages instead. It converts voice to text via WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, Slack, and other messengers or processes your speech notes from Voice Memos.
There’s no doubt that Voicepop is your best speech-to-text app! With its help, you will instantly turn any voice and even video messages into text. After getting this genuine app on your iPhone or iPad, you’ll forget about annoying voicemails and will get proper information from the interlocutor in a comfortable text form.
We’re sure that you need this app, which is absolutely FREE! =)
Easy to use
To guarantee a high level of transcription quality, VoicePop uses unique speech recognition technology. Just find a voice message and share it to Voicepop, so the program could convert it. 
The app is compatible with such popular services as Telegram, WhatsApp, KakaoTalk, Signal, ICQ, and Slack. Use Voicepop to turn voice and video messages to text, whenever you can't listen to them.
Voicepop features:
***Works inside WhatsApp — no need to switch between apps.
***Comparable with voice messages.
***Supports a multitude of languages — more than 45.
This app transcribes voice and video messages to text in a few seconds. It’s been around for a while, and with some of the amazing technology behind it, Voicepop is able to have some really good accuracy.
Read text instead of voice messages
The options you get after installing Voicepop on your device:
***You plan to process voice memos.
***You want to read voice messages in other languages.
***You need to convert the sound message while kids are sleeping.
***You would like to use the app when it’s not convenient to listen to voice messages.
Also the app is doing an excellent job for people, who have hearing loss problems. Give it a try!
Voicepop has a perfectly crafted user interface. Speech-to-text app is also ideal, if you find voicemails annoying and prefer to save your valuable time. Now there’s no need to replay long voice messages on your iPhone/iPad again and again.
Privacy
Voicepop will never access, download or use voice and video messages without your permission. Independently Voicepop Inc. do not have any access to them, and this information is officially indicated in the company’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
Terms of Use: https://voicepop.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://voicepop.com/privacy-policy
License Agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/minterms
What’s the deal
Voicepop is free to download and use via the App Store. 
So why do you wait? This app is a must, if you are sick and tired of voice mails. Save yourself!

bluejetty:00070648:ios.description:
Sense is the best app to reduce stress and live a happy life. Get personal recommendations based on your current emotional state — meditations, packs of nature's sounds, breath exercises — everything you need right now to relax and sense the bright world. 
You have heard about meditation for a long time, or perhaps even read books on meditation, but so far theoretical knowledge has not turned into practice. This app is for those who want to embark on a new path and calm your mind.
This app is perfect for beginners. To master meditation, you do not need to enroll in full-time courses. You can start doing it yourself at home. This is very convenient. You can perform meditation at any time of the day. Free app for anxiety for both beginners and advanced practitioners. You can use it to raise awareness of yourself and your environment. As well as a way to reduce stress and improve concentration.
** Sense is recommended by top psychologists and mental health experts **
WHAT YOU'LL GET:
* Measurement of current stress level — get custom recommendations
* Meditations for every day — morning and evening
* Unique course of mindfulness concentration and visualization — certified CBT practices
* Over 100 ASMR nature sounds — fall asleep instantly, surrounded by nature
* Affirmations every day — forgiving, success, relaxation, happiness, and success
* Breath practices to calm and focus
* Various anti-stress practices
* No more anxiety — meditation will make your life bright
* Unlock your inner source of inspiration and creativity
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS:
Sense offers an auto-renewing monthly subscription at $6.99/month and an auto-renewing yearly subscription at $59.99/year to provide unlimited access to the Sense collection of relaxing sounds, meditations, mindfulness programs, and recommendations.
Terms of use: https://moonly.club/termsofuse
Privacy policy: https://moonly.club/privacy

bluejetty:00019455:ios.name: Stickman Party: 4 Player Games
bluejetty:00019455:ios.summary:
Stickman Party is a unique arcade game created so that you can have fun in the company of friends, as well as Stickmen!
Here is a whole collection of addictive and very exciting games for every day, play wherever and whenever. Compete with
bluejetty:00019455:ios.description:
Stickman Party is a unique arcade game created so that you can have fun in the company of friends, as well as Stickmen!
Here is a whole collection of addictive and very exciting games for every day, play wherever and whenever. Compete with your friends or family in more than 30 different types of competitive games, this arcade will allow you to play immediately 1 2 3 and four players on one device. Fight on powerful tanks in hot dueling, play soccer in team battles 2 on 2 or 1 on 1, take part in crazy car races and fight in an open area in a battle where the strongest wins!
Stickman games have very simple rules. You can play without the Internet / Wi-Fi, because the multiplayer here is local, offline, on one device.
These funny stickman games for one, two players or more are ideal for traveling, for parties, first dates, as well as for husband and wife, children and parents, brother and sister, for a group of friends.
Stickman Party is fun to play on the same device with friends. The more players, the funnier! But if you have no one to play with, then try to play on one player. Train to win against friends later.
Some of the games in the Stickman Party collection have unique rules, but there are remakes of famous mobile hits. Of course, they are adapted for a crazy task, so that it would be comfortable to play alone, for two, three and 4 players on one screen.
For example:
• Stickmen running
• catch chickens
• Run away from the ghost
• Tanks
• Fights
• Stickman football
• Racing cars
• Sea battle
We regularly add new mini-games. Stay tuned and tell your friends about the game!
=======
Specifications
=======
• Simple one-touch, one-button operation
• 4 players can play on one device
• more than 40 different fun mini-games
• Challenge your friends and family
Thanks for the game!

bluejetty:00166651:ios.description:
War Troops: Military strategy RTS game is a fast-paced trench assault strategy game. You are the captain, and your objective is to capture enemy trenches with your troops. Be ready for this combat strategy game! 
Climb up the levels to unlock exciting new troops and military types of equipment and also the troop upgrade. You can use officers, soldiers, artillery, bunkers, snipers, machine gunners, trucks, bazooka, mine, smoke, a tank, and many more.
The goal is to cross the warzone and capture all the enemy trenches and men of war. Doing so will require careful troop formation and strategic advancement timing to military assault and capture all enemy trenches. Army's are recruited and simulated by pressing the buttons at the bottom and gain money automatically over time and by eliminating enemy trenches. Using artillery well can be an easy way to master the army wars!
You must safeguard your trenches. Enemies will occasionally gain stronger. Prepare your troops and warplanes to defend against the deadliest enemy soldiers. Be ready for a military warfare game.
War Troops: Military strategy game Features:
-300+ unique, offline, free, and epic campaigns and unlock special boss levels as you progress the game. 
-Several newly equipped army troops, war weapons, and equipment, Military vehicles such as tanks warplanes, etc, and also boosters will unlock as you progress the game, and also you can upgrade skills each of them.
-Unlock new vehicles and customise them.
-19+ languages are supported.
- Enjoy the glorious victories over the enemy soldiers on this battlefield.
- Endless trench warfare battles that will keep you motivated.
- Real-time combat strategy game with your enemy soldiers.
- Superb visuals and gameplay that remembers you of world war two.
-Train your soldiers and increase your defence system.
Best soldiers and types of equipment ever:
In this strategy game, gather and select from a variety of army soldiers with different abilities also you can equip grenades, Poisons, generators, mines, and Czech also try out tanks, Fighter jets, Bombers also pillboxes to realize your full potential. In this incredible trench warfare strategy game, you must apply a strategy to select the appropriate army for the right job at the right time. We are given every soldier and war machine has unique skills and abilities.
Fight the real war field:
Wave after wave of enemy soldiers that will approach your team in the War Troops: Military strategy game. Keep in mind that you are the only one responsible for the victory of this war fight. At all costs, defeat your enemies and prevent them from crossing your trenches. Create a war strategy that will wipe out all enemy troops.
Just remember, never give up and hold your trenches and upgrade your skills! Let the best offline war game begin. 
Contact us at gameskoco@gmail.com 
Please leave great feedback - it helps us keep going!

bluejetty:00065527:ios.summary:
Find restaurant meals that fit your calories and macros before you order.
Whether you're picking up fast food, finding lunch nearby, or planning dinner out, CalorieCap helps you compare restaurant nutrition and choose a meal that fits your
bluejetty:00065527:ios.description:
Find restaurant meals that fit your calories and macros before you order.
Whether you're picking up fast food, finding lunch nearby, or planning dinner out, CalorieCap helps you compare restaurant nutrition and choose a meal that fits your day.
FIND WHAT FITS TODAY
Set a calorie target for your next meal and explore ranked matches. See why an option fits, compare its nutrition, and adjust your search around what matters to you.
KNOW BEFORE YOU ORDER
See calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber, sugar, and sodium in one place. Browse available restaurant menus and compare options without jumping between nutrition PDFs.
MAKE YOUR ORDER YOUR OWN
At select restaurants, build an order from available ingredients and see its nutrition as you go. Save meals you want to find again.
USE YOUR DAILY NUTRITION
Optionally connect through Apple Health to use supported nutrition data when planning your next meal. Availability depends on your device, permissions, and whether your food tracker shares nutrition with Apple Health. You can also set your own meal target.
CHOOSE YOUR PREFERENCES
Use nutrition and preference filters to narrow your options. Allergen information can help you review an order, but always confirm ingredients and preparation directly with the restaurant.
HELP CHOOSE WHAT COMES NEXT
Vote for restaurants you'd like to see added to CalorieCap.
CALORIECAP+
Get more meal matches, advanced nutrition controls, and an ad-free experience with CalorieCap+. Some features require a subscription. Available plans and prices are shown in the app before purchase.
Restaurant coverage, customization, and nutrition information vary. Nutrition values are provided for planning and may differ from the meal served.
Privacy Policy: https://www.caloriecap.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://www.caloriecap.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00124214:ios.name: Skateboard Party
bluejetty:00124214:ios.summary: Play with your friends using the multiplayer mode, complete achievements, gain experience and upgrade your skaters. Customize your outfits, shoes, board, trucks, wheels and bearings. Challenge skaters from all over the world using Game Cent
bluejetty:00124214:ios.description:
Play with your friends using the multiplayer mode, complete achievements, gain experience and upgrade your skaters. Customize your outfits, shoes, board, trucks, wheels and bearings. Challenge skaters from all over the world using Game Center leaderboards. 
Loaded with features, Mike V: Skateboard Party is the best skateboarding game to hit the market. 
CAREER MODE
Complete over 30 achievements to unlock new items and locations. Gain experience to upgrade your favorite skater’s attributes to perform better and achieve higher scores. 
FREE SKATE
Practice and improve your skateboarding skills without any constraints. 
MULTIPLAYER
Challenge your friends to a skateboard duel and let’s see who can land the baddest tricks! Share and brag your results with your friends on Twitter. 
MASSIVE SELECTION
Select between 8 characters and customize each of them to your preference. From outfits to shoes, choose your favorite gear. A massive collection of boards, trucks, wheels and bearings are available including items from Airwalk, Powell & Peralta, Bones, Tork Trux and Iron Fist Clothing.
LEARN TO SKATE
Over 40 unique tricks to master and hundreds of combinations. Follow the tutorial to get started and progress as you go. Execute the craziest combos and trick sequences to rack up some impressive high scores, gain experience and make a name for yourself.
HIGH DEFINITION
No other skateboarding game is available in HD. Mike V: Skateboard Party includes next-generation graphics specially optimized for your mobile hardware to provide you with the best skateboarding experience on your iPhone, iPad and iPod Touch.
NEW CONTROLS
New fully customizable control system; configure your own buttons layout and adjust the opacity. Use the right or left handed control mode, select a control preset or create your own. Use the analog stick or accelerometer option as you wish. Adjust your truck tightness to change your steering sensitivity. 
LOADED WITH FEATURES
•The only HD Skateboarding game available on the market. 
•Multiplayer mode to play against your friends using Wi-Fi & Bluetooth.
•New, fully customizable control system. You can adjust everything!

bluejetty:00085804:ios.description:
WHAT CAN YOU DO:
• REQUEST or BOOK a taxi quickly
• know the ESTIMATE of your ride
• FOLLOW the taxi coming to you on the map
• set up to six FAVORITE addresses
• pay with your CARD in the app (American Express, Mastercard and Visa), with SATISPAY, APPLE PAY, with your BUSINESS ACCOUNT or directly TO THE TAXI DRIVER
• SIMPLIFY your business trips with business solutions
• VOTE for rides and taxi drivers
WHY APPTAXI?
appTaxi is the right app for you!
• FREE: download and use are free
• EFFICIENT: Detects your location by itself or you can type it
• VERSATILE: allows you to choose the taxi that best suits your needs
• FAST: call a taxi in a few moments, wherever you are or at one of your favorite addresses
• PRACTICAL: notifies you via push notification of the taxi found with all the details on the vehicle
• CONVENIENT: allows you to save up to six addresses as favourites
• SECURE: allows you to register your card and pay for rides securely
• USEFUL: if you have a company you can start an appTaxiPay agreement and charge the trips directly to the company account with an invoice at the end of the month
• REWARDING: allows you to accumulate miles from the MilleMiglia Program, Italo Più points and Volare points
• UNIQUE: it is the only app in Italy that allows you to call a water taxi in Venice
• GREEN: offers a choice of hybrid or electric taxis to protect the environment
• RECEPTIVE: allows you to rate the taxi driver once the ride is finished.
WHERE CAN YOU TRAVEL WITH APPTAXI?
With the appTaxi app, your taxi journey is constantly expanding!
You can find us in major Italian cities:
• Milan, Rome, Florence, Venice, Naples, Bologna, Palermo, Catania, Cagliari
And you can also travel with us in many other cities:
• Abano Terme, Aosta, Arezzo, Bagno a Ripoli, Bergamo, Brescia, Calenzano, Campi Bisenzio, Carpi, Falconara Marittima, Fiesole, Impruneta, Lastra a Signa, Latina, Livorno, Lucca, Malpensa, Martesana, Massa Lubrense, Matera, Mestre, Modena, Monza, Padua, Pisa, Pordenone, Ragusa, Ravenna, Reggio Emilia, Rimini, Scandicci, Seregno, Sesto Fiorentino, Siena, Signa, Sorrento, Treviso, Trieste, Varese, Verona, Viareggio, Vicenza, Villafranca di Verona.
APPTAXI IS ALSO SOCIAL
Follow us on the channels:
FB: https://www.facebook.com/appTaxi/
TW: https://twitter.com/apptaxi_it
Do you want more information?
Visit our website https://www.apptaxi.it/ or write us your comments and feedback at support@apptaxi.it, your opinion is important to us!

bluejetty:00070072:ios.name: My Tide Times Pro - Tide Chart
bluejetty:00070072:ios.summary: My Tide Times Pro is the only tide times application you'll ever need. Whether you're surfing, fishing or just going to the beach you'll be able to use it to get quick and easy access to the times. We think it's the most beautiful tide time
bluejetty:00070072:ios.description:
My Tide Times Pro is the only tide times application you'll ever need. Whether you're surfing, fishing or just going to the beach you'll be able to use it to get quick and easy access to the times. We think it's the most beautiful tide times application on the market to date.
FEATURES 
- Supports over 9,000 tidal stations across over 40 countries (including the US, Canada, UK, Ireland, The Netherlands, Australia and New Zealand)! 
- Find the nearest tide tables to you when the app opens, so you can get tide predictions no matter where you are! 
- View sunrise & sunset times for all locations alongside the tides in the application! 
- Moonrise, moonset and moon phase information!
- View currents information for selected locations around the US & Canada! (Simply tap on a tide station, if there's currents information you'll see an extra tab).
- Never have to worry about ensuring the data is up-to-date because the app takes care of that for you!
- Most locations outside of the UK have up to 30 day charts!
- When information has been downloaded it is stored on the phone so you can view it without an internet connection! 
- It offers a clean interface that you just won't get from other apps! 
- Optimized for the latest iPhone and iPad models.
- Pro version offers the same great functionality of My Tide Times but is ad-free, includes widgets and also includes support for Apple Watch to check the tides on the go (including an Apple Watch complication)!
If you're in need of tide tables, charts, forecasts or times, don't go elsewhere - install My Tide Times today. It's similar to apps like Tides Near Me Free, Hi Tide and Windy.

bluejetty:00074105:ios.description:
With the myRogerMic app you can control your Roger On device from your smartphone. It allows you to customize your microphone settings according to environment and personal preferences.
The myRogerMic app empowers you to:
- Steer the direction of the beam(s) towards the speaker(s) you want to listen to
- Change microphone mode
- Mute / unmute
- Check current device status such as battery level and actual microphone mode.
Compatible models: 
- Roger On™
- Roger On™ iN
- Roger On™ 3
Device compatibility: 
myRogerMic app can be used on smartphones with Bluetooth® Low-Energy (LE) capability and is iOS® Version 14.0 or newer.
To check if your smartphone is compatible, please visit our compatibility checker: https://www.phonak.com/com/en/support/product-support/compatibility.html
The myRogerMic app is compatible with the Phonak Roger On™ with Bluetooth connectivity.

bluejetty:00125883:ios.description:
The sequel to the smash hit mobile game “Virtual Families 2” is here!
A note from the developer:
Hi, and thanks for taking a look at Virtual Families 3! We have been working on it for quite a while, and we’re very happy to be able to finally share this new chapter with everyone. 
With Virtual Families 2 being downloaded over 40 million times, we are so grateful to our dedicated fans and humbled by all your kind words and support! You are the reason we set out to make the third chapter of Virtual Families! We spent years crafting an experience would live up to your expectations, and we plan to continue to listen to all your feedback to make it better with every update! 
Before you skip down to the bullet points and screenshots, let me say a few quick words about this game, and life simulations in general: I love life simulation games. I have always been passionate about designing them, and almost everything that comes out of Last Day of Work is a life sim of some kind. This one, in particular, thrills me so much because it is designed to have a life of its own: unpredictable and so different each time I play it, and each time another player plays it. I love that the story unfolds differently for everyone who plays it, and your experience with the game might be wildly different from your friends’ experiences.
Designing this type of game, however, has its own special challenges. The main challenge is that EVERYTHING in life is a great idea to add to a game like this. There are SO many great ideas, and we simply cannot put them all in at launch. So, while I hope the game captivates you as much as it does us, there will inevitably be things that you feel are missing and you would love to see added (tell us!).
We plan to update the content in this game. We want to add improved pets that are more like real life, more storyline, more events, tons of new things to buy, and the list goes on and on. We will also continue to tune and deepen all the game's inner workings that control happiness, health, and everything else. While the game has been balanced to be playable for free and without purchasing anything, we hope that you will find something compelling enough in the game to give us support so that we can continue to create fun new updates.
Enjoy Virtual Families 3! Please visit our Facebook page and our forums to give us your own amazing ideas and suggestions, and don’t forget to check in on your little family or they will get very sad. :)
With sincere gratitude, 
Arthur Humphrey
Lead Designer, Last Day of Work
Virtual Families 3 has all this and more:
* Adopt a little person and start a family. Make babies and pass the house on to the kids!
* Train your little people to behave as you wish by praising and scolding them.
* Create your family the way you choose, with the same diversity that you would expect in real life!
* Your little people will send you messages, thanking, pleading, and praising you for caring for them.
* Runs in True Real Time. Your little people continue to live, eat, grow, and work when the app is switched off.
* Your little family is in your time zone! Is it getting dark where you live? Your little family is probably getting ready for bed then...
* Highly varied, unpredictable game play. No two games run the same. 
* Make babies. Cure illnesses. Help nurture and guide generations of your family.
* Restore the house. Remodel rooms and add new ones. Shop and decorate.
Recommended for people who enjoy Virtual Villagers and other life simulation games!
Visit our Official Virtual Families site at www.VirtualFamilies.com for instructions, strategy guides, and much more! 
LDW games have been awarded with:
* Sim Game of the Year – Game Tunnel
* The Zeebys – Gamezebo
* Parents Choice Recommended Award
* iParenting Media Award
Check out our other hit games like Virtual Town, Fish Tycoon, Virtual Villagers, and more at https://itunes.apple.com/us/developer/ldw-software-llc/id297606729

bluejetty:00088841:ios.description:
iKlips 5.0 
Whole New Design, Unrivalled Experience
The iKlips 5.0 app is exactly what you need for taking full advantage of each iKlips feature. Featuring 3D Touch support, multi-select, Spilt View, password protection and many more useful functions, the intuitive iKlips app elevates your enjoyable iKlips experience to another level. 
Better yet, iKlips 5.0 features a newly redesigned interface for iPad and iPad Pro to take advantage of its larger screen real estate instead of just blowing up iPhone’s.
The ability to organize, backup and share with friends, family and colleagues on the go gives you the power to do more. iKlips is the only way you’ll want to manage your digital assets !
-Auto Backup While Charging
Put your phone on a wireless charger with iKlips plugged in, the backup process starts automatically. 
-User-friendly File Icons
The new icons help you recognize the file types fast and easily. 
-HEIF Files Conversion
Now all the HEIF files on iKlips can be converted to JPG to provide the most suitable format for your devices. 
-Managing Files, Easy Peasy
iKlips comes in big capacities to be able to store all you file, with file management scheme build to extends the experience from using PC or Mac, managing files or locate particular files got way easier and seamless.
-iKlips Camera, Enhanced!
iKlips camera now has separate controls on exposure and focus, allowing for more advance control imaging.
and off course! high definition photos, even 4K videos are able to record directly onto iKlips, saving your phone space while putting these files in secured devices.
-Device, Cloud, Got Them Altogether
The powerful back up functions of iKlips is designed to secure every precious moments, instantly back up all your photos, album, and videos, ready to share with friends and folks. never have to worry about data lost, or even worst, connection lost between contacts.
-Apple File App Supported
Apple File App is fully supported by iKlips 5.0. You can access your files on iKlips via either Apple File App or iKlips App. 
-Multi-format Media Support
iKlips 5.0 App — it’s not just a file manager. It’s better than most media players and even supports subtitle files.
-Your Photo, Your Wallpaper
Now you can use your favorite photo as the wallpaper for your iKlips App homepage. 
-Watertight Security
Without the Touch ID or the password, your iKlips cannot be unlocked, keeping your files safe and secure. 
-Split View
iKlips 5.0 is fully compatible with the iPad Split View function, allowing you to work on two apps simultaneously and be even more efficient.
-Cloud Storage
With iKllips 5.0, you can synchronize the files on your iKlips with iCloud, Google Drive, Dropbox and other cloud storage service, which not only gives the convenience of accessing files through different devices but also enhances the data security. 
-AirPlay
For an even better video experience the iKlips 5.0 App can wirelessly play video from your iKlips drive on large TV screens or monitors via Apple AirPlay.

bluejetty:00064441:ios.description:
"Yu-Gi-Oh!" is available on-the-go as a mobile app!
Become the best Duelist in the world!
Anywhere, anytime! Prepare yourself for some sweet Duels!
[ABOUT "Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links"]
-Easy to learn rules and simple controls for beginners!
-Don't worry if you are not sure how to use your cards. The game will indicate when you can activate your cards!
-Among 3 million players who have participated in the past World Championships, even Duelists with only 3-6 months of Duel Links experience have also became a champion.
Duel online and aim for the top of "Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links"!
[FEATURES]
・Supporting features for beginners
-Even beginners can hone their skill by completing the in-game missions.
-You can learn the basics of cards and Duel techniques from various features.
・Beginner's Guide
-Duel Quizzes: You can learn the basic rules from quizzes and you can even receive Gems by completing them!
-Auto-Build Deck: Don't worry even if you have no idea how to build a Deck. Include cards you want to use, and the rest of the Deck will be built to synergize with those cards!
-Auto-Duel: Use this feature if you are not sure how to play with your Deck.
-Ranked Duels: This is a PvP mode, but don't worry! You will get matched with Duelists who are close to you in skill!
-Tons of Rewards: You can get a lot of Gems and Card Exchange Tickets in the early stage of the game!
・Offline Battles
-Duel with your favorite characters from the Yu-Gi-Oh! World
-Complete Stage missions to get various items
-Shop for cards in the game store!
・Various "Yu-Gi-Oh!" characters and monsters from the series
-Duel as Yami Yugi, Seto Kaiba, Jaden Yuki, Yusei Fudo, Yuma Tsukumo, Yuya Sakaki, Playmaker, Yuga Ohdo, Yudias Velgear and many more, from the whole canon!
-Featuring voicework from cast members of the original shows!
-You can play as them by completing certain missions!
-Epic 3D cutscenes when ace monsters are Summoned!
-Build your Deck to become the most powerful Dueling Master, with monsters like "Dark Magician" and "Blue-Eyes White Dragon"
・Online Multiplayer Battles
-Battle other Duelists and their special battle Decks
-PVP battles pit you against players from around the world! 
・Editing a Deck
-Collect cards and form the most powerful Deck for battle! Stay tuned for future card additions!
-Use the cards that you collect in-game to build and edit your trusty Deck to take on opponents!
・Characters
-"Yu-Gi-Oh!": Yami Yugi, Seto Kaiba, Joey Wheeler, Yami Marik, and so on
-"Yu-Gi-Oh! THE DARK SIDE OF DIMENSIONS": Aigami, Sera, and so on
-"Yu-Gi-Oh! GX": Jaden Yuki, Chazz Princeton, Zane Truesdale, and so on
-"Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's": Yusei Fudo, Jack Atlas, Kalin Kessler, and so on
-"Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL": Yuma Tsukumo and Astral, Tori Meadows, Bronk Stone, and so on
-"Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V": Yuya Sakaki, Zuzu Boyle, Gong Strong, and so on
-"Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS": Playmaker and Ai, Soulburner, The Gore, and so on
-"Yu-Gi-Oh! SEVENS": Yuga Ohdo, Lucidien "Luke" Kallister, Gavin Sogetsu, Romin Kassidy, and so on
-"Yu-Gi-Oh! GO RUSH!!": Yudias Velgear, Ohdo Yuhi, Ohdo Yuamu, and so on
[ABOUT "Yu-Gi-Oh!"]
"Yu-Gi-Oh!" is a popular manga created by Kazuki Takahashi that has been serialized in SHUEISHA Inc.'s "WEEKLY SHONEN JUMP" since 1996. Konami Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd. provides a Trading Card Game (TCG) and console games, based on the "Yu-Gi-Oh!" anime series created from the original manga, that are enjoyed around the world.
[Supported OS]
iOS 15.0 and above
[Copyright]
©2020 Studio Dice／SHUEISHA, TV TOKYO, KONAMI
©Konami Digital Entertainment

bluejetty:00151898:ios.description:
Arkansas Weather Network is a locally operated platform created to keep Arkansans informed and prepared, no matter the weather. From severe storms to quiet nights, our goal is to deliver life-saving updates, live radar, and dependable forecasts across every corner of the state. The app provides customizable severe weather alerts, lightning and power outage data, and a 24-hour live stream of weather coverage. You can even submit your own weather photos, videos, and reports to help keep your community safe and informed.
Built by Arkansans who live and work here, AWN is a collaboration between trusted meteorologists and passionate storm trackers who understand the local terrain and the people it affects. Every forecast is personal, every alert is precise, and every stream is real. When the weather turns dangerous, we go live, bringing accurate updates straight to your device. When skies clear, we’re still there—covering your community, schools, and events that matter most.
This is the next generation of weather coverage for Arkansas—real, local, and always connected. Arkansas Weather Network is more than an app; it’s a community built on trust, driven by technology, and powered by the people it serves. Stay aware. Stay safe. Stay Arkansas strong.

bluejetty:00068363:ios.description:
Sign.Plus is a legally-binding electronic signature solution to sign documents on iPhone and iPad devices and send documents for signature. It’s secure, reliable, cross-platform, and super easy to use.
Using this free eSignature app, you can fill and sign PDF documents, Word documents, and other types of supported documents. You can also utilize the paper scanning feature to convert your paper documents to digital documents and sign them electronically.
√ Sign.Plus recognized as the best e-Signature solution to fill and sign documents!
◆ Fill and sign documents: Sign.Plus allows you to create an electronic signature to e-sign documents wherever you are and whenever you want. You can draw a signature, type your signature or use your initials.
◆ Send documents for signature: Other than the option to fill and sign documents yourself, you can also send documents for signature. You can send a request for signature even if the signees do not have a Sign.Plus account. You can add various fields to the documents, including signature, initials, date, text, and checkbox.
◆ Tamper-proof audit trails: For every document that goes into the process of signing electronically, there are real-time logs to keep track of any activity that has occurred with information such as name, IP address, email address, device, and much more. The audit trails are non-editable and each document action is thoroughly tracked and time-stamped, serving as legal proof of receipt, review, and signature.
◆ Legally-binding electronic signature: Sign.Plus complies with electronic signature regulations such as ESIGN, eIDAS, and ZertES to ensure it delivers the same legal standing as pen-and-paper signatures.
► Extensive security measurements and compliance offerings
◆ Data encryption: We encrypt all documents at rest using 256-bit Advanced Encryption Standard (AES), with each user’s unique encryption key. Furthermore, to protect data in transit between our apps (currently mobile, API, web) and our servers, we use TLS 1.2+ encryption.
◆ Various compliance offerings: We are committed to certifying ourselves and our e-signing platform for all relevant certifications and compliances, including SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, GDPR, CCPA, and more.
► Looking for an easy way to e-sign PDF documents? We’ve got you covered
If you are looking for a secure document signing app to fill and sign PDF documents, we are here to help. This free eSignature app offers the easiest online signature experience ever, unlike other form filling and e-sign applications.
You can sign PDF docs, contracts, leases, NDAs, agreements, and pretty much every type of legal document without having to go through a complicated process.
Download Sign.Plus for free on your iOS device, scan/import the document you wish to sign/be signed electronically and, depending on the nature of the document, e-sign it yourself or send it for signature.
Sign.Plus features and advantages:
• Legally-binding electronic signature solution
• Advanced yet easy-to-use document signing platform
• Fill and sign PDF documents
• Send documents for signature
• Create an electronic signature (Type, draw, or use initials)
• Extensive regulatory compliance offerings, including SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, GDPR, CCPA, and more
• Scan documents with your mobile camera (automatic document detection, magnifier, border cropping, perspective correctness)
• Data encryption
• Tamper-proof audit trails
• Save documents as draft
• Get real-time notifications
• Multiple date formats
• Free e signature app to sign documents on iPhone and iPad
* Sign.Plus is HIPAA compliant, provided the user has advanced security controls activated and enters into a business associate agreement (BAA) with Sign.Plus. Advanced security controls are available on the Enterprise plan tier.
Any further questions or requests? Do not hesitate to reach us on our website, app, or by email at support@sign.plus. Our customer support team will be pleased to help you!

Train English: Listening Audio — Learn English by Listening and Reading
Welcome to Train English: Listening Audio, your companion for daily English listening practice. Build comprehension, vocabulary, and pronunciation with audiobooks, news, podcasts, flashcards, and quizzes — from beginner to advanced.
Whether you are preparing for IELTS, improving business English, or just getting started, Train English: Listening Audio helps you learn through real audio and synced text.
LISTEN AND READ TOGETHER
Follow highlighted transcripts while you listen. Tap any word for translation or dictionary audio with natural English pronunciation. Adjustable text size and smoother read-along make reading comfortable on any screen.
YOUR AUDIO, YOUR WAY
• My Audios — paste text or add a link to create voiceovers with synced subtitles
• Save lessons and replay them anytime
• Offline mode — download audio and keep learning without internet
• Share text from your browser straight into the app
MAIN FEATURES
• Placement test — discover your level: Beginner, Intermediate, or Advanced
• Interface available in 10 languages
• Daily updated audio: world news, interviews, and trending topics
• Content by topic: family, business, travel, lifestyle, self-development, and more
• Synchronized, highlighted subtitles — follow every word as you listen
• Tap-to-translate dictionary with audio pronunciation
• Vocabulary flashcards — save words to your personal word bank
• Audiobooks with adjustable font size and background color
• Quizzes and comprehension checks after each lesson
• Smart progress tracker
• Offline downloads for learning anywhere
WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
• English listening comprehension through authentic native audio
• Vocabulary expansion with context-based usage
• Reading fluency through real-time transcripts
• Pronunciation and accent training in British and American English
• Grammar awareness through structured content
• Preparation for IELTS and other English exams
• Business English and everyday phrases from real-life topics
WHY TRAIN ENGLISH: LISTENING AUDIO?
Because real progress comes from consistent practice and natural exposure to the language. With our app, you do not need a textbook or expensive classes — just your phone and a few minutes each day.
Whether you are commuting, walking, or relaxing at home, turn any moment into a learning opportunity. Listen passively, train your ear actively, or sit down for focused study.
If you enjoy the app, please leave us a review — it really helps us grow and support more learners like you.

bluejetty:00160545:ios.summary:

No other countdown app let
bluejetty:00160545:ios.description:
Count down to the moments that matter, with the emoji that captures them perfectly.
Pick a date. Set an emoji. Watch your countdown on your iPhone Duo, Home Screen, Lock Screen, StandBy display, and Apple Watch.
No other countdown app lets you express every event with emoji. From birthdays to vacations to weddings, every countdown looks like the moment it represents.
A COUNTDOWN FOR EVERY OCCASION
Events & Birthdays
Track days until birthdays, anniversaries, graduations, baby showers, and the personal milestones that matter most. Set a birthday once and it reschedules automatically every year.
Holidays & Seasons
Count down to Christmas, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Easter, New Year’s, and every seasonal moment in between. Holiday countdowns roll over automatically year after year.
Weddings & Anniversaries
From save the date to the big day, watch your wedding countdown tick down day by day. Couples use Emoji Countdown to share progress, plan ahead, and savor the anticipation.
Vacations & Trips
Counting days until your next holiday, whether it’s a beach trip, a summer break, or a long weekend? Pair the trip with an emoji and feel the excitement build every time you glance at your phone.
Retirement & Life Milestones
Counting down to retirement, your last day of work, a house move, or a new chapter? Big life changes deserve their own widget. Pin them to your Home Screen and reclaim a little anticipation.
Daily Reminders
Use Emoji Countdown as a visual reminder for deadlines, fitness goals, exam dates, and weekly recurring events. Your countdown list works like a calendar, only easier to glance at and harder to forget.
FEATURES
• Free Home Screen, Lock Screen, and StandBy widgets so you can see every countdown at a glance, no subscription required
• Apple Watch app for checking countdowns from your wrist
• Calendar import: one tap pulls birthdays, holidays, and deadlines straight from your iOS Calendar
• Any emoji, any color, so every countdown matches the moment it represents
• Widget customization with colors, gradients, blur effects, borders, and themes so every widget looks exactly the way you want
• Repeating events: set a birthday or holiday once and it rolls over automatically each year
• Dark Mode support
• iCloud sync across iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch
• No ads, no clutter, just your countdowns
FAQ
Is Emoji Countdown free?
Yes. Free to download, and the Home Screen, Lock Screen, and StandBy widgets are included.
Can I make a wedding, birthday, or holiday countdown?
Yes. Emoji Countdown works for weddings, birthdays, anniversaries, graduations, Christmas, Halloween, vacations, retirement, and anything else worth waiting for.
Does it work on Apple Watch?
Yes. The native Apple Watch app lets you check every countdown from your wrist.
Can I add countdowns to my Home Screen and Lock Screen?
Yes. Add a widget to your Home Screen, Lock Screen, or StandBy display and your countdown stays visible at a glance.
Can I import events from my calendar?
Yes. One tap pulls birthdays, holidays, and deadlines straight from your iOS Calendar.
Will my countdowns sync across my devices?
Yes. iCloud keeps everything in sync across iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch.
Can I customize how the widget looks?
Yes. Pick any emoji and any color, then choose from gradients, blur effects, borders, and themes to make every widget look exactly the way you want.
Do birthdays and holidays repeat every year?
Yes. Set a recurring event once and Emoji Countdown rolls it over automatically each year.
Privacy policy: https://www.iubenda.com/privacy-policy/42970297

---- Glow up your look and unlock your full beauty potential. ----
***** Join over 500,000 users! *****
Glowup is the #1 AI makeup assistant, designed to help you master any makeup look with confidence. Whether you're exploring a new style or recreating a viral trend, Glowup’s advanced beauty tech shows you exactly how it’ll look on you—and gives you the step-by-step routine and product list to make it real. From natural to glam, Glowup helps you look and feel your best, effortlessly.
HOW TO USE GLOWUP (previously GlamAI) – MAKEUP & BEAUTY:
1) Download Glowup - #1 Makeup & Beauty App
2) Take a selfie of your bare face that you want to apply makeup styles to
3) Upload your own makeup look or choose from trending styles within Glowup
4) Receive a custom makeup routine tailored to your features*
Glowup is your personal makeup assistant. Simply upload a no-makeup selfie and a makeup look you love—whether it's a natural beat, bold glam, or a viral trend—and our advanced AI will apply that makeup style to your face. You'll instantly see how it looks on you and get a step-by-step makeup routine with the exact products to recreate it. Glowup makes discovering and mastering makeup effortless, personalized, and fun.
**WHY THOUSANDS TRUST GLOWUP**
With AI-powered technology, Glowup takes the guesswork out of makeup, helping you achieve flawless results with ease. No more struggling to figure out how to recreate a look or which products to use!
GLOWUP MAKES BEAUTY EASIER
- Preview your final makeup look before applying
Take the guesswork out of your routine. Glowup applies your chosen makeup style directly to your selfie, so you can see exactly how it’ll look on you—before picking up a single brush. Visualize, tweak, and perfect your look with total confidence.
- Get personalized product recommendations
 No more guessing which foundation, lipstick, or eyeshadow will work best. Glowup provides customized product recommendations based on your skin tone, facial features, and the makeup look you want to achieve, ensuring a perfect match for your beauty needs.
- Step-by-step makeup routine tailored to you
 Receive a fully personalized routine with easy-to-follow steps, guiding you through the process of recreating your chosen look. Whether you're a beginner or a pro, Glowup simplifies application and helps you achieve a polished, professional result.
- Pro beauty tips tailored to your skin type and tone
Glowup’s AI analyzes your skin to deliver expert advice made just for you. 
FEATURES & BENEFITS
AI-powered virtual makeup assistant for effortless beauty looks
Try on styles virtually before applying them
Personalized, step-by-step makeup routines tailored to your features
Expert product recommendations based on your skin tone
Access trending looks from celebrities, influencers, and viral trends
Learn techniques like contouring, blending, and brows with AI coaching
Please note: Glowup does not provide medical or dermatological advice. All recommendations are for informational purposes only. Always consult a professional before trying new beauty products or techniques.

bluejetty:00157782:ios.description:
Printer Mini App is a convenient and efficient mobile printing tool that allows you to easily print various documents, photos, and web pages anytime, anywhere. No matter where you are, you can send the files in your phone to the printer with just a few taps for quick printing. Printer Mini App supports various printer brands and models to meet your different needs.
Main functions:
●Local printing: Supports connecting to local printers, including Wi-Fi printers, Bluetooth printers, and USB printers.
●Remote printing: Connect to remote printers via the Internet for remote printing.
●Document printing: Supports printing documents in various formats, including PDF, Word, Excel, PPT, etc.
●Photo printing: Supports printing photos in mobile phone albums, and provides various photo editing functions.
●Web page printing: Supports printing web page content, including articles, pictures, etc.
●Cloud printing: Supports connecting to cloud printing services for cloud printing.
●Print settings: Provides rich print setting options, including paper size, number of copies, print orientation, etc.
●Printer management: Conveniently manage connected printers, including adding, deleting, editing, etc.
●AI translation: One-click translation of multiple languages, allowing you to easily convert the translation before printing.

– Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
– Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
– Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00015740:ios.description:
Watch the states come to life as you learn US geography!
Stack the States® is back and better than ever with new question types, new bonus games, voice mode, 3D graphics and a detailed interactive map!
As you learn state capitals, cities, shapes, landmarks, flags and more, you can actually touch, move and drop the animated states anywhere on the screen. Carefully build a stack of states that reaches the checkered line to win each level.
You earn a new state for every successfully completed level. All of your states appear on your own personalized map of the United States. Try to collect all 50! As you earn more states, you begin to unlock the free bonus games: Map It, Connect 2 and Capital Tap. Four games in one!
What’s new in Stack the States® 2:
- New question types
- New bonus games: Connect 2 and Capital Tap
- New voice mode that helps non-readers play independently
- Brand new interactive map featuring major cities and a 3D elevation view of each state
- Beautiful 3D graphics
- 10 different 3D scenes depicting various locations in the US
- 3D models of over 90 US landmarks
Plus, all the great features that you loved from the original Stack the States®:
- 50 flash cards — one for each state
- Hundreds of unique questions
- Up to six player profiles
- A personalized map of the US
- Fun sound effects and music
- Works on both iPhone and iPad - a universal app
Stack the States® 2 is an educational app for all ages that's actually FUN to play. Try it now and enjoy four games for the price of one!
PRIVACY DISCLOSURE
Stack the States® 2:
- Does not contain 3rd party ads.
- Does not contain in-app purchases.
- Does not contain integration with social networks.
- Does not use 3rd party analytics / data collection tools.
- Does include links to apps by Dan Russell-Pinson in the iTunes App Store (via Performance Horizon).
For more information on our privacy policy please visit:
http://dan-russell-pinson.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00153735:ios.name: AI Cleaner - GuruZen
bluejetty:00153735:ios.summary:
AI-Powered Storage Cleaner App!
This app is built on advanced AI technology and is specifically designed to solve the problem of insufficient device storage. By leveraging powerful AI analysis capabilities, it helps users identify and remov
bluejetty:00153735:ios.description:
AI-Powered Storage Cleaner App!
This app is built on advanced AI technology and is specifically designed to solve the problem of insufficient device storage. By leveraging powerful AI analysis capabilities, it helps users identify and remove unnecessary files, duplicate files, and similar content, freeing up storage space and ensuring smoother, more efficient device performance.
FEATURES
AI Smart Cleaning
- Uses cutting-edge AI recognition technology to scan and categorize images and videos on the device (such as people, landscapes, food, etc.), enabling precise file management. Users can delete files from a specific category with one tap, quickly removing unwanted photos or videos.
Duplicate File Cleanup
- Conducts an in-depth scan of all images on the device, accurately identifying identical files. Users can efficiently delete redundant images in one click, freeing up valuable storage space.
Similar File Cleanup
- Detects photos and videos that are similar but not identical (e.g., burst shots, multiple images of the same scene). The app provides an intuitive comparison interface, allowing users to select the best photos or videos while removing unnecessary duplicates. This is especially useful for burst shots, screenshot management, and improving photo album organization.
Contacts Cleanup
- Identifies and removes duplicate contacts, reducing redundancy and improving contact list organization.
Video Compression
- Compresses video files without quality loss, reducing storage usage and effectively saving space.
BEST USE CASES
- When your phone is running out of storage and you need to free up space efficiently.
- When you have taken a large number of similar photos and want to quickly pick the best ones while deleting redundant ones.
- When video files are taking up too much space and need optimization through compression.
- When your contact list is cluttered with duplicate or invalid contacts that need to be cleaned up.
Make Storage Management Smarter, Easier, and More Efficient!

Enjoy secure real-time banking anywhere, anytime with our award-winning mobile banking app.

- New opt-in alerts for loans and credit card overdue and coming due.

• Practice mathematics
• Improve problem-solving skills
• Save time while studying
It’s a useful learning tool for students who want quick and reliable math help.

Benefits:
• Instant results
• Accurate solutions
• Easy scanning
• Smooth performance
• User-friendly design
Everything you need in one math app.

bluejetty:00085736:ios.summary: Dive into the action with Dinosaur Dash, a children's app that skillfully merges the excitement of running games with a delightful mix of dinosaur and robot themes. Ideal for kids who crave dynamic gameplay and imaginative scenarios, this g
bluejetty:00085736:ios.description:
Dive into the action with Dinosaur Dash, a children's app that skillfully merges the excitement of running games with a delightful mix of dinosaur and robot themes. Ideal for kids who crave dynamic gameplay and imaginative scenarios, this game showcases 12 impressive mech designs. Each mech is equipped with robust propulsion modules suitable for jet-powered flights and ground movements, boasting unique styles and eye-catching paint jobs that are sure to intrigue young minds.
Dinosaur Dash invites players to navigate through four distinct themed environments: Laboratory, Space Base, Dinosaur Planet, and Ocean World. Spread across 20 well-designed levels, each filled with traps and obstacles, the game offers a challenging yet rewarding adventure run for kids. With the aid of shields and shockwaves, players can overcome these challenges and push forward towards their objectives.
The excitement reaches its peak in a high-stakes boss chase where players must pursue a crafty little dinosaur that, having failed in its dark plots, attempts to flee in its own mech. This pursuit will test players’ reflexes and strategic thinking, ideal for enhancing children's focus and reaction skills.
Designed with young users in mind, Dinosaur Dash features intuitive touch-screen controls that allow children to independently operate their mechs without the need for parental guidance. This makes it a fantastic option for preschool and toddler running games. It’s a running game that offers a safe and family-friendly environment.
Join the global community of Dinosaur Dash players and delve into a world where fun running games meet robot adventures. It’s more than just an interactive running game; it’s a platform for children to develop a sense of justice, improve decision-making skills, and experience the thrill of adventure in a secure and educational setting.
So, if you're searching for an educational runner app that combines the thrill of adventure with enriching learning opportunities, Dinosaur Dash is the perfect choice. Download now and let your child embark on an exciting journey through vibrant landscapes, learning and growing with every step of the journey.

Yateland's educational apps ignite the passion for learning through play among preschool children worldwide. We stand by our motto: "Apps that children love and parents trust." For more information about Yateland and our apps, please visit https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy:
Yateland is committed to protecting user privacy. To understand how we handle these matters, please read our complete privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00096426:ios.description:
Looking for a clean, modern, and easy-to-use app to organize your ministry, record time, and keep your notes in one place?
Ministry Assistant helps you plan, record, and manage your ministry activity effortlessly — securely and privately, with your data kept on your device unless you choose to sync it.
Key Features:
Time tracking: record your service time with precision and simplicity.
Goals and reports: set personal goals, track progress, and view automatic summaries.
Notes and addresses: save details of interested ones and Bible students, add visit notes, and keep everything neatly organized.
Statistics and graphs: get visual summaries of your monthly and yearly activity.
Appointments and schedule: plan your service days, set reminders, and manage appointments.
Timer: built-in stopwatch for accurate time measurement.
Congregation (new): meeting schedules, territories, public witnessing and reports for the whole congregation, synced and end-to-end encrypted.
Privacy First:
Your data belongs to you.
Your personal records stay on your device. Backup, sync and congregation features are optional, and congregation data is end-to-end encrypted — no ads, and analytics only with your consent.
Why Ministry Assistant?
Modern, minimalist design optimized for clarity and focus.
Everything you need for ministry organization — in one place.
Fast, private, and completely ad-free.
Ministry Assistant — your personal companion for effective, organized, and private ministry.
Plan your service, track your progress, and stay focused on what matters most.

bluejetty:00041162:ios.description:
Trapped on a strange island, Kevin and Cheese struggle to return home.
There are also terrifying monsters and other lost people on the island.
Please help the Cheese get home safely!
[Roguelike Dungeon Crawler]
- Maps are automatically generated by the algorithm.
- You can enjoy every battle with a new pattern.
- In each battle, the battle proceeds by strategically combining 15 or more different skills.
- Defeat the 80 unique monsters with different patterns.
[Party Mode]
Create a party and explore the dungeon!
- You can choose from 21 different characters.
- Each character can use different skills.
- A party consists of 4 characters who will fight together.
- You can use different combinations of characters to play through the dungeons.
[Resource collection and construction]
- You can construct buildings with resources collected from dungeons and islands.
- Make various buildings to make it easier to escape.
[There is an ending!]
- Meet NPCs and follow the story as you explore 4 islands.
- Will Kevin and Cheese eventually escape the island at the end of the story?
- The warm sensibility of pixel art and light and shadow are waiting for you here!
-----

This app is suitable for various scenarios,
bluejetty:00127091:ios.description:
The Whiteboard App always adheres to the concept of "simplicity to the extreme" and "Nothing more Nothing less". Despite offering many small tools, its interface remains simple and user-friendly.
This app is suitable for various scenarios, including teaching, creativity, meeting presentations, prototype design, and learning drafts, among others. It provides users with a variety of universally applicable paper formats, objects, and prototype designs to choose from. It also offers instant drawing of geometric shapes, making teaching, creativity, and on-site communication more convenient. Additionally, it can be used for students' homework drafts, doodling, note-taking, temporary notepads, word dictation, and math problems, among other purposes. Users highly praise its simple and easy-to-use button layout and tool exit mechanism.
The app offers two forms of creating new files, allowing users to choose the one that suits them best:
- The first form is a multi-page file (Pages), where each page serves as a canvas with size limitations, similar to a PDF file. This makes it easy to organize knowledge.
- The second form is a free-form file (Free Form), where a file consists of one infinitely large canvas without boundaries. This allows for unlimited creativity.
The app also supports direct import of PDF files, even large files with hundreds or thousands of pages, without crashing. It opens instantly.
Features:
- Small storage space
- Simple operation
- Clean interface
- Quick startup
- Rich functionality
Welcome to download and experience the Whiteboard App as soon as possible!

- Email: chenlidong@gmail.com

bluejetty:00122580:ios.description:

You will get immediate secure online banking access anywhere, anytime and enjoy the following features such as;

• Transfer funds between accounts
• Easily deposit checks to your account using Mobile Deposit*
• Mange your Community Bank debit cards
• Schedule payments and pay bills right from your mobile device
• Use Bill Capture to create new payments
• Locate Community Bank Branches and ATM’s
Security & Privacy of your information is always a top priority at Community Bank of Pickens County. We utilize the same security and encryption features that are available on our online banking system. The CBOPC Mobile app does not store any personal or financial information on your mobile device. So, you can feel confident when using our mobile service that you are safe with us!
*In order to use the CBOPC Mobile app you must be a Community Bank Online Banking user. To sign up for Online Banking please contact someone in customer service for assistance. 
*Mobile Deposit is available to qualifying customers. See customer service for more information.
