bluejetty:00041000:ios.name: QTc-Calculator
bluejetty:00041000:ios.summary:
QTc Calculator corrects the QT interval for heart rate, with nine published formulas at once instead of just one.
Bazett is still the formula most ECG machines use, but it overestimates the QTc at higher heart rates and underestimates it a
bluejetty:00041000:ios.description:
QTc Calculator corrects the QT interval for heart rate, with nine published formulas at once instead of just one.
Bazett is still the formula most ECG machines use, but it overestimates the QTc at higher heart rates and underestimates it at lower ones. QTc Calculator shows you right away how the result changes with other formulas, and where it sits relative to published reference limits and population data.
FORMULAS
Bazett, Fridericia, Framingham, Hodges, Rautaharju (two versions), Mayeda, Kawataki and Goto, side by side. Choose which formulas you want to see and in which order. Each result comes with a chart of the QTc distribution in the general population (Vandenberk et al. 2016) and a short note on the formula's strengths and weaknesses.
START FROM QT OR FROM QTc
Enter heart rate (or RR interval) and QT, or start from a QTc printed by the ECG machine. The app calculates the QT back from the formula the QTc came from and converts it to all other formulas.
J-POINT CALCULATIONS
With a QRS duration, the app adds the JT interval, the heart-rate-corrected JTrr (Rautaharju) and the JTc of each formula. For wide QRS complexes, such as in bundle branch block, it shows QTmc (Bogossian).
REFERENCE LIMITS
Results are color-coded against the short and long QT limits of your choice: ESC 2022, ESC 2015, AHA 2009, ESC 2005, FDA 2005, Gollob 2011, Mazzanti 2014, Goldenberg 2006 (including limits for children and adolescents) and Schwartz 1985/1993. Separate limits for women and men.
SCORES
• Gollob Score for Short QT Syndrome
• Long QT Score (Schwartz, as in the ESC guidelines 2022)
• Tisdale Score for the risk of drug-induced QT prolongation in hospitalized patients
All scores open with the points for the QTc you just calculated.
BASELINE COMPARISON
Enter a previous ECG as a baseline. The app marks it in every chart and tells you when the QTc has increased by more than 60 msec.
MADE FOR DAILY USE
• Plausibility checks catch typos and unusual values right below the input field.
• Notices for heart rates outside the range where QTc formulas are most reliable.
• A guide to measuring the QT interval correctly (threshold and tangent method).
• Share or copy a summary of all results.
• Two-column layout on iPad and on iPhone Duo when unfolded.
• Color-blind mode (blue instead of green).
• English and German.
PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. The app does not connect to the internet. Your inputs stay on your device.
ALL SOURCES INCLUDED
Every formula, limit and score names its literature source. All references are listed in the app.
IMPORTANT
QTc Calculator is a calculation and reference tool for healthcare professionals. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment recommendations and does not replace clinical judgment.
Please note: This app provides only information, is not medical or treatment advice and may not be treated as such by the user. As such, this App may not be relied upon for the purposes of medical diagnosis or as a recommendation for medical care or treatment. The information on this App is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. All content, including text, graphics, images and information, contained on or available through this App is for general information purposes only.
Professional Medical Advice and Assistance
You are strongly encouraged to confirm any information obtained from or through this App with your physician or another professional healthcare provider and to review all information regarding any medical condition or treatment with your physician or other a professional healthcare provider.

AI Detector & Humanizer combines advanced AI detection technology with a powerful humanization engine to accurately identify and transform AI-generated content. Whether you're dealing with text or images, this app offers precise detection and the ability to make AI content sound natural and human-like.
Key Features:
AI Text Detection
Effortlessly detect AI-generated text from any source. Simply paste text, upload files, or extract content from documents to quickly identify AI generation. Our sophisticated AI detection algorithms deliver fast and reliable results across various formats.
Multiple Format Support: Works with DOC, PDF, TXT, and more
Instant Text Detection: Real-time scanning of pasted text
Cross-Validation with Leading Detection Models: Ensures high accuracy from multiple detectors
Detailed Probability Breakdown: Get insights into the likelihood of AI-generated content
Advanced Image Detection
Our AI-powered image detector provides a deep analysis to identify AI-generated visuals. Instantly detect whether an image was created by AI and understand its authenticity.
Instant Image Analysis: Upload and analyze images immediately
AI Art Model Detection: Identify the specific AI model used for the image
Authenticity Scoring: Evaluate the image's credibility with a detailed score
AI Manipulation Detection: Recognize alterations in real photos
AI Text Humanizer
Turn detectable AI-generated text into natural, human-like content that bypasses standard AI detectors. Our humanization engine preserves the original meaning while adjusting the text to sound more human and authentic.
Smart Rewording Technology: Transform AI text for a more natural flow
Key Message Preservation: Keep the original tone and intent intact
Multiple Style Options: Customize the output to suit your needs
Perfect For:
Educators needing accurate AI content verification
Content Creators ensuring originality and authenticity
Publishers checking content integrity
Researchers validating AI-generated sources
Why Choose AI Detector & Humanizer?
Unmatched Accuracy
Leverage the power of multiple detection models to ensure reliable and accurate identification of AI-generated content.
Regular Updates
Stay ahead of rapidly evolving AI technology with regular app updates, ensuring your detector remains up-to-date.
Easy-to-Use
With a user-friendly interface, AI Detector & Humanizer makes content detection and transformation simple and accessible.
Try AI Detector & Humanizer Today!
Discover the most powerful tool for detecting and humanizing AI content. Whether you’re analyzing text, images, or transforming AI content into human-like text, AI Detector & Humanizer is your go-to solution.

bluejetty:00182707:ios.description:
Cool retro pinball game with customizable tables. A flippin' good time. Discover powerballs. Collect mods. Test your pinball skills on 14 different tables:
- Explore the galaxy in "Space Frontier" 
- Over 50 levels of brick breaking in "Brix"
- Play in reverse gravity in the Mirror House at the "Carnival"
- Be a sheriff in "Wild West" and run the bandits out of town
- Dive to the bottom of the sea in "Treasure Hunter" 
- See how many runs you can score in "Fastball"
- Go old school, really old, with "Bagaball"
- Reconfigure the layout of "The Apparatus"
- Become an 18th century shipping tycoon in "Tradewinds"
- Play to the beat of tunes from the Celtic Jukebox
- Tee off with your favorite dinosaurs in "Jurassic Links"
- You are in the driver's seat and your passengers need Rydes!
- Dragons gone wild in "Dragonwatch"
- Step onto the training pitch in "Futball Camp"
Go for the high score with Pinball Deluxe: Reloaded and relive the good old days of the arcade. Explore the unique play style on each table. Will you be able to unlock all the mini-games and beat the wizard modes? Collect mods to customize the table to your skills to score big. PD:R will reward your quick reflexes with plenty of action and also trophies for your exploits with the silver ball.
Things to love about Pinball Deluxe:
- WOW graphics
- Award winning table design
- Precise physics
- Collectible mods for table customization
- Mini-games on the matrix display
- Unique play style on each table
- Powerballs
- Online multiplayer mode
- Fun challenges and achievements

bluejetty:00116976:ios.description:
Welcome to FlareFlow: 1-Minute Dramas! — Your next binge-worthy obsession starts here! 
Every swipe brings a new HD mini-drama—romance, revenge, thrill, fantasy—multiple genres to satisfy your binge cravings. Watch anytime, anywhere, with fast updates and endless excitement. One swipe = full story arc! 
Why You’ll Love FlareFlow
Watch fast-paced dramas anytime, anywhere
Immersive experience across multiple genres 
High-quality stories tailored just for you 
Premium perks with exclusive surprises for members
Quick & Addictive Mini-Dramas – Watch Anytime, Anywhere!
Catch exciting 1-minute dramas wherever you are—on your commute, during a break, or just relaxing at home. Fast-paced episodes make it easy to enjoy a full story in just minutes, giving you instant entertainment whenever you want. 
Diverse Genres – Stories You’ll Love
From romance, suspense, and fantasy to revenge, thrillers, and heartwarming tales, FlareFlow brings you a rich variety of short dramas. Our smart recommendation engine learns what you like and serves up the stories you’ll want to watch next. Every mood, every taste, covered.
Regular Updates – Never Run Out of Drama
FlareFlow is constantly refreshed with new episodes and mini-series every day. Whether you’re craving lighthearted fun, thrilling twists, or emotional storytelling, there’s always something new waiting to keep your watchlist full and your binge continuous.
Immersive HD Playback – Control Your Experience
Enjoy crystal-clear, high-definition playback for maximum immersion. Adjust the speed to suit your mood, join in with interactive comments, and experience your favorite stories like never before. Every episode is crafted for an engaging, cinematic feel—even in just one minute! 
Personalized Recommendations – Perfect Matches for You 
Skip the endless searching! FlareFlow learns your taste and delivers short dramas tailored to you. From trending originals to must-watch mini-series, your next obsession is always just a tap away. 
Seamless User Experience – Watch Your Way
Enjoy uninterrupted viewing with an ad-free experience, save your favorites to revisit anytime, and show your love with likes and collections. Every feature is designed to make your mini-drama journey smooth, fun, and personal.
VIP Perks – Unlock Exclusive Content 
Become a FlareFlow VIP and enjoy exclusive content not available elsewhere, watch ad-free, and download episodes to watch offline anytime. Plus, get access to full HD for a premium viewing experience and unlock additional member-only surprises! 
Featured Shows:
Mothering My Husband's Bastard— Isabella barely survives childbirth, only to find her husband celebrating his child with his mistress. When they plot to steal her fortune by harming her baby, she fights back, proving they’ve underestimated her. 
Oops, I Married My Bestie's Brother!— Elle accidentally marries a stranger in Vegas, only to discover he’s her best friend’s brother. As secrets and misunderstandings unfold, a drunken mistake turns into a slow-burn romance full of family drama and laughs. 
She Means Justice — Legendary attorney Samantha Maddock must protect her pregnant daughter from a dangerous client’s son. Can she take down the untouchable elite and seek justice for her family? 
Download FlareFlow now and start your unforgettable journey!

User Agreement: [https://flareflow.tv/terms.html](https://flareflow.tv/terms.html)

bluejetty:00184894:ios.description:
The simplest VLC Remote you'll ever find. Period. But now the simplest VLC Remote is also a complete Mac Remote & PC Remote app.
Groping in the dark for keyboard shortcuts whilst watching a movie or racing to your computer in the middle of a steamy date just to change the music track? well, you'll no longer have to do that.
Meet VLC media player’s most compatible, up-to-date and user-friendly partner—VLC Mobile Remote for iOS. VLC M Remote is the most convenient way of controlling VLC Player from your smartphones and tablets. No more couch-to-computer workouts. If you watch movies and videos offline or online on your computers, this VLC Remote gives you the awesome power to control VLC Media Player wherever you're seated, whether in the kitchen or in the garden.
Just install the app, sit back, relax and remotely control VLC Player, Netflix, YouTube and Amazon Prime from the couch. 
Works well with VLC running on both Desktops & Laptops based Windows, Mac OS or Linux.
"This is the best remote app for VLC and can't even think about watching movies without it" - Vishal
"App does everything I need it to with a modern UI and nice features. Setup is very in-depth and simple to understand" - Colby347
Remote for VLC
This VLC Remote Control App lets you control VLC Media Player on your desktop or laptop and allows you to browse, play your computer files as well as YouTube videos.
+ With this VLC Remote App, You don't need to install any software on your PC or Mac! (or alternatively, install our helper app, VMR Connect to your PC/Mac for easy setup)
+ 'Setup Wizard' step by step guide makes it easy to setup VLC Media Player with this VLC Remote app.
+ Control VLC from Apple Watches
+ This VLC Remote App auto connects to VLC Player when you're on same Wi-Fi
+ Stop, Play and Pause
+ Control volume, next track and previous track
+ Seek control, fast forward and fast rewind
+ Toggle full-screen, Repeat, Shuffle, Loop, Aspect Ratio, Audio Track
+ Manage Subtitle, playback speed, crop
+ DVD Controls
+ Use this app as a PC remote to access all your media files.
+ Works as a YouTube remote.
+ Manage playlist
+ Add subtitle files to currently playing video (supports .srt files only and requires VLC v2.2.0 or up).
+ Play online media files (Website videos, radio channels etc)
+ Take screenshot or snap of video frame
+ Set a folder as 'Home location'
+ Save favourite folders
+ Home Screen Widget & Notification controls
+ Lock screen notification controls/widget
+ Incoming call handling with soft pause & soft resume options
+ Use device volume buttons to control VLC volume
+ Handle multiple files on the saved computer
+ Fast scrolling on browse & playlists
+ Switch Audio output devices
+ Sort Browse list
+ Save multiple host/computer addresses
+ Quit VLC Media player directly from the App
PC Remote & Mac Remote (Windows & Mac)
With VMR Connect on your Windows PC or Mac, it also works as a complete Remote for your PC or Mac. This app is the most convenient way to watch not only offline videos but also online videos from Netflix, YouTube, Amazon Prime, HBO, HotStar etc.
+ Mouse & Keyboard Remote
+ System Power Control (Shutdown, restart, sleep etc)
+ Works as Netflix Remote, Amazon Prime Remote, YouTube Remote.
+ Remote control for any media player.
+ Launch and Control Chrome, Firefox or any other internet browser on your PC/Mac.
All You Need 
+ VLC Media player ( v2.0 or newer) on your Windows PC, Mac computers or Linux PC
+ Common local network (LAN or WiFi) connection between your phone & desktop or laptop
+ Install VMR Connect (Optional) to Windows PC or Mac from https://vlcmobileremote.com/download
Supported Operating Systems 
+ Works as a VLC Remote with Windows, OSX/Mac OS and Linux operating systems.
+ With Windows systems, works as a PC Remote Controller.
+ Also Works as Mac Remote for Mac OS running devices.
Visit our website for more info - https://vlcmobileremote.com/
"Terms of Use: https://vlcmobileremote.com/terms/"

bluejetty:00150645:ios.description:
The Citizens Savings Bank Mobile App is a free mobile decision support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances. 
Features: Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization. Make mobile deposits and transfer funds easily.
Bill Pay with Bill Discovery: Pay people or merchants. The app will automatically identify bills within your list of transactions and display a reminder to you when upcoming bills are due.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Contact: Locate Citizens Savings Bank branches and ATMs and contact Citizens Savings Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE: The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. 
Getting Started: To use the Citizens Savings Bank Mobile App, you can enroll as a mobile user only or enroll and use it on your desktop or tablet as well. Simply download the app, launch it, and tap the ENROLL NOW link and follow the prompts. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.
Additional Features:
• View an instant balance on your home screen
• Make a loan payment
• Link to Open an Account
• Enable Touch ID or Face ID for a fast and safe way to access your account
• Transfer funds between your Citizens Savings Bank Accounts and accounts held at other financial institutions
• Send and receive money to people you know and trust using email addresses or mobile numbers (Zelle®)
• Receive text messages alerts related to your accounts
Citizens Savings Bank’s administrative offices are located at 500 South State Street in Clarks Summit, PA 18411. Branch locations include Clarks Summit, 538 South State Street, Clarks Summit, PA 18411; South Scranton, 702 Cedar Ave., Scranton 18505, PA; West Scranton, 156 South Main Ave., Scranton, PA 18504; Taylor, 137 South Main Ave., Taylor, PA 18517; Honesdale, 335 Willow Ave., Honesdale, PA 18431 and Mount Pocono, 1421 Mount Pocono Blvd., Mount Pocono, PA 18344.

Arizona Mobile ID allows you to control what information you share during a transaction. For ex
bluejetty:00181690:android.description:
Including layers of security and privacy controls, Arizona Mobile ID is a contactless, convenient way to verify your identity from your phone. 
Arizona Mobile ID allows you to control what information you share during a transaction. For example, when buying age-restricted items, the app can confirm you are of legal age without having to share your birth date or address.
Intuitive and easy-to-use, Mobile ID is unlocked by a selfie match to verify identity, or by using a self-selected pin or TouchID/FaceID so your personal information is always protected.
In five simple steps, you can register for your Arizona mID:
1. Download the app and set permissions
2. Register your phone number 
3. Use your device camera to scan the front and back of your driver’s license or ID card
4. Follow the app’s registration steps to take a selfie 
5. Set up app security and you’re good to go! 
Arizona Mobile ID can be used to verify a person’s identity to complete enhanced-verification services online, such as transferring a vehicle title and requesting a disbursement at AZMVDNow.gov, MVD’s primary customer self-service website.
Please note: Arizona Mobile ID is considered an official state-issued ID, serving as a companion to your physical ID. Please continue to carry your physical ID because not all entities are able to verify mID yet. 
For more information, please visit https://mobileid.az.gov 
This app requires Android 7 or newer. Android 10-based EMUI 10 devices are NOT supported.

bluejetty:00131049:ios.name: Voice Translator: Translate AI
bluejetty:00131049:ios.summary: Voice Translator AI is the perfect tool for seamless communication with people from around the world. Whether you're traveling, working, or making new connections, this app offers fast, accurate, and natural translations in real time. With
bluejetty:00131049:ios.description:
Voice Translator AI is the perfect tool for seamless communication with people from around the world. Whether you're traveling, working, or making new connections, this app offers fast, accurate, and natural translations in real time. With advanced AI technology, it transforms your device into a personal interpreter.
Key features:
- AI translation with model selection
- Headphones Mode
- Real Talk Mode
- Touch Mode
- Camera Translator 
- Object Translator
- Supports more than 150 languages
AI Voice Translator. Choose from multiple advanced AI translation models to get the most accurate and natural-sounding results. The app allows you to select the voice engine that best fits your needs - whether you're aiming for speed, nuance, or clarity. This flexibility ensures that your spoken words are translated with maximum precision, preserving tone and meaning across languages.
Headphones Mode. This feature helps you stay focused during conversations by providing live audio translation directly through your own headphones. Simply connect your headphones, speak in your language, and hear the translation without disturbing others. It’s perfect for traveling, public spaces, or private discussions.
Touch Mode. This mode is designed for face-to-face conversations where two people sit across from each other. The voice input buttons appear on opposite sides of the screen - one for each speaker - so each person can simply tap their side to talk. It’s a natural and convenient way to communicate using just one device. For added flexibility, you can also switch to a layout with both buttons at the bottom of the screen - whichever feels more comfortable.
Real Talk Mode. Perfect for longer conversations, this mode allows you to start the dialogue with just a single tap. Once activated, you can speak freely without pressing the button again after each phrase. The app continuously captures the conversation and translates phrases as you go - ensuring a smooth experience. 
Camera Translator. Instantly translate printed text, menus, signs, documents using your phone's camera. The app uses smart OCR to detect and recognize text in various languages, delivering quick and accurate translations on screen.
Object Translator. Identify and translate objects around you in real time using AR technology. Just point your camera at an item, and the app will recognize and display its name or description in your selected language - perfect for navigating unfamiliar environments or learning new vocabulary visually.
Wide Language Support. The app includes a large selection of languages from globally spoken ones to more specific regional dialects - ensuring you’re covered in almost any situation, anywhere in the world.
Auto-Renewable Subscription Terms:
- Your subscription will automatically renew on a weekly, monthly, or annual basis according to the plan you choose, and the charge will be processed via your Apple ID.
- Free trials automatically switch to paid subscriptions unless canceled at least 24 hours before the trial period ends.
- If you purchase a premium plan during a free trial, any remaining trial time will be forfeited.
- You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your iTunes account settings. Changes will apply after the current billing period ends.
Terms Of Use - https://docs.google.com/document/d/1o074NELkqmPFKd1jRvL5cG_Pp-xw5eIiLwNkCNS0UY8

bluejetty:00158425:ios.description:
About Alula
At Alula, we believe that the best security solution is provided by the professional security dealer. And we know that today’s security customer expects more than just basic security. In order to deliver the best experience for the needs of today’s modern security customer, you need to design and develop the hardware, software, and services for a complete, end-to-end professional security system for the professional security dealer.
The thoughtful technology in our products are designed to keep up with a changing world. Intuitive. Reliable. Innovative. Simplifying your business while saving you money. It’s what you deserve and what people expect. And we’re only scratching the surface of possibilities. Keeping people and property safe is your business. At Alula, creating the tools and support you need to do that, is in our DNA.
It’s your home, you set the rules.
The Alula App gives you what you deserve, reliability and control. Set rules for real-time notifications. Know instantly when doors and windows are opened or when motion is detected.
Technology at your pace
With event based “Scenes” and “Recipes”, your smart devices can support your way of life. Adjust the entire atmosphere in your home based on your day to day routines. Lights, cameras, garage doors and thermostats can adjust to greet you in the morning or when you arrive back home in the evenings.
Alula Home Security Zone Configurations
Alula uses zones in coordination with armed modes and zone configurations to determine how your security system responds when a sensor or detector is triggered. Customize your own zone configurations.
Cloud Video Services
Alula Cloud is an easy-to-use and affordable cloud video solution designed for businesses and homeowners. Now your customers can keep an eye on their home or business with the comfort of knowing their video is securely stored and can be retrieved from anywhere.
- Cost Effective: Why purchase expensive hardware storage, especially if there are multiple sites that need surveillance. Easily manage all camera from one platform.
- Easy to Use: Built for users who do not want to bother with complicated and expensive systems, with simple setup for dealers.
- Flexible Camera Support: Alula Cloud video works with the largest number of leading IP Cameras. Select the right camera for each customer.

bluejetty:00162053:ios.description:
Criado especialmente para investidores de longo prazo, o Investidor10 App é uma solução completa para você acompanhar e otimizar seus investimentos em Ações, Fundos Imobiliários, BDRs, ETFs, entre outros instrumentos financeiros.
*Principais recursos do Investidor10 App:*
► Carteira de Investimentos: Tenha o controle total de sua carteira de investimentos de forma intuitiva e monitore como seus ativos estão performando ao longo do tempo.
► Evolução Patrimonial: Acompanhe de perto a trajetória do seu patrimônio, incluindo os impactos dos aportes ao longo do tempo.
► Controle de Recebimento de Dividendos: Gerencie de forma eficiente seus proventos, tanto os já recebidos quanto os futuros. Tenha uma visão clara do fluxo de recebimento de dividendos, proporcionando uma gestão mais eficaz dos seus rendimentos.
► Preço Médio: Saiba o preço médio de seus investimentos de forma precisa.
► Análise Inteligente: Obtenha insights valiosos e tome decisões fundamentadas com base em informações e análises.
► Gráficos Comparativos: Analise a distribuição de ativos por setor, a exposição da carteira e a rentabilidade em comparação com índices relevantes.
► Histórico de Rentabilidade: Acesse facilmente o histórico de rentabilidade de seus investimentos. Analise o desempenho para ajustar sua estratégia e alcançar seus objetivos financeiros.
► Sistema de Metas: Defina metas financeiras claras e mensuráveis. Acompanhe o progresso em direção aos seus objetivos e ajuste suas estratégias.
► Notícias do mercado: Mantenha-se informado para tomar as melhores decisões de investimento, com notícias sobre mercado de ações, empresas e negócios, e política.
Você ainda pode impulsionar seus investimentos com recursos exclusivos do Investidor10 PRO:
► Integração com a B3: Importe automaticamente todos os seus investimentos da Bolsa de Valores (B3) para a sua carteira, sem a necessidade de integração com corretoras.
► IRPF (Imposto de Renda): Organize a declaração dos seus investimentos com uma ferramenta desenvolvida para auxiliar investidores no preenchimento do programa da Receita.
► Ferramentas de Preço Justo: Utilize ferramentas baseadas na fórmula de Graham e no método de análise de Décio Bazin para obter insights sobre o valor de ações brasileiras e ações americanas.
► Checklist Buy and Hold: Identifique oportunidades de investimento alinhadas à estratégia Buy and Hold com parâmetros de mercado reconhecidos.
► Cursos de Investimentos: Acesse diversos cursos sobre o mercado financeiro para aprimorar seus conhecimentos de investimento.
O Investidor10 não é uma plataforma de negociação, mas oferece uma gama completa de recursos para acompanhar o mercado financeiro.
Junte-se a milhares de investidores que acessam o Investidor10 na versão web, e tenha agora em suas mãos uma ferramenta ainda mais poderosa para alavancar seus investimentos.

bluejetty:00031520:ios.name: WPXI Severe Weather Team 11
bluejetty:00031520:ios.summary: Chief Meteorologist Stephen Cropper and Severe Weather Team 11 power Pittsburgh's best weather tool. The WPXI Severe Weather 11 app gives you everything you need to stay on top of western Pennsylvania's constantly changing weather condition
bluejetty:00031520:ios.description:
Chief Meteorologist Stephen Cropper and Severe Weather Team 11 power Pittsburgh's best weather tool. The WPXI Severe Weather 11 app gives you everything you need to stay on top of western Pennsylvania's constantly changing weather conditions. This free 24/7 app not only makes available Pittsburgh's most accurate forecast but allows users to get interactive with many of the resources available in Severe Weather Center 11.
Summary of Features:
- There is a new radar in the weather app that matches Live Storm Tracker Doppler 11 and also includes future radar to provide you with a likely path and outlook of storms. The radar has 250 meter resolution, the highest available.
- New tracks - We added earthquakes and storm tracks as layers in the radar. Now you can track the location and magnitude of earthquakes as well for storms the speed, direction and type. Tap the “storm symbols” icon in the radar to see the list.
- Push alerts are FREE for more than 25 alert types including everything from tornado warnings to winter storm warnings and tropical storm alert types. 
- Now you can scroll through the home screen to access most of what you need or want on one tab. 
- Place a location pin precisely where you want it for a specific address or any position on a map. When saving a location you can name it exactly how you want it. 
- The app works with identical features on tablet and handset.
- Additional items added seasonally
The weather app also has these critical benefits and features:
- The radar zooms down to your neighborhood or zooms out to check radar anywhere in the country.
- The app provides Location-Based alerts. While many other apps offer alerts based on your county, This app supports a more precise type of alert issued for the most dangerous types of weather threats. More precision means you get alerts that matter to you, not false alarms.
- Current conditions, hourly and daily forecasts for any location you enter.
- High resolution satellite cloud imagery
- Ability to add and save locations
- A fully integrated GPS for current location awareness
- Additional items added seasonally
*Data and alerting available for the United States only.

bluejetty:00125991:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00125991:ios.description:
Take this handy app on your bird-watching trips for quick access to bird calls and assistance with bird ID. Now featuring AI-powered Bird Call ID, a supportive tool to help you ID bird calls in the wild.
NEW: Bird Call ID
Record a live bird call and receive a suggested species identification powered by AI. Available via optional in-app subscription.
HOW WILL THIS APP HELP YOU? 
• Covers all 1001 bird species
• Use the Bird Call ID feature to identify birds by their calls (subscription feature)
• Updated information with fresh input from new contributing authors
• All species text in English AND Afrikaans
• Over 1200 bird calls covering 888 species
• Quick-Play bird calls right from the menu
• More than 4200 photographs
• Improved Location data functionality
• 6 New and updated illustrations with fine attention to detail
• Expanded Smart Search filters – search by bill type, bird size, colour, patterns and features, tail shape, habitat and more.
• Compare more species with "similar species" plates
• New seabirds and raptor illustrations with fine attention to detail
• Distribution maps updated with latest known ranges
• Expanded life list functionality
UPDATE PLAN:
This app will be updated regularly over the coming years. These updates will aim to improve on the content, features and functionality in the app, and they will be free to the customer. We value the input from customers, and urge you to email us at apps@penguinrandomhouse.co.za with any recommendations or features you’d like to see. 
THE AUTHORS 
Ian Sinclair is one of Africa’s foremost field birders and has authored or co-authored
over 20 bird books.
Phil Hockey (1956–2013), former Director of the Fitz Institute at UCT, was a
recognised authority on the biology of southern African birds.
Warwick Tarboton is a well-known bird expert and writer who has produced a
number of well-received books.
Peter Ryan is the former Director of the Fitz Institute at UCT and has authored several books
on the region’s birds.
Niall Perrins is a dedicated birder, photographer and bird guide.
Dominic Rollinson holds a PhD in seabird conservation and works as a bird guide.
JOIN OUR GROWING COMMUNITY
If you’ve got a few comments or great suggestions to share, we’d love to hear from you at www.mydigitalearth.com
ADDITIONAL NOTES
* Uninstalling/reinstalling the app will result in the loss of your list. We recommend that you keep a backup from the application (My List > Export).
* Got questions? Check out the Sasol eBirds FAQ for answers to the most common queries: https://www.sasolbirds.co.za/faq.php

bluejetty:00073893:ios.name: Spectra - Music Visualizer
bluejetty:00073893:ios.summary: Enjoy music at a deeper level with realtime visualization! Spectra is a lightweight music & audio visualizer app that allows you to select and visualize audio in realtime, right on your phone or mac. Want to export your visualization? We ha
bluejetty:00073893:ios.description:
Enjoy music at a deeper level with realtime visualization! Spectra is a lightweight music & audio visualizer app that allows you to select and visualize audio in realtime, right on your phone or mac. Want to export your visualization? We have you covered. Simply click the "Create Video" button from within the app. No longer do you need expensive software to create those beautiful animations you've seen on the internet. Want to customize the background image or put a logo in the center? We made that available as well. In fact, you can customize just about all aspects of the visualizer. You can even import audio files from apps like iMessage or Mail using the share sheet. We want to keep improving the app so If you have any suggestions, be sure to leave a review and tell us what feature you're missing!
The features:
• Amazing, 60fps realtime visualization for any audio file or iTunes music (not Apple Music) song
• Video exporting of your audio visualization (4k at 60fps)
• Custom background image
• Background presets
• Background effects
• Custom logo image
• Visualizer customization
• Particle customization
• Video export settings
• Video animation options
• Presets
• More to come!!!
Here's how it works:
The sound we hear is made up of many frequencies. The visualizer decomposes the audio input into its frequencies and displays the lower frequencies at the top/left of the audio spectrum and the higher frequencies at the bottom/right of the spectrum. This can create some cool-looking shapes that all correspond to the currently-playing audio track!
Whether you're a producer that wants to see the frequency range of their song, an audiophile, or someone who wants to take a deeper look into their music, this app is definitely for you.

bluejetty:00150676:ios.description:
Hana Bank USA Mobile Banking app is a free app that provides a fast, secure and convenient way to manage your finances from anywhere. With industry-leading security enhancements and technology, the Hana Bank USA mobile app gives you the flexibility you need for banking on the go. 
Here’s what you can do with the Hana Bank USA mobile app: 
• View transactions and account balances 
• Keep your transactions organized by adding tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks 
• Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount 
• Transfer money between your accounts 
• Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend 
• Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back 
• Report your debit card lost or stolen 
• View and save your monthly statements 
• Find branches and ATMs near you
Enhanced security includes:
• Two-factor authentication 
• Biometric sign-in such as fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
Getting Started: 
To start using our app, you must be enrolled as a Hana Bank USA Online Banking user. If you are already enrolled in our Online Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Online Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, you will be able to view your account transactions and balances. 
Hana Bank USA, N.A. 
Member FDIC

bluejetty:00015990:ios.description:
Time to get to work in Armed Heist – the action-packed multiplayer shooter game that gets your heart pumping! Test your reflexes as you venture on your bank robbery spree. Robbing banks & armored trucks has never been more thrilling as you avoid flying bullets.
Looking for a great bank robbery third person shooter game? Welcome to the right place, where you face off against the cops in over 70 bank shooting challenges in the best tps game online!
Your mission: become a ruthless thug and bank robbing crime lord! Always be the first person shooting, or else you will end up six feet under.
Killer Game Features:
• Customizable Weapon System – build the wildest, modified guns you could ever imagine! Pistols, shotguns, snipers & assault rifles! Get your arsenal as deadly as possible for the next bank robbery!
Modify it with action-packed sights, suppressors, grips, barrels, stocks & killer skins! All of which will affect the performance of your weapon.
• 3D Crime Map – A dynamic job database crime map of low security banks and armored trucks, lets you pick and choose what heist you want to pull today!
• Dynamic Scenarios – Get ready for the thrill! In this tps online shooting game, no bank shooting challenge ever plays out the same way twice. Every single scenario will be different depending on your moves and gun skills. 
• Pimp Your Character – Create your own ruthless bank robber! Want to be a killer clown? X special forces? Maybe a badass gangster? Earn skins, masks, bulletproof vests & awesome outfits. High-quality 3D graphics and immersive gameplay make this third person shooter into an action-packed shootout!
Armed Heist is one of the most intense third person shooter games online. Unlike fps games (first person shooter game), where all you see in the barrel of your gun, in tps games (third person shooter games) the camera rotates around your character in an active and dynamic way, making you feel like you are the one robbing banks and blazing bullets!
Grab your gear. You got a job to do.

Welcome to the official app of Shri Hit Radha Keli Kunj, Vrindavan. 
The app is developed with the blessings and grace of PriyaPritam and Pujya Gurudev Bhagwaan.
This app intends to benefit the devotees of 'Vrindavan Hitopasana'. It creates a means of connection with Pujya Maharaj Ji and helps to progress in one’s spiritual life. 
It provides a simple-to-use scrollable feature to read most of the Vaanis. 
It contains the following information and features:
1. An introduction about Pujya Shri Hit Premanand Govind Sharan Ji Maharaj.
2. Shri Hit Harivansh Vaani 
 - Shri Hit Chaurasi Ji (With Audio)
 - Shri Radha Sudha Nidhi Ji (With Meaning and Audio)
 - Shri Hit Sevak Vani Ji (With Meaning and Audio)
 - Shri Hit Sfut Vaani Ji
 - Yamunastakam (With Meaning)
 - Harivansh Mahaprabhu ke patra  
3. Rasikon Ki Vaani
 - Ashtadasha Siddhant Ke pad
 - Shri Kelimal
 - Byaleesleela 
 - Prem Ki Peer
 - Rasik Ananya Mal (Bhakt Charitra)
4. Ashtyam Seva Paddhati
 - Acharya Vandana
 - Isht Vandana
 - Guru Vandana
 - Shri Sevak Vandana
 - Ashtyam Seva Paddhati
5. Nitya Paath Rasopasna
 - Manglacharan
 - Shri Hit Mangal Gaan  
 - Yamunastakam
 - Rasik Namavali
 - Sri Vrindavan Namavali
 - Sri Lalju ki Namavali
 - Sri Priyaju ki Namavali
 - Bhakta Namavali
 - Yugaldhyaan
 - Isht Stuti 
 - Kirtan and Jaykara
 - Padavali
 - Isht Aaradhan Prakaran
 - Shri Radharani's 28 names
6. Strotravali 
 - Gopal Sahastranaam
 - Radha Kripa Kataksh Stotram (With Meaning)
 - Krishnastakam (With Meaning)
 - Madhurastakam (With Meaning)
 - Bhaj Govindam (Charpat Panjarika Stotram) With Meaning
 - Gopi Geet
7. An option to view and download daily darshan HD pics of Pujya Shri Hit Premanand Govind Sharan Ji Maharaj, Thakur Radha Mohan Ji, Hit Sajni Ju, Shri Hit Radha Keli Kunj and Shri Vrindavan Dham. 
8. A list of our Official Social Media Channels and all books published by Shri Hit Radha Keli Kunj, Vrindavan.
9. Realtime updates on new videos posted by official channels of Shri Hit Radha Keli Kunj
10. The 'About Radha Keli Kunj' page provides the timetable of Shri Hit Radha Keli Kunj, Vrindavan. You can also navigate to Radha Keli Kunj via Maps.
11. The blog section lets you read the latest blogs from Bhajan Marg
12. Daily Quotes By Shri Hit Premanand Govind Sharan Ji Maharaj
13. Notifications for Videos, Blogs and Quotes
14. Utsav Nirnay Patrika
15. all the information you need to visit us to attend Satsang, Ekantik Vartalap, Darshan, or KirtanDark Mode And 52 Colour Themes
16. Photos Of Rasik Saints For Daily Darshan
17. The FAQ section covers all the information you need to visit us to attend Satsang, Ekantik Vartalap, Darshan, or Kirtan. It also guides on the procedure to be followed for Diksha (initiation)
18. Bhakta Charitra
19. 19. Multi-Language Support - Hindi, English, Punjabi, Gujarati, Bengali, Telugu and Oriya
20. Search Feature: Easily find verses in Vaani Paath!
21. Music option to listen to Kirtans, Naam Jap And Vaani Paath
22. Naam Jap Reminders to help you remember to chant the holy name of God regularly. 
23. Finally, there is an option to report bugs and issues, as well as request new features.

bluejetty:00069256:ios.description:
Popular and professional nonogram game
All puzzles are tested by computer program
Clear App graphics and rich functions
Suitable for beginner and master
HangXun Nonogram is a kind of picture logic game that was first invented by the Japanese in 1987. At first, the game was named after "お絵かきロジック", which means "drawing logic". Now Nonogram is known as nomogram, pictogram, Hanjie, Griddlers, Picross, Japanese Crosswords, Japanese Puzzles, Pic-a-Pix, "Paint by numbers" and other names.
Nonogram game starts with tens of blank cells in a N x M grid, and these blank cells must be colored or left blank according to numbers at the side of the grid to reveal a hidden picture. In this puzzle type, the numbers are a form of discrete tomography that measures how many unbroken lines of filled-in squares there are in any given row or column. For example, a clue of "3 6 2" would mean there are sets of three, six, and two filled squares, in that order, with at least one blank square between successive sets.
Nonogram game rules are very simple, easy to get started. Even you are a beginner for the game, you can start to play it very easily. Whether you want to sharpen your mind or relax your heart, you should give this classic Nonogram game a try. More you play, your brain will become more active. During your commute, before you sleep ... enjoy downtime with brain training.
Main Features:
- Over 10000 Nonogram Puzzles, all are free
- All puzzles are tested by computer program and have unique solution
- Include not only Black-and-white Nonograms, but also colored Nonograms
- All puzzles are sorted by groups from 5x5 to 50x50
- 7 difficulty levels are from beginner to Extreme
- Easy keyboard tool-bar is for big size of nonograms
- Freely download millions of puzzles from our server
More Features:
- Auto check the error
- Unlimited undo and hint time
- Two game modes, freely fill mode and error limit mode
- Save game automatically, and continue it next time
- Score ranking, daily challenge ranking
- Auto fill X and completed lines
- Suitable for phones and tablets
- Clean and beautiful graphics
- Audio effect
Thanks for your selecting HangXun Nonogram Game! We will try our best to make the game better and better.

What is Shortboxed?

bluejetty:00092488:ios.description:
What is Shortboxed?
Shortboxed is the most trusted marketplace and auction platform to buy and sell comic books. In addition to a thriving community with tens of thousands of buyers and sellers, there are also free tools and resources such as a price guide, portfolio manager, extensive data, and quality content to make buying and selling easy, safe, and fun.
How does buying and selling work?
For the marketplace, vetted dealers, comic shop owners, and collectors list their comic books for sale on Shortboxed while buyers browse and discover tens of thousands of comic books, both graded and ungraded. When someone buys a book, the seller receives an order confirmation with a pre-paid shipping label. Sellers get paid once the book is confirmed delivered. Our seller fee is a flat 10% - no hidden fees or shenanigans. Super simple!
For event style auctions, approved sellers send in their books to Shortboxed before an auction is curated. Once the auction event is live, buyers can bid on items until the closing time. Once an auction event ends, winners will receive an invoice to pay before receiving their items.
Shortboxed Features
Sell raw or graded comic books - you can submit raw or graded comic books for sale on Shortboxed, with all raw books verified by Shortboxed before being delivered to the buyer. Buy and sell with confidence!
Quick and easy submissions - take a couple pics, add a price and any additional info as needed, and that’s it. We take care of the rest, including exposure to tens of thousands of potential buyers across the U.S., Canada and U.K. 
We handle customer support - have an issue with an order? Our attentive team will take care of any questions or order issues. No more endless back and forth between buyers and sellers - we take care of everything so you don’t have to. 
Fair Market Value data - make informed buying decisions with our fair market value range, sales history, and indicators that show you if a book is a good deal.
Portfolio Manager - manage your For Sale inventory and your Personal Collection all in one place with the Portfolio Manager. Organize your collection and track the value of your Portfolio for free.
Price Guide - look up recent sales history with our free price guide featuring over one million recent comic book sales across multiple platforms. Did we mention it’s free?
Amazing content - check the app often for new content from the community, how-to guides, collector spotlights, free giveaways, newsletters, and more!
Ready to buy and sell? 
Please read the FAQ in-app or on Shortboxed.com for a complete list of all the buying and selling policies.
Download Shortboxed today and connect with our community on Instagram, Facebook and Twitter @shortboxed and on TikTok @shortboxedcomics.

bluejetty:00128769:ios.description:
Would you like to relax, exercise your brain, and expand your vocabulary-all at the same time? With Wordscapes Search, the NEWEST game from the makers of Wordscapes, you can! These incredibly engaging word search puzzles are brain-blasting fun! 
Connect letters to find every word on the board and sail through thousands of classic puzzle levels set against stunning nature backgrounds. Training your brain has never been easier - or more relaxing. Once you start playing, you just won't be able to put it down!
FEATURES
- Escape and train your brain by visiting the beautiful destinations of Wordscapes Search!
- CHALLENGE your brain and vocabulary 
- LOTS OF LEVELS. Play 1000’s of puzzle board levels- with more coming soon
- EARN POWER-UPS. Use boosters to find words when you get stuck
- COLLECT BONUS POINTS. Find extra words to earn rewards
 - Think you can find every word? These word search puzzles are easy at the start, but get challenging fast!
WHY PLAY?
Calling all brainiacs, quiz whizzes, puzzle pros, and crossword fiends! If you like to relax and unwind with a crossword puzzle, trivia and quiz games, board games, scrabble, or solitaire - you’ll love Wordscapes Search! It’s easy at first, but gets challenging fast. Can you beat the game? Start playing and find out!
Wordscapes Search is a modern twist on classic word search puzzles, combining the features of crossword, scrabble style, word find, and word connect puzzle games. This BRAND NEW word game is proudly brought to you by PeopleFun, the makers of Wordscapes. Join the PeopleFun family and connect with us!
A bit of trivia….
Quick quiz! How many words are in the English language? Answer: about 170,000 in current use. And how many words are in the average person’s vocabulary? Answer: between 20 and 30 thousand. Is your vocabulary above average? Start training your brain and become a word search brainiac: download Wordscapes Search and start your word puzzle adventure today! With 1000’s of puzzle board levels you’ll never be bored!
Download Wordscapes Search and start your word puzzle adventure today!

bluejetty:00041765:ios.description:
Introducing Secret Photo Vault - Your Ultimate Photo and Video Security App
Keeping your precious photos and videos secure with a passcode has never been this effortless. Say hello to Secret Photo Vault - the all-in-one app designed to provide top-notch privacy and protection for your personal files.
Key Features:
• Advanced Passcode Protection: Secret Photo Vault offers an advanced passcode system to safeguard your private photos and videos. Create multiple albums and add unique passwords to each, ensuring ironclad security.
• Privacy Screen: Worried about prying eyes? Rest easy knowing that whenever you exit the app, a privacy screen shields your data, making it visible only to you.
• Intruder Alerts: Stay one step ahead with our intelligent Intruder Alerts. If anyone attempts unauthorized access to your secure vault, Secret Photo Vault captures a snapshot and records the date and time, allowing you to review the attempted breach later.
• Effortless File Import: Easily import your photos and videos into any album. Keep your files organized and under lock and key.
• Convenient File Export & Sharing: Want to share or export files from your albums back to your device? Secret Photo Vault makes it a breeze, ensuring your files remain protected even when shared.
• Secure Lockscreen: Choose between a PIN or enable Face ID (or Touch ID) for swift and secure access to the app.
• Intuitive Photo & Video Viewer: Open and view your photos and videos from any album with confidence, thanks to Secret Photo Vault's robust file security.
• Built-in Camera: Capture new moments directly within Secret Photo Vault using the camera option. Just tap on the + button and select Camera.
• Safety Net with Trash: Deleted files are moved to the trash, giving you the flexibility to restore them to any album or permanently delete them as per your preference.
• Multi-device Backup: Keep your files backed up and accessible on multiple devices, ensuring you never lose your precious memories.
Experience unmatched peace of mind knowing that Secret Photo Vault has your back when it comes to protecting your private files. Get Secret Photo Vault now and take control of your photo and video security like never before.
Premium Subscription:
Secret Photo Vault offers both a 3-day free trial and a basic free version. To access the free version, simply sign up for an account and tap the X in the upper left-hand corner.
By choosing to subscribe, you will be charged a weekly or yearly subscription fee based on your country. The app will display the subscription fee before payment. Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the term. Subscription renewals cost the same as the original subscription, and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account upon purchase confirmation.
You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal at any time after purchase by going to your iTunes Account Settings. Refunds will not be given for any unused portion of the term.

bluejetty:00167799:ios.description:
Tired of weak signal? With Cell Tower Locator PRO you can finally see where the nearest cell towers are and understand your real network coverage.
This smart tool works like a cellmapper and signal finder in your pocket. It shows you a live map of 3G, 4G LTE, and 5G towers, including details about operator, distance, and tower type — so you always know what’s around.
Cell Tower Locator Pro app is your ultimate solution for finding the nearest cell towers and improving your mobile network connection. This app is perfect for anyone looking to enhance their cellular signal by exploring the locations of nearby towers. With Cell Tower Locator Pro, you'll have detailed information about cell towers right at your fingertips.
App Features:
- Cell Tower Map: Using your current location, Cell Tower Locator Pro displays all nearby cell towers on a map, providing you with a visual overview of their distribution around you.
- Detailed Tower Information: Tap on any tower on the map to access comprehensive details, including the cellular operator, network type (5G, 4G/LTE, 3G), and potentially signal strength and other technical data.
- List of Nearest Towers: Cell Tower Locator Pro not only shows towers on a map but also provides a list of the nearest towers, indicating their distance from your current location.
- Network Type Filter: Users can apply filters to display only towers of a specific network type, such as 5G, 4G/LTE, or 3G, making it easier to assess the availability and coverage of different networks.
- Connection Speed Measurement: Evaluate your internet connection speed as you switch between operators to find the best performance.
Cell Tower Locator Pro is the ideal app for anyone who wants to stay informed about their mobile network and optimize their connection. This app is especially useful in areas with unstable signals or for people who frequently travel to new places.
Find the nearest cell towers, enhance your signal, and enjoy better connectivity with Cell Tower Locator Pro. Download now and take control of your mobile network experience!

bluejetty:00121246:ios.name: Equibase
bluejetty:00121246:ios.summary: The Equibase app brings you horse racing entries, changes, results, and video replays from every North American Thoroughbred track - available at your fingertips from Thoroughbred racing's official source for racing information and statisti
bluejetty:00121246:ios.description:
The Equibase app brings you horse racing entries, changes, results, and video replays from every North American Thoroughbred track - available at your fingertips from Thoroughbred racing's official source for racing information and statistics.
Entries -
Get a complete list of entries for all of today (and tomorrow's) Thoroughbred racing action, plus access to exciting handicapping products (purchase required). Each entry contains detailed race information, post time, post position, morning line odds, plus additional data elements. The app also includes easy access to Entries Plus which presents entry information coupled with basic past performance data in a way that is both engaging and interactive.
Results –
Every race includes the official result chart from Equibase and a video replay. Result charts offer a recap of the entire race, including complete order of finish, descriptive narrative for each horse, odds and payoff information plus a wealth of other result data for a comprehensive look at the race.
International Entries and Results -
Easily accessible from the main entries and results menus, get select international entry and result information from around the world.
Changes -
Be the first to know about scratches and changes, plus access to the current weather conditions at the track.
Workouts -
Get workout information from every official workout center in North America.
Carryovers -
Get top carryover information from tracks for the upcoming race day.
News -
Easily accessible from the home screen and the main navigation bar, catch up on the latest racing news and industry headlines.
Racing Yearbook -
Get free video race replays and race results for every graded stakes race throughout the year and every year going back to 2010. Also stay up on all upcoming graded stakes races.
Betting Tools -
The app includes two tools to help you with developing the wagers you would like to place on a race.
Smart Pick:
The Smart Pick™ betting tool is the perfect way to determine which horse to wager on for those that might not have the time or experience to analyze traditional past performance pages – it's smart handicapping made easy!
Bet Calculator -
The bet calculator is a simple tool to help you determine the cost of an exotic wager
Racing Schedule -
Access to a complete Thoroughbred racing schedule - check to see when your favorite track is starting or ending it's live racing meet.
Virtual Stable -
You can access your Virtual Stable directly from the app and add horses to your stable to be notified of their future activity with one click.
Remove Ads Feature -
For $2.99 per month or $19.99 per year, you can remove ads from the app and gain access to the race of the day, which includes a free past performance and selection for a selected race.
Please Note: Purchasing the premium version excludes ads from the app, however portions of this app point to web pages from Equibase so you may experience ads if you click on those pages, which include leaders' lists and statistical profiles.

bluejetty:00074411:ios.description:

Weekly Circular & Promotions:
- Browse and shop items on sale directly from the Weekly Ad.

Digital Coupons:
- Load additional savings directly to your Fresh Grocer Rewards card to redeem at checkout.

Saved Lists:

- Add personalized notes to items, ensuring your preferences and special requests are always remembered.
Scan Product Barcodes:

Recipes:

Personalized Offers:
- Reorder from a curated list of your past purchases and get recommended items on sale each week.

- Explore an extensive range of products, from fresh produce to pantry staples, international foods, and specialty items.
- Discover our own brands carefully curated for taste, quality, and affordability.
- Stock up on essentials with club-sized options. Whether its breakfast and pantry items, or cleaning supplies, buying in larger quantities saves you money.
Loyalty Card Access:
- Save your Fresh Grocer Rewards card to your Wallet app or directly access it within The Fresh Grocer app.
Search Functionality:
- Find exactly what you need in seconds with powerful and intuitive search for products, recipes, and coupons.
Deli and Catering Pre-Orders:
- Order cold cuts, cakes, and catering platters (where available) for time-saving, customizable options, freshness and hassle-free pickup.
Download The Fresh Grocer app and enjoy a seamless shopping experience today!

bluejetty:00200023:ios.description:
Necrophonic is an ITC app used for spirit communication and EVP research.
8 Sounds Banks:
The audio has been mastered in a way to bring out various sound properties . 
Using Pro Tools I was able to enhance high, mid, and low range frequencies. I also applied 
other filters to create unique sound characteristics to help layer the audio and create an 
environment suitable for spirit communication.
The audio itself is made up of phonemes, 
partial words, reverse audio, foreign languages, and other parts of speech that can help 
spirits communicate. Besides some basic phonetic sounds such as na, no, da, do, di, ma, may, etc.
there are no real words of phrases contained in the banks.
These sounds banks play in a similar
way to that of my other app "Spiritus Ghost Box" but instead of 4 sound banks Necrophonic has
8 active sound banks.
White Noise Sound Bank:
This app also has an optional 9th sound bank called "White noise". 
This bank can be used alone or with the other 8 giving you a total of 9 sound banks. This 
audio is taken for the internal sounds of the famous DR60 recorder that is known as the 
"Holy Grail" of EVP recorders. This is not a White Noise Generator, this is a normal sound bank like the others but this one contains white noise from the DR60.
Audio Effects:
This app does contain Echo and Reverb audio effects. These have been proven 
to be the best effects to apply to ITC sessions. The echo can create audio that can be 
manipulated within the echo itself. Echo can also help in live, real time communication by 
repeating the audio and allowing you to better hear whats coming through. Reverb can be 
applied to the audio to create a spacious sound environment that will enhance audio manipulation.

Residents have the ability to pay rent with a single tap, manage
bluejetty:00065266:ios.description:
The ResidentPortal app provides a convenient way to pay rent, submit maintenance orders with photos, and communicate with your apartment community all from your mobile phone.
Residents have the ability to pay rent with a single tap, manage one-time or recurring rent payments and receive rent reminder push notifications with the app (see below for a list of key features).
Much of the ResidentPortal app is configurable by the property in which you live. Property settings include, but are not limited to, payment methods, payment days, full balance payment requirements, or maintenance request availability.
 If you have feedback, suggestions or bugs about the app itself, please email rpapp@entrata.com, we would love to hear from you!
ResidentPortal App Features:
• Make a One Time Payment - Easily submit a one time payment with the same trusted payment platform you have always used. 
• Add/Delete Recurring Payments - Easily schedule new auto-payments ensuring your rent will never be late.
• Pay by Voice - Allows you to quickly pay rent by searching 'Pay My Rent' from Spotlight Search and linking directly to the make payment screen in the app. 
• One-Tap Pay - Pay rent with a single tap right from your smartphone. The app remembers your last used payment method and knows your exact balance due.
• RentNotify - Sends push notifications to your device, reminding you to pay rent.
• Contact Property - Contact your property directly from the app. The app automatically routes your call to the appropriate after-hours number when the office closes.
• Submit Maintenance Requests - Submit a maintenance request right from the app. 
• Take a Picture of the Problem - Use your smart phone's camera to take a picture of the maintenance issue without leaving the app.
• Inspections - Complete move-in, maintenance, and other inspections right from your mobile device.
• Reserve Amenities - Schedule amenities at your property.
• Touch ID Login - After initial setup, securely log in to the app by scanning your finger print.
• Face ID Login - Authenticate with your face with iPhone X+.
• 3D Touch Support - Quickly pay rent, submit a maintenance request, or view your balance by tapping and holding the app icon. 
Please note: The ResidentPortal App is only for residents of properties using Entrata's ResidentPortal and ResidentPay products.

bluejetty:00174453:ios.description:
Bus Times London is a travel app designed to help you move around London with clearer bus information, live TfL updates, and simple journey planning. Whether you are commuting to work, visiting landmarks, travelling across the city, or checking your usual route, Bus Times London helps you find the right bus at the right time.
Live London Bus Times
Check live bus times using official Transport for London information. Look up bus stops, bus routes, locations, and points of interest to see real-time departures and waiting times.
Key Features:
- Live TfL bus times across London
- Nearby bus stops shown on an interactive map
- Real-time bus journey planner
- Live departure boards for selected stops
- Timetables for any time of the week
- View bus routes and stops along the way
- Find where a bus is on your selected route
- Save favorite stops, routes, and journeys
- Personalized Home Stop for regular routes
- Step-by-step journey guidance
- Travel updates for diversions and road closures
- Fare information for ticket planning
- Apple Watch app support
- Wake Me alerts to help avoid missing your stop
- Oyster card balance access through TfL My Account
Plan Bus Routes Quickly
Use the journey planner to find bus routes across London. Get step-by-step guidance, estimated travel times, and details on where you may need to change buses.
Nearby Stops And Interactive Maps
Find nearby bus stops from wherever you are in London. The Locate Me feature helps you quickly see stops around you, while the interactive map makes it easier to understand routes, directions, and local bus options.
Useful Tools For Daily Travel
Save your favorite bus stops, routes, and journeys so you can access them quickly when you are on the go. The personalized Home Stop feature gives fast access to bus times for the routes you use most.
Premium Access
Available as an in-app subscription: £1.99 monthly or £4.99 annually or a lifetime purchase at £12.99. Prices may vary by location. Cancel at any time, for any reason. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, at the cost of your chosen price tier. Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings in your iTunes Account. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when a subscription to that publication is purchased, where applicable.
Please Note
Continued use of GPS in the background can decrease battery life. Augmented reality bus stop guidance requires a compatible device and the required permissions.
Bus Times London Countdown App is an independent app and is not associated with, endorsed by, or affiliated with the Transport For London Authority.
Privacy Policy: https://mapway.ai/londonbusios/privacy/
Terms and Conditions: https://mapway.ai/londonbusios/terms/

bluejetty:00127558:ios.name: Photo Metadata EXIF Remover
bluejetty:00127558:ios.summary:
See what your photos reveal, then share a copy without it. Photo Metadata EXIF Remover shows every detail stored in a photo's file and shares a copy with no metadata, or with only the location removed. Your original stays as it is.
SEE EVE
bluejetty:00127558:ios.description:
See what your photos reveal, then share a copy without it. Photo Metadata EXIF Remover shows every detail stored in a photo's file and shares a copy with no metadata, or with only the location removed. Your original stays as it is.
SEE EVERYTHING A PHOTO HOLDS
• Open any photo or video to see every detail stored in its file, from camera settings to location and dates.
• See on a map where a photo was taken and, when the file records it, which way the camera faced.
• Search by field name or value, and copy any value.
SHARE A COPY WITHOUT THE DETAILS
• Share Without Any Metadata sends a copy with no camera, date, or location details.
• Share Without GPS Data sends a copy without its location and keeps the rest.
• Tap Actions on a photo and choose one. To do several, tap Select first.
• In the app, JPEG copies keep their exact picture data. A JPEG you share from Photos may be re-encoded by Photos first. Other formats may be re-encoded.
IN THE PHOTOS APP
Three actions appear under the Share button in Photos, so you don't have to open this app. They work on up to 20 photos at a time:
• View All Metadata
• Share Without Any Metadata
• Share Without GPS Data
GOOD TO KNOW
• The original in your library keeps its metadata. Only the copy you share goes without it.
• Removing metadata works on photos only. You can still open a video to see its details.
• Live Photos are shared as still photos.
PRIVACY
Your photos are never uploaded or copied from this app to any server or cloud. Maps and place names come from Apple Maps, which receives a photo's coordinates. Usage and crash data never include your photos, file names, or metadata values, and you can turn them off in Settings.
No account needed.
Need more? Metadata Pro is a separate paid app from the same developer. It does what this app does, and also edits fields and changes dates and places.

bluejetty:00032769:ios.description:
The Natural World is under attack by the MuckMonger Pollution Army of evil Mucklings and MuckMares! This dark army is now assaulting the entrance to Deep Earth where the Heart of Nature is kept. They must not be allowed to enter or all will be lost!
But Nature is not completely defenseless! - Natural Guardian Spirits have emerged from the Deep Earth to defend Nature against the onslaught of the Mucklings and MuckMares - but we need your help!
Merge the Natural Spirits to create stronger Guardians and strategically arrange them on the Last Patch in front of the entrance to Deep Earth to fight off the never-ending waves of Mucklings and defeat the MuckMare bosses. 
“Nature Strikes Back” combines the best aspects from merge games, tower defense games, and idle games into a unique gaming experience with fantasy elements and cute characters.
 *Nature Strikes Back is a Merge Game!
Merge the Natural Spirits to unlock the cute characters that are ever stronger Guardian Spirits!
*Nature Strikes Back is a Tower Defense Game!
Nature needs your help to defend the entrance to the Deep Earth and the Heart of Nature!
*Nature Strikes Back is also an Idle Game!
Even while you are away, you can continue to defend Nature and earn rewards!
Features:
Merge and unlock 70+ cute Natural Guardian Spirits!
Defeat waves and waves of the Pollution Army of Mucklings and the boss Muckmares!
Recycle your extra Natural Guardian Spirits for rewards!
Continue to defend the entrance to Deep Earth even while you’re idle!
Nature Strikes Back is free to play, though some in-game items can also be purchased for real money.
You can turn off the payment feature by disabling in-app purchases in your device’s settings.

bluejetty:00022197:ios.description:
Learning languages has never been so easy! More and more people learn languages with LENGO every day. Join today and be part of our growing community!
LENGO IS FREE TO USE
Our goal is to make education accessible to anyone. Thus, all basic features are permanently free to use. We are continuously extending paid content as well as free content to make LENGO even better.
WHAT TO EXPECT
LENGO equips you with everything you need to learn the language you want. It has been shown that you can significantly reduce the time invested in learning a new language by using instant feedback, recurrent material, and other methodologies that LENGO supports. Another aspect that is likely to improve your learning success is the motivation methods, which are often missing from traditional language-learning methods. However, you still have to bring some initiative.
EXTRA CONTENT? THAT'S PREMIUM
With LENGO Pro, you unlock your full potential. You unlock everything you need to learn languages as quickly and successfully as possible.
ABOUT LENGO
LENGO is a language learning platform that strives to enrich global human interaction by improving people’s ability to communicate.
Privacy policy: https://www.lengo.io/about/privacy/
Terms of use: https://www.lengo.io/about/terms
Questions? Contact us:
contact@lengo.io
---------------------------------------------------------------
Information about the auto-renewable nature of the subscription
A subscription is not essential to get access to the full learning materials. You can also gain access by uploading content that adds value to the community. Otherwise, content can be unlocked through in-app-purchases. However, subscriptions are useful for users who want full access without any further action required. The subscribed user does not have to pay attention to our digital currency. Therefore, full access to the app is Lengo Pro.
Each subscription will be automatically renewed unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current payment period. Your iTunes account will be automatically charged at the same price for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current payment period unless you change your subscription preferences in your iTunes Account Settings. When a subscription is canceled, access to the app’s courses and features will expire at the end of the current payment period.

bluejetty:00066054:ios.name: Indonesian Train Simulator
bluejetty:00066054:ios.summary:
Indonesian Train Simulator is another high quality train simulation game from the stable of Highbrow Interactive, the creators of the mega-successful “Euro Train Simulator" and the path-breaking "Indian Train Simulator".
Indonesian Train S
bluejetty:00066054:ios.description:
Indonesian Train Simulator is another high quality train simulation game from the stable of Highbrow Interactive, the creators of the mega-successful “Euro Train Simulator" and the path-breaking "Indian Train Simulator".
Indonesian Train Simulator features “Track Changing” and fully functional “Signalling System”. The game boasts a self-sufficient railroad environment where all trains coexist and operate just like in the real world. Dynamic track-changing and sophisticated path selection systems enable all the AI trains to function smartly without stepping on each others’ paths. Since players will now rely entirely on signalling and track changing switches, the paths they take will be one among an exponential set of possibilities. This means they will find themselves stopping their trains on any of the platforms available at each station.
“Drive” - where the player can design a scenario to their preference
“Play Now” - users will instantly begin a simulation put together with randomized preferences
“Career” - features uniquely designed missions
FEATURES:
1. Track Change: A fully realized track changing functionality has been implemented, for the first time in a mobile train simulator. 
2. Signal: Indonesian Train Sim makes use of fully functional signalling system. While waiting for the signal to turn Green, players will be able to see which other trains are currently occupying their path. 
3. A Message System is in place to notify user of every activity happening within the game, offering suggestions when deemed necessary to information about penalty and bonus. The categories are Speed, Station, Track Switch, Route, Signal. 
4. Multiple weather and time options. 
5. Passengers: Special attention has been given to create passengers who look and dress like Indonesians. 
6. Stations: The stations were designed to capture the feel of being in any Indonesian railway station. From the kiosks to the advertisement boards, the attention to detail is extreme.
7. Types of locomotives: GE U18C, GE U20C, GE CC206 
8. Types of coaches: Passenger and Freight coaches
9. Sound design has been carefully crafted keeping the hustle and bustle of modern Indonesia in mind. The train sounds are best in class.
10. Camera angles: multiple, interesting camera angles have been provided: Driver, Cabin, Overhead, Drone, Reverse, Signal, Orbit and Passenger. 
11. High quality graphics: The level of graphics has been pushed to new levels and anyone familiar with Indonesian routes will tell you how realistic the design is. 
12. Available stations: Gambir, Karawang, Purwakarta, Bandung.
We already have a lot of new features planned ourselves for the upcoming updates, but feel free to suggest your own ideas in the comments section and the ones getting most number of responses will be made available very soon.
If you have any issue with the game, feel free to write to us and we assure you we will resolve them in an update. You do not have to give us a low rating to get our attention. As always, we are listening!
Like our official Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/HighbrowInteractive/

2. Signal: Indonesian Train Sim makes use of fully functional signalling system. While waiting for the signal to turn Green, players will be able to see which other trains are currently occupying their path. 

3. A Message System is in place to notify user of every activity happening within the game, offering suggestions when deemed necessary to information about penalty and bonus. The categories are Speed, Station, Track Switch, Route, Signal. 

4. Multiple weather and time options. 

5. Passengers: Special attention has been given to create passengers who look and dress like Indonesians. 

6. Stations: The stations were designed to capture the feel of being in any Indonesian railway station. From the kiosks to the advertisement boards, the attention to detail is extreme.

7. Types of locomotives: GE U18C, GE U20C, GE CC206 

8. Types of coaches: Passenger and Freight coaches

9. Sound design has been carefully crafted keeping the hustle and bustle of modern Indonesia in mind. The train sounds are best in class.

10. Camera angles: multiple, interesting camera angles have been provided: Driver, Cabin, Overhead, Drone, Reverse, Signal, Orbit and Passenger.  

11. High quality graphics: The level of graphics has been pushed to new levels and anyone familiar with Indonesian routes will tell you how realistic the design is. 

12. Available stations: Gambir, Karawang, Purwakarta, Bandung.

We already have a lot of new features planned ourselves for the upcoming updates, but feel free to suggest your own ideas in the comments section and the ones getting most number of responses will be made available very soon.

If you have any issue with the game, feel free to write to us and we assure you we will resolve them in an update. You do not have to give us a low rating to get our attention. As always, we are listening!

bluejetty:00165756:ios.summary:
