The "Read" section allows you to see data su
bluejetty:00165756:ios.description:
NFC Tools can read and write your NFC tags with a simple and lightweight user interface.
By passing your device near an NFC chip, you can read the data it contains and interact with the content.
The "Read" section allows you to see data such as:
- the maker of the tag
- the type of tag (ex : Mifare Ultralight, NTAG213)
- the norm of the tag (ex : NFC Forum Type 2)
- the available technology (ex: NFC A)
- its serial number (ex : 04:85:c8:5a:40:2b:80)
- the size of the tag and of the data on it
- if you can write on the tag
- all the data on the tag (NDEF format)
NFC Tools can record standard information on your tags which will be compatible with any NFC device.
For instance, you can store a VCARD to share your contact details easily, open an URL, share a phone number or even a geolocation.
The "Write" section let you record standardised data such as:
- a simple text
- a link to a website
- an email
- a contact
- a phone number
- a predefined text message
- an address or geolocation
- a WiFi or Bluetooth configuration
- personalised data
- and more...
The write function allows you to add as much data as you wish.
This way you can record large quantities of information on your tag.
The app also allows you to save the contents of your chip for later access.
NFC Tools has been tested with the following NFC tags:
- NTAG 203, 210, 210u, 212, 213, 213TT, 215, 216, 413 DNA, 424 DNA
- Ultralight, Ultralight C, Ultralight EV1
- ICODE SLI, SLI-S, SLIX, SLIX-S, SLIX-L, SLIX2, DNA
- DESFire EV1, EV2, EV3
- ST25TV, ST25TA
- Felica
If you encounter any problem, don’t hesitate to contact us.
Notes:
- Compatible from iPhone 7.
- Use the "compatibility" mode to read/write Mifare Classic tags.

- an address or geolocation
- a WiFi or Bluetooth configuration
- personalised data
- and more...

The write function allows you to add as much data as you wish.
This way you can record large quantities of information on your tag.

The app also allows you to save the contents of your chip for later access.

NFC Tools has been tested with the following NFC tags:
- NTAG 203, 210, 210u, 212, 213, 213TT, 215, 216, 413 DNA, 424 DNA
- Ultralight, Ultralight C, Ultralight EV1
- ICODE SLI, SLI-S, SLIX, SLIX-S, SLIX-L, SLIX2, DNA
- DESFire EV1, EV2, EV3
- ST25TV, ST25TA
- Felica

If you encounter any problem, don’t hesitate to contact us.

Notes:
- Compatible from iPhone 7.
- Use the "compatibility" mode to read/write Mifare Classic tags.

bluejetty:00074037:ios.name: Hatch Grow
bluejetty:00074037:ios.summary: Hatch Baby--recipient of the prestigious Mom’s Choice Award--helps you track of all your baby’s most important growth and health data, including feedings, diaper changes, sleep, and much more. Get insight into your baby’s development with v
bluejetty:00074037:ios.description:
Hatch Baby--recipient of the prestigious Mom’s Choice Award--helps you track of all your baby’s most important growth and health data, including feedings, diaper changes, sleep, and much more. Get insight into your baby’s development with visual charts and understand your baby’s patterns with a convenient activity summary. Use the app on its own, or connect it with our award-winning Hatch Baby Grow or Smart Changing Pad--changing pad with built-in, wireless smart scale. Grow measures how much breast milk your baby is drinking at each feeding and automatically syncs to the Hatch Baby app.
FEEDINGS 
- Track breastfeeding or bottle sessions with an easy-to-use, one-tap timer, which allows you to adjust the start time if you forget to start the timer. 
- Conveniently pause the timer during nursing sessions to switch breasts and record the time for both sides. 
- Connect to Grow or the Smart Changing Pad (optional) to measure exactly how much your baby is eating at each breastfeeding session.
- Capture feeding session notes, like your baby’s formula preference. 
- View daily, weekly, or monthly summary charts to gain insight into your baby’s eating patterns. 
DIAPERS
- Easily keep track of changes to ensure your baby is drinking enough throughout the day. 
- Record notes that can be shared with your pediatrician or other caregivers.
- Connect to Grow or the Smart Changing Pad (optional) and automatically record diaper changes. 
- View daily, weekly, or monthly summary charts to gain insight into your baby’s diaper patterns. 
SLEEP
- Track naps and nighttime sleep with an easy-to-use sleep timer, which allows you to adjust the start time if you forget to start the timer. 
- Discover your baby's sleeping patterns to help her get the best rest.
- View daily, weekly, or monthly summary charts to gain insight into your baby’s sleep patterns. 
GROWTH METRICS
- Track your baby’s weight and length gain, and compare his growth percentile to worldwide (WHO) data.
- See how your baby grows week-to-week.
- Weigh your baby anytime or before and after feedings with Grow or the Smart Changing Pad (optional) and automatically send weights to the app.
SHARE WITH CAREGIVERS + PROFESSIONALS
- Invite your partner or caregiver to share your baby’s account and record activity.
- Receive updates from your baby’s caregiver while you are away, including when your baby last ate or slept.
- Export and share your baby's data with your pediatrician or lactation consultant. 
- Access your baby’s information across multiple devices.
PUMPING
- Track pumping sessions with an easy-to-use, one-tap timer.
- Record amount, duration, and side(s) pumped. 
DAILY SUMMARY
- View a convenient summary of your baby’s diaper count, feeding amount, and total sleep for the day, as well as Hatch Handbook articles providing parenting insights. 
- Scroll through a log of your baby’s recent activity. 
- Customize your dashboard to display the activities (i.e. feedings, diapers, and sleep) you track or view most frequently.
PHOTOS
- Take a photo of your baby every day, play the slideshow, and watch how your baby has grown! 
- Share photos with family and friends.

Hatch Baby--recipient of the prestigious Mom’s Choice Award--helps you track of all your baby’s most important growth and health data, including feedings, diaper changes, sleep, and much more. Get insight into your baby’s development with visual charts and understand your baby’s patterns with a convenient activity summary. Use the app on its own, or connect it with our award-winning Hatch Baby Grow or Smart Changing Pad--changing pad with built-in, wireless smart scale. Grow measures how much breast milk your baby is drinking at each feeding and automatically syncs to the Hatch Baby app.

FEEDINGS 
- Track breastfeeding or bottle sessions with an easy-to-use, one-tap timer, which allows you to adjust the start time if you forget to start the timer. 
- Conveniently pause the timer during nursing sessions to switch breasts and record the time for both sides. 
- Connect to Grow or the Smart Changing Pad (optional) to measure exactly how much your baby is eating at each breastfeeding session.
- Capture feeding session notes, like your baby’s formula preference. 
- View daily, weekly, or monthly summary charts to gain insight into your baby’s eating patterns. 

DIAPERS
- Easily keep track of changes to ensure your baby is drinking enough throughout the day. 
- Record notes that can be shared with your pediatrician or other caregivers.
- Connect to Grow or the Smart Changing Pad (optional) and automatically record diaper changes. 
- View daily, weekly, or monthly summary charts to gain insight into your baby’s diaper patterns. 

SLEEP
- Track naps and nighttime sleep with an easy-to-use sleep timer, which allows you to adjust the start time if you forget to start the timer. 
- Discover your baby's sleeping patterns to help her get the best rest.
- View daily, weekly, or monthly summary charts to gain insight into your baby’s sleep patterns. 

GROWTH METRICS
- Track your baby’s weight and length gain, and compare his growth percentile to worldwide (WHO) data.
- See how your baby grows week-to-week.
- Weigh your baby anytime or before and after feedings with Grow or the Smart Changing Pad (optional) and automatically send weights to the app.

SHARE WITH CAREGIVERS + PROFESSIONALS
- Invite your partner or caregiver to share your baby’s account and record activity.
- Receive updates from your baby’s caregiver while you are away, including when your baby last ate or slept.
- Export and share your baby's data with your pediatrician or lactation consultant. 
- Access your baby’s information across multiple devices.

PUMPING
- Track pumping sessions with an easy-to-use, one-tap timer.
- Record amount, duration, and side(s) pumped. 

DAILY SUMMARY
- View a convenient summary of your baby’s diaper count, feeding amount, and total sleep for the day, as well as Hatch Handbook articles providing parenting insights. 
- Scroll through a log of your baby’s recent activity. 
- Customize your dashboard to display the activities (i.e. feedings, diapers, and sleep) you track or view most frequently.

PHOTOS
- Take a photo of your baby every day, play the slideshow, and watch how your baby has grown! 
- Share photos with family and friends. 

GROW AND SMART CHANGING PAD (optional)
- Use the app on its own, or connect it with Hatch Baby Grow and Smart Changing Pad -- where changing pad meets connected smart scale to help track your baby’s weight gain and feeding amounts.

bluejetty:00145586:ios.description:
تطبيق تحميل بلس سابقاً
تطبيق فيديو بلس يساعدك على استيراد ملفاتك وحفظها في جهازك حيث تستطيع حفظ ملفات الاغاني والفيديو والصور في جهازك بكل سهولة ويسر ويوفر التطبيق المميزات التالية:
- تحميل ملفات الفيديو والاغاني والصور الى التطبيق من مصادر متعددة
- نقل الملفات الى الجوال بدون وصلات عن طريق الواي فاي
- مكتبة التطبيق لحفظ الملفات وتوفر مميزات عديدة مثل تشغيل ملفات الفيديو كصوت في الخلفية والاستماع الى الاغاني خارج التطبيق
- يدعم التطبيق نظام حماية متقدم حيث انه يمكن تقفيل التطبيق باستخدام كلمة مرور او بصمة اليد او الوجه للحماية من المتطفلين
والعديد من المميزات اكتشفها داخل التطبيق ولن تحتاج اي تطبيق اغاني اخر.
يمكنك الاشتراك معنا للاستمتاع بالتطبيق بدون اعلانات.
احصل على فترة تجريبية مجانية عند الاشتراك لاول مرة في الاشتراك الاسبوعي. 
في حال رغبتك في الاشتراك بشكل اسبوعي لن يتم خصم اي مبلغ منك الا عند انتهاء الفترة التجريبية بينما عند الاشتراك الشهري سيتم خصم المبلغ فور تاكيد الطلب.
في حال كنت لا ترغب في الاستمرار في الاشتراك يجب عليك الغاء الاشتراك قبل انتهاء الفترة بـ 24 ساعة على الاقل. يمكنك التحكم في اشتراكك عن طريقة اعدادات الايفون.
يحصل المشتركين على دعم فني خاص عبر التواصل مباشرة مع فريق الدعم الخاص بالتطبيق عبر البريد الالكتروني ويحصل المشتركين على فرصة للانضمام الى مجتمع خاص بمشتركي التطبيق للتواصل وتبادل الخبرات

bluejetty:00065584:ios.name: FoodieLens - Food Photo Editor
bluejetty:00065584:ios.summary:
With over 440,000 downloads, FoodieLens is revolutionizing the way food photography is captured. This app allows anyone to create professional-looking photos of their meals with just a few taps. 
Specially designed for capturing the beauty
bluejetty:00065584:ios.description:
With over 440,000 downloads, FoodieLens is revolutionizing the way food photography is captured. This app allows anyone to create professional-looking photos of their meals with just a few taps. 
Specially designed for capturing the beauty and detail of food at close range, FoodieLens combines advanced technology with user-friendly functionality. 
Whether you aim to be the star of social media or simply want to preserve your culinary creations, FoodieLens empowers you to take stunning food photographs easily.
--------------------
Key Features:
--------------------
-> Extensive Filter Collection: With around 90 unique filters at your fingertips, transform any ordinary meal into a photographic masterpiece. Whether aiming for a classic black-and-white elegance or a vibrant retro vibe, these filters adjust your photos in a single tap to exude professional flair.
-> Creative Effects: Tap into creativity with about 50 artistic effects that can pixelate, sketch, distort, or cartoonize your images, offering endless possibilities for innovation in your food photography.
-> DSLR-Style Focus: Achieve that soft, blurred background seen in DSLR photographs with our focus tool, enhancing the visual appeal of your food by drawing attention to its details.
-> Precision Editing Controls: Manipulate brightness, color saturation, and hue with precision tools to ensure your food looks as delicious digitally as it does on your plate.
-> One-Tap Auto Adjust: Simplify photo editing with an auto-adjust feature that optimizes your photos with just one tap, ensuring they always look their best.
-> Scene-Specific Optimization: Whether you’re shooting indoors, at night, or outdoors, FoodieLens provides tailored adjustments to suit various lighting and environmental conditions, making sure your photos always have the right exposure and mood.
-> Fun Stickers and Text Options: Embellish your photos with an extensive selection of stickers or add text to narrate your food story. These decorative elements are perfect for adding a personal touch to your culinary snapshots.
-> Interactive Drawing: Unleash your creativity by drawing directly on your photos, adding unique touches that make your images one-of-a-kind.
-> Kaleidoscope and 3D Effects: Explore the unusual by turning your photos into fascinating kaleidoscope patterns or preparing them for an immersive experience with 3D glasses.
-> Comprehensive Photo Editing Tools: Resize, crop, rotate, and more—FoodieLens offers all the tools you need to perfect your photos. For those who like to control every aspect of their image, the tone curve adjustment offers complex editing capabilities that cater to advanced photographers.
-> User-Friendly Interface: Despite its range of professional-grade features, FoodieLens is designed to be intuitive and easy to use. Whether you’re a novice or an expert, you’ll find the interface straightforward and the results impressive.
FoodieLens is not just an app but a gateway to transforming your culinary experiences into lasting visual memories. It stands out in the crowded field of image editing apps by focusing specifically on food photography, offering tools and features that enhance the unique qualities of food. Let's capture the perfect shot of your next meal and share it with the world with FoodieLens!

bluejetty:00023401:ios.name: ComBank Digital
bluejetty:00023401:ios.summary:
Banking with ComBank Digital is fast, simple, and secure. Open an account within few seconds to experience banking designed to fit your lifestyle.
As well as updating the design and adding new functionality, we’ve worked hard to streamline
bluejetty:00023401:ios.description:
Banking with ComBank Digital is fast, simple, and secure. Open an account within few seconds to experience banking designed to fit your lifestyle.
As well as updating the design and adding new functionality, we’ve worked hard to streamline the app and make it easy to use. We’ll continue improving the app and gradually adding new features.
Feel free to leave a comment and tell us what you’d like to see!
Key Features
• Log in securely with or without your Secure Key. To log in quickly, you can now use Fingerprint on eligible devices.
• View payment card information, such as withdrawal and spending limits. You can also report your lost or stolen card directly from the app.
• Open an account within few seconds directly from your phone. No long lines, no paperwork, no fuss.
• Achieve your short and long-term financial goals with Spaces. Set savings targets and transfer money with a single swipe.
• Receive instant notifications on all account activity so you know what’s happening with your account in real-time.
• Balance Inquiry, View account history.
• Pay your bills, Manage your funds, Open other account, FD account creation and other main financial services.
• Locating our service points and ATM.
• Information on interest rates / currency details of our products.
• Our latest promotional and offers.
Loan Services
• Explore available loan products and financing facilities offered by Commercial Bank.
• Check loan eligibility and applicable product requirements.
• View loan amounts, applicable interest rates or equivalent Annual Percentage Rate (APR), repayment periods, fees and charges.
• Review repayment schedules and estimated total repayment amounts before proceeding with a loan application.
• Submit and track loan applications through the app, subject to product availability and eligibility requirements.
Additional Services
• Locate our branches, service points and ATMs.
• View information about interest rates and foreign exchange rates.
• Explore our latest promotions and offers.
Loan Information & Disclosures
Loan facilities are provided by Commercial Bank of Ceylon PLC, a licensed financial institution regulated by Central Bank of Sri Lanka.
Loan availability, approval and applicable terms are subject to the relevant product eligibility criteria, credit assessment and regulatory requirements.
The applicable loan amount, Annual Percentage Rate (APR) or equivalent rate, repayment period, repayment dates, fees and charges, and total repayment amount will be disclosed to customers before they proceed with a loan agreement.
Loan Terms
• Minimum loan amount: Rs. 100,000
• Maximum loan amount: Rs. 1,000,000
• Minimum repayment period: 6 months
• Maximum repayment period: 84 months
• Maximum applicable APR / equivalent rate: 17% p.a.
• Applicable fees and charges: No additional charges will be charged during the initial phase.
Illustrative Repayment Example
For a loan of Rs. 100,000 over 60 months, at an applicable APR / equivalent rate of 15% p.a., the estimated total repayment amount would be Rs. 2,379, including applicable fees and charges.
Actual repayment amounts and terms may vary depending on the selected loan product, customer eligibility and approved loan conditions.
Who We Are
Commercial Bank is the largest private bank in Sri Lanka, and the only Sri Lankan bank to be ranked among the world’s top 1000 banks for many successive years. The Bank operates a network of 250+ computer-linked service points and the country’s single largest ATM network of 600+ terminals.
The Bank has been adjudged ‘Best Bank in Sri Lanka’ for 15 consecutive years by ‘Global Finance’ Magazine and has won multiple awards as the country’s best bank from ‘The Banker,’ ‘FinanceAsia,’ ‘Euromoney’ and ‘Trade Finance’ magazines.

bluejetty:00069449:ios.description:
Nike Training Club isn't just another workout app — it's a portal to Nike's top trainers, athletes and experts. It's where you can access industry-leading workout programming and legit coaching for free. Whether you put in the work at the gym or at home, NTC is here to power your progress. If you're serious about your fitness, this is where you train.
Nike Members get free access to the latest strength training, conditioning, yoga, pilates, recovery and mindfulness content. Train the way you want and reach your goals with Nike Training Club.
EXPERT PROGRAMMING FOR EVERY LEVEL
• Gym workouts: Curated strength and conditioning workouts and programs designed for the gym 
• Home workouts: Whiteboard and trainer-led workouts made for small spaces, travel and lack of equipment
• Total-body strength: Programming to develop muscular strength, hypertrophy, power and endurance
• Conditioning: High-intensity workouts, including high-intensity interval and sprint-interval training 
• Core workouts: Workouts for strong abs and more
• Yoga and pilates: Flows and postures to stretch and strengthen
• Recovery: Self-myofascial release, stretching, walking and more
• Mindfulness: Guidance on staying present to improve performance and experience
ACCESSIBLE AND PROGRESSIVE WORKOUTS
• Something for everyone: Find advanced workout programming, beginner workouts and everything in between
• On your terms: Join on-demand, trainer-led classes or follow whiteboard workouts on your own
• Train for something: Achieve your goals with weeks-long workout programs for the gym or home
• Training guidance: Explore a library of in-depth training information at your fingertips
• Nike-only inspiration: Advice and insights from Nike's top trainers, athletes and experts
• Find your favorite exercise: Strength training, conditioning, HIIT workouts, yoga, pilates and more
• Strengthen every muscle: Workouts that target arms, legs, abs and more
• Bodyweight training: Equipment-free workouts that build muscle
• Track achievements: Log completed workouts and celebrate accomplishments
WORKOUT ON DEMAND
• Workouts for any level: Choose from multiple trainer-led, Video On Demand (VOD) classes*
• Workouts for all modalities: Find workouts focused on strength training, conditioning, yoga, pilates and more
• Premiere workouts: Work out with elite athletes and entertainers*
• NTC TV: Train hands-free and get group class experiences at home***
Download Nike Training Club and train with us.
APPLE WATCH SUPPORT
Focus more on your workout and less on your phone when you connect your Apple Watch with NTC. Easily advance to the next movement, pause, skip movements and more, all while monitoring your heart rate and calories burned right from your wrist.
EVERY MOVEMENT COUNTS
Enter any other daily workouts in the Activity tab to keep an accurate account of your journey. If you use the Nike Run Club app, your runs will be automatically recorded in your activity history.
Nike Training Club works with Apple Health to sync workouts and record heart-rate data.
Apple Music can be used to access music library to play music during workouts.
*VOD (Video-On Demand) available in the US, UK, BR, JP, CN, FR, DE, RU, IT, ES, MX and KR.
**NTC Live currently available in the US, UK and select countries.
***NTC TV available only in the US.

I believe that women should feel beautiful in their daily lives, my goal is to bring fun clothing to women of all shapes and sizes. I truly believe that every story has a style, which is what led me to start my own store. 
My name is Megan, known to some of you as SkinnyMeg from my blog. I have lost over 100 pounds, had two children, and grown to love the community of women I participate with on a daily basis. Through my blog I have gained so much enrichment in my daily life, I love to help other's on their own weight loss journey. One thing has always remained consistent no matter my size, my love of clothing. The right outfit has the power to change my mood at any given moment, dressy or casual, I look forward to finding that right dress or top each and every day, well except Sundays, which are reserved for a cute T-shirt and a messy bun!
On my last birthday I had a look at my life ahead, my heart desired to follow my dreams, and with the support of my husband and family I opened Ollie Marie. I'm so excited to share it with all of you!

apple-macos:6761574740.name: Magic Weather - Earth Live
apple-macos:6761574740.description:
Magic Weather is a weather companion built around an interactive 3D Earth. Explore the globe, check your cities and follow changing conditions in one place.
MAGIC EARTH
• Rotate and zoom Earth with day/night lighting and city lights
• Explore live clouds, precipitation, temperature, wind and other available environmental layers
• Follow available storms, radar and environmental observations
• Share the Earth view on an AirPlay display
FORECAST
• Current conditions, feels-like temperature, today's high and low
• Interactive hourly charts for temperature, wind, rain, snow and clouds
• Daily outlook and detailed forecasts, with up to 7 days available from supported providers
• Wind, pressure, humidity, visibility, UV, dew point, air quality, sunrise and sunset
• On-device weather summaries and AI Weather Chat on supported Apple Intelligence devices
SMART NOTIFICATIONS
Choose the weather events that matter to you: approaching rain or snow, temperature changes, aurora and other sky conditions. Government alerts and storm observations are available where supported by the data source. Live Activities and Dynamic Island can show active precipitation on supported devices.
MAKE IT YOURS
Choose your weather provider, temperature units, language, themes, app icons and precipitation colors. Arrange detail cards and save cities. Add Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, including forecast charts and an Earth widget.
APPLE WATCH
Check current conditions, hourly and daily forecasts, a wind compass and a mini globe. Add weather complications to supported watch faces.
PREMIUM
Free weather and basic Earth viewing are available without subscribing. Monthly and Yearly Premium plans unlock additional Earth overlays, the full available forecast, premium alerts and supported AI Weather Chat. Both plans provide the same Premium access.
The Yearly plan offers 12 months for the price of 10 monthly payments where displayed, described as 2 months free vs monthly billing. The full annual price is billed upfront. Prices and eligible introductory offers are displayed by the App Store for your region. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled through your App Store settings. Restore Purchase restores an existing Apple subscription, including Premium shared with the native Apple TV app.
PRIVACY AND AVAILABILITY
No Magic Weather account is required. Location is optional; choose a city manually instead. Selected coordinates are sent to data providers to retrieve local conditions. Optional AI runs on-device. Fresh weather and live datasets require internet. Forecast length, radar, storms, alerts and other observations vary by provider and regional coverage.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://magic-weather.com/privacy.html
